listings.name: Burger QuantenPower Ferndiagnose zur Ursachenfindung und Harmonisierung
listings.description: Burger QuantenPower Coaching in Rottendorf is a life coaching practice for individuals and businesses that works from a distance, wherever the client lives. Its coaching framework is supported by the TimeWaver system. The process starts with a TimeWaver analysis in the information field, continues with a personal Zoom conversation, and leads to an action plan for daily life and longer-term support. A yearly balancing programme for 2026 is also offered, and a free first conversation can be requested. Rated 5.0 from 60 Google reviews, 58 of them five stars and 2 four stars.

listings.name: Dr. Hammerschmidt & Siegemund Hausarzt Röthenbach
listings.description: Dr. Hammerschmidt & Siegemund is a family practice in Röthenbach an der Pegnitz run by two physicians in general practice and internal medicine. Alongside conventional care it offers acupuncture and bioresonance sessions as optional services. The practice has a restroom, wheelchair-accessible entrance, both free and paid street parking, and posted opening hours, and appointments are required. Rated 4.6 from 73 Google reviews, 65 of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Rauch
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Rauch in Augsburg is the practice of Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Peter Rauch. It offers bioresonance, NLS sessions, vital-field analysis with Vieva Pro, heart rate variability (HRV) sessions, electroacupuncture after Dr. Voll, osteopathic techniques, and classical and complex homeopathy. Appointments are required. Rated 4.9 from 54 Google reviews, 53 of them five stars.

listings.name: Diatrofi MB Ernährungsberatung für Kleinkinder, Jugendliche und Erwachsene
listings.description: Diatrofi MB is a nutrition counselling practice in München for toddlers, teenagers and adults, built around everyday solutions rather than strict meal plans and diets. A focus is healthy eating for children, including seminars for daycare centres that help families build a relaxed relationship with food. Bioresonance measurements are offered as an add-on, and sessions can be combined with hypnosis on request. Rated 5.0 from 42 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Dr. med. Isa Kübler
listings.description: Dr. Isa Kübler is a physician specialising in gynaecology and obstetrics, with a practice in the centre of Grünwald. Besides routine gynaecology, her practice lists complementary offers: acupuncture, acu-taping, phytotherapy, homeopathy and BICOM bioresonance sessions. She also holds a specialist qualification in anaesthesiology and emergency care. The practice presents BICOM bioresonance as an energetic method in its complementary section. Rated 4.7 from 46 Google reviews, 42 of them five stars. Appointments are required, and online appointments are offered.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis & Massage
listings.description: Stefan A. Mau is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who combines computer-assisted energy medicine with classic natural health methods in München-Westend. His offer includes the Power Life Scan (NLS), SCIO biofeedback, a vital-field scan and bioresonance with BICOM. Alongside these come acupuncture, osteopathy and lymph drainage, Dorn and Breuss massage, nutrition counselling, neural sessions, complex homeopathy and a range of massages. Appointments are required, and the practice welcomes LGBTQ+ guests. Rated 5.0 from 36 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Natürlich gesund und glücklich - Silvia Tischler
listings.description: Silvia Tischler runs Natürlich gesund und glücklich in Schwarzhofen. The practice offers individual health counselling, prevention, psychological counselling, personality development, coaching and stress management. Bioresonance, phytotherapy, mycotherapy with vital mushrooms and heart rate variability measurement are part of the range. Rated 5.0 from 36 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker und Naturheilpraxis Miriam Boos-Cyppel
listings.description: Miriam Boos-Cyppel is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in München who trained in Traditional Chinese Medicine in China between 2012 and 2016. Her practice combines TCM with Western natural health methods, including acupuncture, acupressure massage, kinesio tape, Thai foot reflexology and Bioresonanztherapie 3000. She can be reached by phone or email. Rated 5.0 from 35 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Maria Rammel Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Maria Rammel is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner), hormone coach and astrologer with a naturopathic practice in Wallersdorf. Bioresonance therapy is one of her main offers, next to children's naturopathy, psychological support and conversations on body, soul and mind. She also runs online courses, live masterclasses, workshops and e-books. Appointments can be booked by phone, by email or online. Rated 5.0 from 31 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Petra Schneider, Heilpraktikerin, Akupunktur, Bicom Bioresonanztherapie, Asiatische Medizin, Darmfachberatung
listings.description: Petra Schneider is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Pastetten, in the Erding district, with over 22 years in naturopathy. Bicom bioresonance, trained at IMU College after Martin Keymer, is one of her two core skills, next to Engaging Vitality acupuncture within Chinese medicine. She also offers herbal and aroma methods, gut counselling and massage. A 15-minute introductory conversation can be held by phone or in the practice, and Monday is for phone and online appointments. Rated 5.0 from 30 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Carolin Greiner-Mai
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Carolin Greiner-Mai in Obermeitingen offers osteopathy, hypnosis, systemic therapy, coaching, couples therapy, family constellations, private physiotherapy, kinesiology, ear acupuncture and bioresonance, plus biofeedback and neurofeedback. Sacral work after Upledger, Gestalt and body-oriented work are also listed, as are ear acupuncture, massage and private physiotherapy, and the practice shows client testimonials. Appointments can be booked online. Rated 5.0 from 29 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Michael Binder
listings.description: Michael Binder is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner), health coach and vital-substance specialist in Ansbach. His practice works with the Rayocomp PS 1000 polar bioresonance device from Rayonex, used in the Rayonex analysis and harmonisation system. The range also includes vital substances, immune colloids, homeopathy, manupathy, Schüssler salts and Bach flowers. From 1 June 2026 the practice is in new rooms in the City Park Passage at Kanalstraße 2-12. Rated 5.0 from 27 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Körperflüstern - Kristina Materna (Heilpraktikerin, Reiki-Lehrerin)
listings.description: Körperflüstern in Teisendorf is the naturopathic practice of Kristina Materna, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and Reiki teacher. For the body it offers bioresonance analysis, osteopathic work, chiropractic, nutrient counselling and frequency therapy. For mind and spirit it offers hypnosis, constellation work, Spiritual Response Therapy and coaching. Energetic house cleansing, Reiki sessions and Reiki courses complete the range. The practice is in Teisendorf in the Berchtesgadener Land district of Bavaria. Rated 5.0 from 24 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: MU Dr. Katerina Hahn
listings.description: Dr. Katerina Hahn is a physician and specialist in general practice in Neutraubling. Her practice offers bioresonance sessions with a BICOM device and the BICOM Body Check 2, a bioenergetic check, together with Matrix rhythm therapy, BEMER vascular therapy and interval hypoxia-hyperoxia training. Appointments can be booked through Doctolib. Rated 4.8 from 27 Google reviews, 25 of them five stars.

listings.name: feelgood - Gesundheitspraxis Bayreuth
listings.description: feelgood Gesundheitspraxis in Bayreuth is run by Pamela Lautner, a state-certified Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). She offers Bicom bioresonance sessions alongside fitdankbaby fitness courses for pregnancy and the first years with a baby, postnatal recovery courses and the Tupler technique. Appointments for bioresonance are arranged by phone or through the contact form, and the practice website explains the basics and how a session works. Women-owned, with wheelchair-accessible parking and seating and unisex restrooms. Rated 5.0 from 23 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Gerald Storm
listings.description: The practice of Gerald Storm in Gersthofen is a general practice run by a physician. Beyond its regular services it lists private offers, among them bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, and also mentions Physiokey and orthomolecular nutrient therapy. Wheelchair accessible parking and entrance are available, and appointments are recommended. Rated 4.4 from 36 Google reviews, 30 of them five stars and 5 one star.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilverfahren Veronika Kreitmeir (Heilpraktikerin)
listings.description: Veronika Kreitmeir is a certified Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a practice in München, working by appointment. Her range combines bioresonance, nutrition optimisation and integrative approaches from TCM and homeopathy, aimed at strengthening general wellbeing. Rated 5.0 from 22 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: AIS Naturheilpraxis Inh. Annette Schmidmeier Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: AIS Naturheilpraxis in München is run by Annette Schmidmeier, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and aroma practitioner who has worked in the health field for more than 40 years. Her offer includes bio-frequency sessions with the Metatron Hunter, an NLS device, as a bio-energetic check-up of the whole organism. Alongside it she offers atlas correction, Dorn spinal work, cupping massage, Reiki, chakra balancing and meditation, and she teaches basic and advanced aromatherapy seminars. Rated 5.0 from 21 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerpraxis BalanceGanzheitlich Gabriele Zidek
listings.description: Gabriele Zidek is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Penzberg offering BICOM bioresonance, BodyTalk including distance sessions, nutrition plans, micronutrients, Novafon sessions and lymph drainage. She also offers Atlasprofilax and a magnesium-oxygen approach. She trained in BodyTalk (accredited 2007 and 2009), has been a BodyTalk Access trainer since 2009 and has worked with bioresonance since 2017. Rated 5.0 from 21 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Lichtimpulse Claudia Jevtic- Tierkommunikation & Energetik
listings.description: Lichtimpulse in Moorenweis is a practice for vibration-based work with people and animals, run by Claudia Jevtic. The range covers bioresonance therapy, animal communication, shamanic soul journeys, numerology and energetic work, together with online courses, coaching and meditations. Rated 5.0 from 21 Google reviews, all of them five stars. An online shop handles session bookings, and a newsletter is available.

listings.name: Seraina Stangier ganzheitliche Therapie für Mensch und Pferd tfmp
listings.description: Seraina Stangier works in München as a physiotherapist and offers sessions for people and for horses. Her range includes craniosacral and meridian work, manual techniques, atlas work, bioresonance analysis, fascia work, personal training, back school, workplace ergonomics and rider biomechanics in the saddle. Pulsed magnetic field sessions and Nordic walking are also on offer. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 21 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Dr. (Univ. Bologna) Nicola Petrarolo Facharzt für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie (VT)
listings.description: Dr. Nicola Petrarolo in Seeon-Seebruck is a physician specialising in psychiatry and psychotherapy who also offers bioresonance sessions, along with hypnosis. Rated 4.8 from 24 Google reviews, 22 of them five stars. Seeon-Seebruck lies by the Chiemsee in Upper Bavaria.

listings.name: Herr Dr. med. Bernd-W. Rosen
listings.description: Dr. med. Bernd-W. Rosen is a physician in Kulmbach, a specialist in physical and rehabilitation medicine and in general practice. His practice lists chirotherapy, osteopathy, naturopathic methods and bioresonance therapy, with consultations by appointment. Rated 4.2 from 37 Google reviews, 29 of them five stars and 7 one star. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are offered.

listings.name: Cranio Coaching - Any Krusche
listings.description: Cranio Coaching by Any Krusche is a practice in Jengen near Buchloe offering craniosacral work, coaching and bioresonance. Coaching is available online or on site, and a free first conversation can be booked. Rated 5.0 from 20 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required, and parking is free on site.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Eva Böck
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Eva Böck is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Erlangen-Tennenlohe, serving the Erlangen, Nuremberg and Fürth area. Bioresonance is the main focus, working mainly with the BICOM Optima by Regumed and a MITO Vitalfeld device by Vitatec. Other offers are Psychosomatic Energetics after Dr. Banis, homeopathy, neural therapy, health coaching, a soul conversation and regression work. Rated 5.0 from 20 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Practice for physiotherapy and osteopathy Claudia Schregle
listings.description: Claudia Schregle's practice in Passau focuses on physiotherapy and osteopathy, including osteopathy for children, and also offers bioresonance, wellness massage, La-Stone sessions and yoga. A team of Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioners) works there. Appointments are by phone or contact form, and registration is open daily from 08:00 to 13:00. An outdoor programme and team-building days are also available. Rated 4.2 from 34 Google reviews, 25 of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Helen Wittmeier - Praxis für Naturheilkunde
listings.description: Helen Wittmeier is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Erlenbach bei Marktheidenfeld. Her practice centres on bioresonance, including the BICOM Body Check, an energetic scan, and she is trained as a bioresonance therapist and BICOM Body Check therapist. Further offers include micronutrient guidance, body composition analysis, a computer-assisted back scan, Bioptron light sessions and attention to psychological wellbeing. Clients come from the Main-Spessart area and beyond. Rated 5.0 from 18 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: LebensEnergie Schuler
listings.description: LebensEnergie Schuler in Jettingen-Scheppach is a practice for wellbeing, relaxation and personal change. It offers Organetik, a bioresonance method for people and animals, and a personal Energie-Kompass session of about 30 minutes that can take place by phone, over Zoom or in the practice. Sessions at a distance are possible. The range also includes BrainLight relaxation, a Vitori crystal mat, massage, energy work, life counselling, workshops and talks. The practitioner is a certified Organetik practitioner and psychological counsellor. Rated 5.0 from 18 Google reviews, all at five stars.

listings.name: Ute Battran, Systemische Aufstellungsarbeit Familien-/wingwaveCoach Breath-Work, Bioresonanz, Mobbingprävention.
listings.description: Ute Battran is a family coach in Unterschleißheim, north of Munich. She is a wingwave coach and offers systemic constellation work, breathwork, courses and retreats, and bullying prevention training for kindergartens and schools. Bioresonance sessions are part of the range and use an Organo Sensor device, aimed at balance of body, mind and soul. Online appointments are possible. Rated 5.0 from 18 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Biophysikalische Praxis (Bioresonanz und Biophysikalische Information)
listings.description: Verena Rumm runs a practice for bioresonance and biophysical information in Grünwald, in renovated rooms she moved into in May 2022. Offers also include magnetic field training and, since 2024, red light and near-infrared sessions. A free trial appointment is available by phone, and online booking is open after the first in-person conversation. Rated 5.0 from 16 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker SEIDEL & STEWART
listings.description: Heilpraktiker Seidel & Stewart in Rottach-Egern is a naturopathic practice with 20 years of experience. It offers bioresonance with BICOM, complex homeopathy and selected classic naturopathic methods, plus a cellSCAN based check and individual nutrition and metabolism programmes (wavePLAN). Rated 5.0 from 16 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Laurent Dumonet - Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Laurent Dumonet is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in München-Obermenzing, at Menzinger Straße 68. His practice offers quantum resonance, a method he describes as similar to bioresonance, along with homeopathy, kinesiology and energised water. Consultations can also be held online for people who live outside München or abroad, and the practice works in German, English and French. Phone hours run from 9:00 to 20:00 daily, ending at 17:00 on Tuesdays, and the practice closes during school holidays. Rated 5.0 from 16 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Chiropraktiker Darmtherapeut - Waldemar Florczak
listings.description: Waldemar Florczak is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and chiropractor in Schwabmünchen with 30 years of experience. His practice combines integrative chiropractic with psychosomatics, gut therapy and bioresonance, using gentle adjustments together with reflexology and fascia work. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Bauer Monika
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Monika Bauer in Massing offers guidance from person to person, with focus areas on nutrition and drinking habits, water filtration, environmental medicine, homeopathy, kinesiology-based testing, bioresonance therapy and holopathy. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Appointments are required, and free street parking is nearby.

listings.name: Zentrum Integrative Therapie
listings.description: Zentrum Integrative Therapie in Glonn is a practice community and school where Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioners), psychotherapy practitioners and coaches work together. The practice works with adults, children and infants. Its range includes craniosacral trauma work, Asian medicine, bioresonance therapy, phytotherapy, yoga and movement work, constellation work and animal-assisted therapy. The school runs training programmes in craniosacral work. Appointments are made by phone or email. Rated 4.9 from 15 Google reviews, 14 of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Annette Büttner, Naturheilpraxis
listings.description: Annette Büttner is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a practice in Ochsenfurt. The offer includes a bioscan measurement and bioresonance, together with acupuncture, ear acupuncture, cupping, Dorn-Breuss therapy, massage, orthomolecular therapy and gut cleansing. Gift vouchers are available. Her approach sees the person as a unit of body, soul and mind. Rated 5.0 from 14 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Vaterstetten-Baldham
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Vaterstetten-Baldham is the practice of Henning Timm, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Vaterstetten. His offer covers bioresonance, homeopathy, pelvic floor training, Guided Imagery and Music (GIM) and deeply relaxing massage. A free, non-binding consultation can be arranged by phone or by online video chat. The practice describes a wider range of methods, so ask which ones fit your interest before booking. Rated 5.0 from 14 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde & Osteopathie Sabine Dietlmeier, Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Sabine Dietlmeier is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a naturopathy and osteopathy practice in Gröbenzell near Munich. Alongside osteopathy her main methods are bioresonance and acupuncture, and she works on gut health, women's health, micronutrients, stress and sleep. Appointments can be booked online or by phone, and the practice has accessible parking and entrance. Rated 5.0 from 14 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: VitaBalance Naturheilpraxis - Petra Kuchar
listings.description: VitaBalance Naturheilpraxis in Bad Tölz is the practice of Petra Kuchar, who offers bioresonance sessions together with nutrition advice, mental coaching, movement advice and a weight management programme. Appointments are by arrangement, weekends on request, and recommended by phone. Rated 5.0 from 14 Google reviews, all five stars. Parking is wheelchair accessible; call ahead to confirm opening times.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Amend Inh. Christine Amend
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Amend, run by Christine Amend in Karlstadt am Main, is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice with a focus on foot care. The list of offers includes foot care and foot reflexology, ear acupuncture, body acupressure, massage, cupping, Bach and Californian flower essences and sessions on the BICOM Bodycheck 2 bioresonance device. Appointments are by arrangement. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Wellaroma Kosmetik und Heilpraktikerpraxis Claudia Neumeier
listings.description: Wellaroma in Erding combines a cosmetics and wellness studio with the practice of a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner), Claudia Neumeier. Facial care and wellness massages sit beside craniosacral osteopathy, manual therapy and ear acupuncture. Bioresonance sessions with the BICOM system are a recent addition. Rated 4.9 from 13 Google reviews, 12 of them five stars. Appointments are recommended and wheelchair-accessible parking is available.

listings.name: Adriana Espino - Integrative Psychotherapie (HeilprG) - Individualtherapie - Paartherapie - Bioresonanz - Deutsch - Spanisch
listings.description: Adriana Espino works in München as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) for psychotherapy, with a practice built around integrative psychological counselling for individuals and couples. Bioresonance sessions are part of the range, offered in person or online, in German or Spanish. A free initial consultation is available by phone. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Frau Rita M. Böhm & Andrea M. Groß
listings.description: Rita M. Böhm and Andrea M. Groß run a practice in Freudenberg offering bioresonance, Bach flower therapy, homeopathy, Schüssler salts, cupping and chakra flower essences. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended, so call ahead to book.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Rachel Thomas - Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Rachel Thomas runs a naturopathic practice in Ansbach as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with 30 years of experience. Her methods are homeopathy, bioresonance, foot reflexology and acupuncture. Bioresonance is presented as a gentle, non-invasive method that works with electromagnetic oscillations to ease stress and support wellbeing. Sessions take place in Ansbach or by video anywhere in the world, and the practice site is also available in English. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Barbiero Manuel
listings.description: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Barbiero Manuel in Simbach am Inn is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice that has specialised in the bioresonance method for more than a decade. The Bicom health check is offered as a session, with session packages, while annual follow-up check-ups and children are billed as single sessions. The practice covers naturopathy and children's care, and it sits at Sonnenhof Felln. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Karola Feicht - Coach für Gesundheit und Lebensfreude
listings.description: Karola Feicht coaches for health and joy of life in Mittelstetten. Her scan and biofeedback offers include a bioenergetic Metavital biophoton scan, a bioresonance scan and balance with the Bicom Optima, HeartMath biofeedback, magnetic field work and the Bemer mat. Coaching topics cover epigenetics, micronutrients, kinesiology, systemic constellations, pregnancy preparation and burnout prevention. Coaching and sessions run in person or online, and dogs, horses and cats can have kinesiology, bioresonance or biophoton sessions. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Praxis Dr. med. Inke Lemberg
listings.description: Dr. med. Inke Lemberg is a family practice physician in Weilheim in Oberbayern, running a practice for integral medicine. Besides general work she offers manual medicine, osteopathy, acupuncture, laser acupuncture, ear acupuncture, BICOM bioresonance, a Body Balance Check, sound work and yin yoga. Rated 4.3 from 16 Google reviews, 13 of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker in Münsing am Starnberger See - Heilpraktikerin Rea Demenat von Behr
listings.description: Rea Demenat von Behr is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Münsing on Lake Starnberg, with a second location in Munich. Her range spans bioresonance therapy, acupuncture, homeopathy, phytotherapy, nutrition therapy and orthomolecular therapy. A visit begins with a detailed intake conversation, then an extended review and an agreed plan. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Katja Höllein
listings.description: Katja Höllein is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Rödental offering counselling and sessions for physical and emotional wellbeing. Her methods include biofeedback, bioresonance, craniosacral therapy, ear acupuncture, kinesiology, Schüssler salts, Bach flowers, EMDR, EFT and micronutrient profiles. She also runs workshops, courses, forest retreats, a therapy time-out and workplace health promotion, with a focus on women's health. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Physiotherapie Schimanski
listings.description: Physiotherapie Schimanski in Riedering, on the Simssee near Rosenheim and at the foot of the Chiemgau Alps, has worked for more than 19 years. It offers classical physiotherapy, manual therapy, PNF Bobath, lymphatic drainage, craniosacral and visceral therapy. The practice also works with energy: bioresonance, energy fields in rooms and places, shamanic geomancy and house clearing. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Osteopathie & Naturheilkunde Philipp Hoffmann - Osteopath
listings.description: Philipp Hoffmann is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and osteopath with a practice in Immenstadt. The practice combines osteopathy with the BICOM bioresonance method and works with babies, children and pregnant clients; it also publishes information on how a session runs and a study on the BICOM method, and it lists opening hours and directions. Appointments are required, and parking is on site and wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all at five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für TCM & Akupunktur Angela Schnyder
listings.description: Angela Schnyder is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in München-Pasing, at Planegger Straße 128, focusing on classical acupuncture and Traditional Chinese Medicine. Her practice follows the idea of a free flow of energy and works through acupuncture of the meridians and Bicom bioresonance frequency sessions. Other offers include warmth sessions, cupping massage, Tuina massage, soft laser, ear acupuncture, magnetic field sessions and nutrition counselling, with separate pages for women and children. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Schwerpunktpraxis für Rückenschmerzen Dr. Josef Fischer
listings.description: Dr. med. Josef Fischer leads a specialist back practice in München built on his 3-element approach: movement, nutrition and energy. As a physician with an orthopaedic background, he offers osteopathy, chirotherapy, posture and movement analysis, nutrition guidance, massages, back training and TCM acupuncture. The energy element includes information field sessions with TimeWaver. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: SD Ästhetik & Gesundheitspraxis / TCM - Akupunktur, Heilpraktiker, Lippenunterspritzung
listings.description: SD Ästhetik & Gesundheitspraxis in Buchloe is the practice of Sofia Dimitriou, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) working in aesthetics and wellbeing. Offers include traditional Chinese medicine, acupuncture, manual trigger point work, cupping, bioresonance and skin care. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended, so call ahead to book.

listings.name: Thomas Lindenthal - Praxis für Osteopathie / Naturheilkunde / Physiotherapie
listings.description: Thomas Lindenthal runs a practice in Kissing that combines osteopathy, naturopathic methods and physiotherapy. He is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner), osteopath and physiotherapist. The range includes bioresonance therapy, kinesiology, Touch for Health, chiropractic, Matrix Rhythm Therapy, acupressure massage, shockwave therapy, massage techniques, systemic constellations, The Reconnection and nutrition supplement advice. Applications at a distance by Zoom or phone are offered too. Appointments are required, and parking is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker & Homöopath Nürnberg - Gesundheitspraxis im Nürbanum Martin Hüwel
listings.description: Martin Hüwel, Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner), has run his Nuremberg practice in the Nürbanum for more than 30 years. His work centres on frequency therapy (Ondamed and PEMF), psychosomatic energetics, classical homeopathy and a health check with a bioscan. The practice is at Allersberger Straße 185, with free parking. Appointments are by arrangement. Rated 4.9 from 10 Google reviews, 9 of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis agape lifestyle Sabine Becker
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis agape lifestyle is run by Sabine Becker, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with more than 20 years of experience, in the Seearkaden opposite Starnberg See station. Her offer includes bioresonance, kinesiology, acupuncture, systemic constellations, coaching and mindset retreats, with focus areas such as gut health and the microbiome. Women-owned, with card payment and a wheelchair-accessible entrance. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from nine Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Franziska Frankson
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Franziska Frankson is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice at Athener Ring 5 in Würzburg. The listed offers include bioresonance, orthomolecular therapy and cupping. Rated 4.5 from 11 Google reviews, 9 of them five stars. Call ahead to book a time.

listings.name: Institut für Ganzheitliche Schönheit Monika Scheßl Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Monika Scheßl runs a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in München that pairs natural health methods with beauty-focused care. Sessions begin with iris and facial analysis, followed by bioresonance. Laser acupuncture is also part of the range, as are cosmetic skin care sessions for the outer appearance. Rated 4.6 from 10 Google reviews, 9 of them five stars and 1 one star.

listings.name: Dr. med. Siegfried Ascher
listings.description: Dr. med. Siegfried Ascher runs a private practice in Erding-Aufhausen. The physician works in general medicine and adds natural-medicine methods, including bioresonance sessions and Oberon sessions, an NLS system. Further offers include acupuncture, homeopathy, neural therapy, traditional Chinese medicine, autogenic training, progressive muscle relaxation and nutrition counselling with fasting support. Rated 4.3 from 12 Google reviews, 10 of them five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Anna Derksen Naturheilpraxis Erlangen
listings.description: Anna Derksen runs a naturopathic practice in Erlangen as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and lecturer. Her main focus is electroacupuncture after Dr. Voll, described as EAV and bioresonance, with additional guidance on gut health and micronutrients. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended and a parking garage is nearby.

listings.name: Kraft-Freude-Leben, Christiane Skrebsky
listings.description: Christiane Skrebsky offers life and wellbeing counselling in Bad Griesbach, in the Passau district. Her focus areas are kinesiology, Organetik (a bioresonance method), transformation therapy after Robert Betz and family constellations, and she also gives talks and workshops. Sessions are possible in the practice or online, and a non-binding first conversation is available by phone. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from eight Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to confirm opening times.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis HOCHFELD
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis HOCHFELD in Bayreuth is a naturopathic practice with bioresonance as its main focus, plus acupuncture and Spenglersan immune therapy. Appointments are required. Women-owned, with a wheelchair-accessible entrance and free street parking. Rated 5.0 from eight Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Spurwechsel Finde deinen Weg
listings.description: Spurwechsel Finde deinen Weg is a life coaching practice in Wallersdorf. Its offers are Reiki, hypnosis, psychokinesiology, bioresonance, other alternative concepts and essential oils. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to confirm how a bioresonance session is run.

listings.name: Zentrum für ganzheitliche Traumatherapie
listings.description: Zentrum für ganzheitliche Traumatherapie in Gmund am Tegernsee is led by Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Petra Maria Quack. The practice offers trauma-oriented individual, couple and group therapy, constellation work, EMDR and training, and lists bioresonance among its naturopathic modules. Appointments are given from 10 to 20 hours, and the practice is owned by a woman and welcomes LGBTQ clients. Rated 4.9 from 8 Google reviews, 7 of them five stars.

listings.name: Frau Dr. med. Karoline Sachsenberg Klassische Homöopathie, Bioresonanztherapie und Allgemeinmedizin in München
listings.description: Dr. med. Karoline Sachsenberg is a physician in general practice with a private practice at Goetheplatz in München's Ludwigsvorstadt district. Her work combines classical homeopathy, bioresonance, acupuncture and psychosomatic basic care, drawing on more than 30 years of experience. She learned bioresonance over 20 years ago in the practice of her mentor, Dr. med. Rolf Oesterle, and works with Regumed devices. Appointments are made by phone, which is staffed daily, even during holiday periods. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin - Verena Berthold
listings.description: Verena Berthold has run her Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Winhöring since 2010, serving Altötting, Mühldorf am Inn, Töging am Inn and the wider area. Her offer includes craniosacral therapy, acupuncture, connective tissue work, foot reflexology, energy work and bioresonance sessions that work with a hair sample. Osteopathy and bioresonance are also available for animals such as dogs, horses and cats, with farm visits possible. Appointments by phone or WhatsApp. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Silke Börner und Team - Entspann di mol
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Silke Börner and team, known as Entspann di mol, is a naturopathic practice in Obergünzburg offering bioresonance, Dorn therapy, massage, acupuncture, cupping and taping, plus nutrition, fasting and gut-health coaching and IHHT training. Red-light sessions, Baunscheidt and reflexology are part of the offer, and a practice team works alongside her. Appointments can be booked online or by WhatsApp. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Birgit Maier-Scholz
listings.description: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Birgit Maier-Scholz in Erding is run by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with an anthroposophic background. The range includes bioresonance, acupuncture, Dorn method and osteopathy, and hypnosis work. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required, and parking and the entrance are wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Ramona Würdinger Gesundheit in der Praxis, Lipödem Beratung, Familien Aufstellung, psych. Beratung
listings.description: Ramona Würdinger runs a health counselling practice in Obernzell that combines bioscan and bioresonance sessions with counselling, family constellations and psychological support. Maps lists the practice as a health counsellor. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Bioresonanz Ulm
listings.description: Bioresonanz Ulm is a practice for bioresonance and magnetic field therapy in Neu-Ulm, with a second address in Ulm. It describes its approach as gentle and aimed at general wellbeing in body and mind. Appointments are made by phone. The first consultation is held in agreement with the practice's physician adviser, after which an individual plan is drawn up. The practice also carries Dr. Weyrauch herbal specialties for people and animals and posts them to customers. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Claudia Ewender
listings.description: Claudia Ewender runs a practice in Kempten with hypnotherapy, Sinosomatics and wingwave coaching as its main offers. Further methods include Chinese herbal therapy, acupuncture, gua sha, cupping, bioresonance therapy, foot reflexology and ear acupuncture. She says she chooses the right method together with each client in conversation and sometimes switches methods within a session, aiming at wellbeing. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars. Wheelchair-accessible parking, entrance, seating and restroom are available.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Julia Altermann Naturheilpraxis Bioresonanztherapie Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Julia Altermann is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Memmingen whose work centres on BICOM bioresonance and bioenergetic body work. Alongside it she offers gut rebuilding, Bach flowers, aromatherapy and BEMER therapy, including BEMER rental. She takes time for a thorough first conversation before choosing methods. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required, and parking is free in a garage, on the street or in a lot, with a hearing loop on site.

listings.name: Kinderheilpraktikerin Daniela Dietel
listings.description: Daniela Dietel is a children's Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a naturopathy practice in Hof for children and adults. Bioresonance therapy sits alongside craniosacral osteopathy, ear acupuncture and taping. She also offers homeopathy, baby massage and support from family planning through pregnancy to birth, including homeopathy, Schüssler salts and osteopathy during pregnancy. Single sessions take place in the practice. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all at five stars. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Birgit Schichtl Ghazouani Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Birgit Schichtl-Ghazouani runs a Naturheilpraxis as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her range includes EEG neurofeedback, bioresonance and radionics with a hair sample, a Bioscan, epigenetics, radial shockwave therapy, chiropractic, frequency field therapy and fertility support. Radionics sessions with the Bruce Copen device need no visit to the practice, and the results are discussed in an online consultation. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Osteopathie Kerstin Feneberg
listings.description: Kerstin Feneberg runs an osteopathy and naturopathy practice at Augsburger Straße in Füssen. She is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and works with osteopathy for adults and children, bioresonance sessions, homeopathy and phytotherapy. Appointments are booked by phone, email or WhatsApp. The practice is owned by a woman and recommends booking ahead. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Sylvia Kudella Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Sylvia Kudella is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with her own practice in Würzburg-Heidingsfeld. Bioresonance therapy is the focus, for adults and for children and families. A session starts with a detailed conversation about the client's situation, and nutrition, sleep, stress, movement and micronutrients can be included. Couples coaching is a separate offer, not combined with bioresonance. Appointments are by arrangement, and a free, non-binding first phone call is possible. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Zahnärztin Dr./IMF Bukarest Anne-Marie Trent München
listings.description: Anne-Marie Trent runs a dentist's practice in München and holds a doctorate from the IMF in Bucharest. Beyond routine dental care, the practice lists bioresonance sessions among its services, alongside natural health and homeopathic approaches under the banner of holistic dentistry. Appointments are required. Rated 4.4 from 7 Google reviews, 6 of them five stars and 1 one star.

listings.name: Elements Therapiezentrum by Care Central
listings.description: Elements in Nuremberg, a therapy centre run by Care Central, offers hyperbaric oxygen sessions as its main focus, along with hydrogen inhalation, bioresonance therapy after Paul Schmidt, BIOMAG magnetic field therapy and near-infrared light. Bioresonance and BIOMAG sessions are also offered for animals, from small pets upwards, in cooperation with an animal osteopath. An online shop sells supplements and vouchers, and a second location is in Bayreuth. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Claudia und Andreas Mayer
listings.description: Claudia and Andreas Mayer run a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in München-Schwabing, working with infants, children and adults. The main focus is bioresonance with a Bicom device, including the Bicom Body Check, a gentle scan that takes a few minutes. Osteopathy is the second pillar, supported by craniosacral work, homeopathy and energy and chakra work. Appointments are booked by phone. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Lösch in Neusäß Bioresonanztherapie Therapie nach Dr. Klinghardt und Dr. Selz Heilpraxis
listings.description: This Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Neusäß combines bioresonance sessions, including bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, with kinesiology and energy-based methods that draw on bio- and quantum physics. The practice also works with approaches named after Dr. Klinghardt and Dr. Selz. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Antje Loos
listings.description: Antje Loos is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Freising, with a practice on Arndtstraße. Her range includes Penzel acupressure massage on the body, spine and joints, gentle craniosacral bodywork, homeopathy, kinesiology, isopathy, tuning fork sound sessions and Bach flower consultations. Bioresonance sessions are one of the methods she uses. She also teaches courses at the adult education centre and practises Taiji. Appointments are reserved by phone. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Gudrun Kühner
listings.description: Heilpraxis Gudrun Kühner in München is a naturopathic practice for people who feel unheard after routine check-ups. Its range includes bioresonance, micronutrient guidance, herbal approaches, magnetic field sessions, homeopathy, hormone massage and mental field sessions. Areas of focus are digestive wellbeing, women's health and preventive check-ups with personal guidance. Appointments are required and on-site visits are offered. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Nadine Pangratz Heilpraktikerin nach Dr. Klinghardt
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Nadine Pangratz is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Baiersdorf, between Erlangen and Forchheim, seeing adults and children and welcoming clients from across the Nuremberg region. Bioresonance is offered alongside homeopathy, kinesiology and psychokinesiology, systemic family constellations, Dorn therapy, nutrition counselling, energy work and mental field techniques. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required, so call ahead.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Schiff
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Schiff at Marktstrasse 16 in Bissingen is the practice of Josef Schiff, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and physiotherapist, active in Bissingen for about 20 years. The range includes an NES scan, EAV after Dr. Voll, meridian analysis, TFH kinesiology, NST osteopathy and bioresonance. Appointments are by arrangement, payment is cash only, and the entrance is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from five Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Auroa Praxis & Ausbildung
listings.description: Auroa Praxis & Ausbildung in Gundelsheim is a health consultancy that lists energetic and systemic coaching, bioresonance, nutrition counselling, craniosacral work and aroma oils, with training courses alongside. The premises have wheelchair accessible parking and the practice welcomes LGBTQ clients. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews. Opening hours are not posted, so call ahead.

listings.name: Bioresonanz-Praxis-Söhlmann
listings.description: Bioresonanz-Praxis-Söhlmann is a naturopathic practice in Landsberg am Lech offering bioresonance sessions. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended, and parking and seating are wheelchair accessible. Call ahead to confirm the session options.

listings.name: Bioresonanz-Schonsky
listings.description: Bioresonanz-Schonsky is a bioresonance practice in Bad Endorf, near Rosenheim and the Chiemsee, run by Katja Schonsky (B.A.). Sessions use electromagnetic oscillations, and the practice offers gift vouchers for health and wellbeing. Appointments are made by phone or email, and opening hours are posted. Rated 5.0 from four Google reviews, all five stars. Parking is wheelchair accessible. The practice pages cover the way sessions are run and the areas of application, and an HOLOSLIM offer is announced as news. Call to confirm what a first appointment involves.

listings.name: Das VitalWerk
listings.description: Das VitalWerk in Steinwiesen is a wellbeing centre in the Frankenwald near Kronach for resilience and stress management. Courses cover yoga, meditation, Qi Gong, sound and relaxation, and the practice side includes bioresonance with a VIEVA analysis, IHHT oxygen sessions, nutrition, Liebscher & Bracht specialists, systemic coaching and constellations. Wellness massages and open days are also on offer. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Institut Claudia Beer
listings.description: Institut Claudia Beer in Bobingen offers spiritual and psychological coaching for mind, body and soul. The methods include constellation techniques, ancestor constellations, SRT (Spiritual Response Therapy), aura work, consciousness coaching and frequency sessions with TimeWaver, plus MetaHunter. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to ask which sessions suit your goals and how they are booked.

listings.name: Margit Tischler Energiearbeit
listings.description: Margit Tischler offers energy work in Aldersbach, centred on ORGANETIK, a bioresonance procedure she has been trained in and practises with clients and family. Alongside it she offers Organo Feng Shui consultation, acupressure massage after Penzel, Tibetan energy massage, foot reflexology, Reiki and shamanic work. She also teaches ORGANETIK seminars and supplies ORGANO products. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from four Google reviews, all five stars, with posted opening hours and free parking.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Hanna Karnstedt
listings.description: Hanna Karnstedt runs a naturopathy practice in Hilpoltstein, listed as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and osteopath. Osteopathy and bioresonance are the named services. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all at five stars. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Simone K. Ammann
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Simone K. Ammann in Oberstdorf lists bioresonance therapy next to Bach flower therapy, homeopathy, Schüssler salt therapy, children's care, anthroposophic approaches, ear acupuncture and acid-base regulation. A separate foot care service runs under the same name. Appointments are required and made by phone, so call before visiting. Simone K. Ammann also describes her areas of focus in a short personal introduction. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Sabine Schmidt
listings.description: Sabine Schmidt's naturopathic practice in Ortenburg offers bioresonance therapy as one of its named services, alongside neural therapy and hormone counselling. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended, so call to confirm which sessions are available.

listings.name: Private Praxis für Physiotherapie & Naturheilkunde - Andrea Fabel
listings.description: Private Praxis für Physiotherapie & Naturheilkunde, led by Andrea Fabel in Prien am Chiemsee, combines private physiotherapy with craniosacral body therapy and bioresonance sessions. Electroacupuncture after Voll is also listed. Opening hours are posted and appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: belle peau cosmétique
listings.description: Belle peau cosmétique in Erlangen is a cosmetics studio that has added energetic wellness sessions since 2023. These include work with the chakras, shamanic soul journeys, a vital analysis through bioresonance, manifestation work and meditations, offered alongside individual cosmetic care. Rated 4.8 from 4 Google reviews, 3 of them five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis für Bioresonanz
listings.description: This München practice is led by Heike Habermann, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) whose guiding line is to do something good for the body so that the soul wants to live in it. Bioresonance is the central offer, introduced on a dedicated page covering how it works, who it suits and how it can be combined with other methods. Intestinal cleansing, lymph drainage and Shiatsu are also available. Appointments are required and arranged by phone or email. Rated 3.7 from 6 Google reviews, 4 of them five stars and 2 of them one star.

listings.name: Beate Fuoss - Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Beate Fuoss is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Neuendettelsau who also trained as a nurse. She works with the Bicom optima bioresonance device from Regumed and combines it with traditional Chinese medicine including acupuncture and moxibustion, nutrition advice, Dorn spinal therapy, homeopathy and systemic family constellations, which are DGfS-certified and can also be done online. A phone conversation beforehand covers what is needed. She also offers Dorn therapy and sympathetic nerve therapy after Dr. Heesch, and runs events in Neuendettelsau. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Gesundheitspraxis/Heilpraktikerin, Auszeit Apartment Christa Pindel
listings.description: Christa Pindel runs a health practice and guest apartment in Ortenburg as a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her sessions include a BICOM Body-Check, osteopathy for infants, children and adults, and stays that combine accommodation with sessions. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin und Osteopathin Marina Roppelt
listings.description: Marina Roppelt is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and osteopath in Spiegelau. Alongside osteopathy she works with bioresonance on the MNLS system Oberon, where the scan is done through headphones and shown on a computer. Her range also includes Liebscher & Bracht, reflexology, naturopathic methods and REGENA therapy. Spiegelau is in the Bavarian Forest in the Freyung-Grafenau district, and the practice website lists her methods in detail. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Franziska Knörl
listings.description: Heilpraxis Franziska Knörl in Waischenfeld, Upper Franconia, is run by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). The practice offers naturopathy and bioresonance sessions. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Waischenfeld lies in the Franconian Switzerland region.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Caroline Borgolte
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Caroline Borgolte in Schweinfurt is the practice of Caroline Borgolte, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her concept draws mainly on bioresonance, ear acupuncture and chakra harmonisation, and she works with Schüssler salts, Bach flowers, spagyrics and CBD oil. Appointments are made by arrangement. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Penka Donnert, Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Penka Donnert received her Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) licence in München in 2017 and also works as an animal practitioner with a mobile practice. Her main focus is BICOM bioresonance, supported by homeopathy, Bach flowers, aromatherapy, herbal approaches, nutrition guidance, acupressure and massage. She also offers aesthetic care for the skin. Her work ranges from babies and children to women, men and seniors. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Osteopathie und Allergie
listings.description: This Diespeck practice combines osteopathy, including parietal, visceral and craniosacral work, with osteopathic taping and bioresonance sessions for people from babies to seniors. Bioresonance is also offered for psycho-energetic balance. Visits are by appointment only, arranged by phone or email, so there are no waiting times. The office line is staffed on Monday and Tuesday afternoons, and a contact form is available at other times. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars. Wheelchair-accessible parking is available.

listings.name: Dr. Klaus Jürgens
listings.description: Dr. med. Klaus G. Jürgens runs a private practice in München as a physician specialising in orthopaedics and chirotherapy (chiropractic care). The practice also lists bioresonance sessions among its offers, next to laser and spine-focused sessions, and holds consultation hours for privately insured and self-paying clients. Contact is by email or through the consultation hours listed for the practice. Rated 3.0 from 6 Google reviews, 3 of them five stars and 3 of them one star.

listings.name: Anne Mohr-Bartsch Heilpraktikerin, Zentrum für Craniosacrale Traumatherapie
listings.description: Anne Mohr-Bartsch runs a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Haar, set up as a centre for craniosacral and trauma-sensitive work. Bioresonance is among the sessions on offer, next to craniosacral therapy. The practice describes quick appointment booking and a team that gives thorough advice. Appointments are recommended, and the entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews.

listings.name: Gesundheit und Lebensfreude
listings.description: Gesundheit und Lebensfreude in Heimertingen is a Reiki practice that also offers tarot and bioresonance. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews. Parking is wheelchair accessible and appointments are recommended. Call ahead to confirm opening times and how a session is run.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Lisa Maschlak
listings.description: Lisa Maschlak is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Hohenthann with a focus on homeopathy and BICOM bioresonance. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews. Appointments are required, there is free parking, and debit cards are accepted. Call ahead to confirm opening times.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Gudrun Kühner
listings.description: Heilpraxis Gudrun Kühner in Hörgertshausen offers bioresonance among its therapy options, next to micronutrients, plant-based therapy, magnetic field therapy, homeopathy, hormone massage and mental field therapy. The practice focuses on women's health and preventive counselling. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews. Appointments are required, and the entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Petra Friedrich
listings.description: Heilpraxis Petra Friedrich in Salzweg is a naturopathic practice with a focus on bioresonance and Colorpuncture after Peter Mandel. For emotional wellbeing she offers Access sessions after Dr. Douglas Diehl. Other offers include Bach flowers, Schüssler salts, essential oils and Raindrop massage, and seminars in the Metamorphic Technique can be booked. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Veronika Sheikh München Laim
listings.description: In München-Laim, Veronika Sheikh works as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) from Von-der-Pfordten-Straße 34, with appointments by arrangement. The range covers acupuncture, bioresonance, frequency sessions, EMDR coaching and micronutrient guidance, aimed at body, mind and spirit, and she takes a natural, whole-person approach. Frequency sessions use Trikombin and EAV, and English-speaking sessions are available. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Marschall Bioresonanz
listings.description: Margot Marschall, Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a Master of Science in human movement science, spent 15 years in orthopaedics before training in bioresonance and craniosacral osteopathy. She offers Bicom bioresonance sessions and craniosacral osteopathy, serving Neubiberg, Haar, the Munich east side and Wolfratshausen. Her listing also names English as a page option. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Hours are posted and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Brigitte Schulz
listings.description: Brigitte Schulz is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Bruckberg whose practice focuses on naturopathy and bioresonance. Sessions use a BICOM optima device from Regumed, and the practice also offers a Body Balance Check on a separate device. Further offers include acupuncture, hypnosis, nutrition and sleep guidance, gut health, women's health and children's sessions. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Elisabeth Mähringer
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Elisabeth Mähringer in Ruhpolding lists bioresonance, psychosomatic energetics, homeopathy, Bach flowers, Kahi coaching and orthomolecular consulting. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Opening hours are posted and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Horst Kraus
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Horst Kraus in Forchheim is a naturopathic practice with two named focuses: the Liebscher & Bracht method, which is its main emphasis, and bioresonance sessions. Appointments are recommended and opening hours are posted. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. The practice has a restroom on site. Call ahead to confirm what a first visit involves and how to book.

listings.name: Physio HelBa
listings.description: Physio HelBa in Grafenrheinfeld is the practice of Helmut Balser, a physiotherapist who also holds the Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) qualification. He works with atlas therapy, STR, the S-point method and Dorn therapy, and has recently added bioresonance sessions. A water filter system is also sold. Appointments are required, and the premises are wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews.

listings.name: Pranamer Praxis für Naturheilkunde & Meridiantherapien, Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Pranamer Praxis für Naturheilkunde & Meridiantherapien in Bad Hindelang is led by Andrea Geisteier, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with diplomas in acupuncture and Ayurveda and training as an energy coach. Her work combines kinesiology after Dr Klinghardt and bioresonance with Japanese acupuncture, impulse therapy and nutrient guidance. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from two Google reviews, both five stars. Opening hours are posted.

listings.name: Praxis für Ergotherapie und Entspannung
listings.description: Praxis für Ergotherapie und Entspannung is an occupational therapy practice in Schweinfurt run by Nicole Götzendörfer. A single therapist stays with each client for the whole visit and works toward the client's goals. Besides occupational therapy, the practice offers neurofeedback and bioresonance sessions, and it runs yoga courses for prevention that health insurers may subsidise. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews.

listings.name: Praxis für ganzheitliche Therapie und Bioresonanz Monica Stein
listings.description: Monica Stein has worked as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in her own practice since 1989, now in Alling near Munich. Her practice centres on stress management and metabolism optimisation, using computer-assisted bioresonance sessions together with traditional naturopathic knowledge. Each visit includes a conversation about the client's current life situation. Appointments can be booked online, and opening hours are posted. Rated 5.0 from two Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Vaterstetten - Eleonore Keupp
listings.description: Eleonore Keupp runs a naturopathic practice in Vaterstetten. The range includes bioresonance, electro-acupuncture after Voll, acupuncture, colour-point work, homeopathy, plant medicine, Dorn spinal work, manual techniques, ultrasound and massage. She also offers a Metabolic Balance nutrition change. Fees are billed under the Heilpraktiker fee schedule (GebüH). Appointments are made by phone or through the contact form. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Gilching Julia Eingärtner - Praxis Kerngesund Gilching
listings.description: Praxis Kerngesund in Gilching is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice of Julia Eingärtner. It lists body therapy, talk therapy, EMDR, homeopathy, bioresonance, BodyTalk, fascia energetics, massage and physiotherapy. Appointments are required and a contact form is available. Rated 4.5 from 2 Google reviews.

listings.name: BEWECO Heilpraktikerin Susanne Vogt - Praxis für Energie- und Informationsmedizin, Schmerztherapie, Kinesiologie
listings.description: BEWECO in Coburg is the practice of Susanne Vogt, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who has worked here since 2015. Her approach is energy and information-based, with frequency analyses on METAVITAL HUMAN TS and METAVITAL DOG, kinesiology, Innerwise, bioresonance and Liebscher and Bracht methods, for people and animals. A rejuvenation couch is available for relaxation, and the premises are barrier-free with free parking. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Card payments are accepted, the practice welcomes LGBTQ clients, and appointments are required. Dates for 2026 are published for booking.

listings.name: BIORESONANZ für Mensch & Tier
listings.description: Bioresonanz für Mensch und Tier offers HOLOSAN bioresonance sessions in the Landshut district from Bruckberg, for people and for pets. The practice describes bioresonance as a gentle method that draws on energy physics and traditional Chinese medicine, used as support alongside everyday care. Its pages cover how a session runs, the Holosan device with its software and natural products as a complement. The practitioner has used bioresonance with her own dog. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Landsberg
listings.description: Stefan Grießinger runs Naturheilpraxis Griessinger in the centre of Landsberg am Lech, working as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). He works mainly with osteopathy, acupuncture, Bicom bioresonance and complex homeopathy. Online appointment booking is available, and the practice has a guide for first visits. Acupuncture and osteopathy are listed as further specialities. Appointments are required. Paid parking is available in a garage, a lot and on the street, and the entrance, seating and restroom are wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Gilg
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Gilg in Simbach am Inn offers bioresonance, phytotherapy, acupuncture, implant acupuncture, solution-focused hypnosis and MediTaping, and it also sees children. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call ahead to confirm session details and opening times.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Unterbierbach
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Unterbierbach is the practice of Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Michael Odendahl, serving Fraunberg and the area around Erding and Taufkirchen. Bioresonance sessions are done with the Metatron Hospital, an NLS system. The practice also offers Cell-Re-Active Training from Theralogy, osteopressure trained in the Liebscher & Bracht approach, nutrient guidance and intensive coaching based on the Qifactor concept. Appointments can be booked online or by phone, and a practice video and a virtual practice visit are on offer. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Praxis Heilpraktikerin Claudia Hösl
listings.description: Claudia Hösl runs a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Forstern that presents her as a BICOM bioresonance specialist. Nutrition counselling is part of the range. The premises have a wheelchair accessible entrance, seating and restroom, and appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call to confirm opening times.

listings.name: Rita Irlesberger
listings.description: Rita Irlesberger is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) at Nelkenstrasse 12 in Weihmichl. The practice offers a BodyBalanceCheck, a bioenergetic check that scans the frequency patterns of the body's energy state, along with bioresonance, Jin Shin Jyutsu, kinesiology, homeopathy, cupping and foot reflexology. Jaw balance work (RESET) and gift vouchers are also available. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Weihmichl is in the Landshut district of Lower Bavaria.

listings.name: Schadeck Christof Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Christof Schadeck runs a naturopathic practice as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Schwarzenfeld. His preferred methods are classical and complex homeopathy, psychosomatic energetics, bioresonance, neural therapy, chiropractic and acupuncture. He also works on regeneration. The practice is in Schwarzenfeld in the Upper Palatinate region of Bavaria. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Schwarzenfeld lies in the Schwandorf district, and the practice is found in the Schwarzenfeld area of the Upper Palatinate.

listings.name: Traumatherapie, Hilfe bei Depressionen - Ängsten u.v.m. Psychotherapie nach dem Heilpraktikergesetz
listings.description: Renate Dertinger runs a practice in Pähl, south of Munich and close to Weilheim, Herrsching, Dießen, Starnberg and Tutzing. She is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) for psychotherapy under the Heilpraktikergesetz, with training in systemic couple and family therapy (DGSF) and Somatic Experiencing trauma therapy. Her sessions use Mental Field Therapy (MFT), developed by Dr. Dietrich Klinghardt, and frequency work with the TimeWaver Frequency device and its McMakin module. Sessions are also possible over Zoom. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Lebenskraft - Praxis für Bioresonanz
listings.description: Lebenskraft is a bioresonance practice in Mühldorf run by Christiane Kirmeier, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and member of the Fachverband Deutscher Heilpraktiker e.V. She trained in bioresonance therapy and in TCM and acupuncture. The practice also has pages on herbs and relaxation, and a free 20-minute consultation is available by phone or email. Rated 3.0 from 2 Google reviews, one at five stars and one at one star. Wheelchair-accessible parking is available.

listings.name: Angelika Tagsold Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Angelika Tagsold is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Maisach, west of Munich, at Tulpenstraße 17a. Her practice, branded Wirbelsäule-In-Balance, offers spine-focused therapy, kinesiology, acupuncture, homeopathy, Bach flowers and bioresonance, with osteopathic techniques and energetic massages. Gift vouchers are available.

listings.name: Céline Teufele Heilpraktikerin Oberallgäu Bioresonanztherapie
listings.description: Céline Teufele is listed as a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Oberstdorf, offering bioresonance therapy. The linked Oberstdorf therapy practice is run by Andreas Hieble and also covers physiotherapy, podo-orthesiology and BCR microcurrent therapy, with naturopathy including hormone counselling for women and men. Weekday opening hours start at 8.00, with Wednesday open until 20.00. Appointments are recommended. Call ahead to confirm who offers the bioresonance sessions.

listings.name: Claudia Werner - Praxis für Bioresonanztherapie und energetische Regulation
listings.description: Claudia Werner runs a practice in Dachau for bioresonance and energetic regulation. She is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and works with the BICOM bioresonance method from Regumed, which she presents as sitting alongside approaches such as homeopathy. The practice also offers spagyrics, Schüssler salts and Bach flower sessions, and has pages on bioresonance for children and on women's health topics. Costs and a contact page are on the practice website. Wheelchair-accessible parking is available and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Cosmic Wave
listings.description: Cosmic Wave in Starnberg is a coaching center built around TimeWaver information-field technology, with a stated focus on holistic wellbeing. The offer includes aura analysis and harmonisation in the information field, a monthly Powermonat programme, and a separate page called Kind und Tier in Balance for children and animals. The TimeWaver gets its own page on the practice website. Opening hours are not posted, so call or use the contact form to arrange a session and ask how a TimeWaver session is run.

listings.name: Dr. phil. Andreas Kalg, Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Dr. phil. Andreas Kalg is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Unterthingau in the Allgäu. His practice centres on traditional Chinese medicine, including Chinese herbal medicine, acupuncture and cupping. Further offers are bioresonance, hypnosis therapy, Sinosomatics, wingwave coaching, laser therapy, massage and nutrition counselling. Unterthingau lies in the Ostallgäu district near Kempten, Bavaria. Appointments can be requested through his online profile.

listings.name: Felicitas Schauer - Heilpraktikerin & Gesundheitspädagogin SKA
listings.description: Felicitas Schauer is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and health educator in München. Her programme covers autogenic training, progressive muscle relaxation after Jacobson, solution-oriented hypnosis, K-taping and bioresonance sessions for everyday concerns. She brings more than 40 years of experience from conventional healthcare and about twenty years as a health educator. Her Maps profile also lists business management consulting as a related service.

listings.name: Gesund-Zeit-Praxis-Erkheim
listings.description: Gesund-Zeit-Praxis-Erkheim is a naturopathic practice in Erkheim whose focus areas are craniosacral osteopathy, Dorn therapy, women's health and bioresonance. The owner describes an approach that sees each person as a whole being. A mentoring offer is also available, and costs are explained on a separate page. Call 08336 56 60 50 to confirm opening hours and how to book a session.

listings.name: Heike Astrid Fuß Heilpraktiker und Ernährungsberatung
listings.description: Heike Astrid Fuß is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and nutrition counsellor in Pfaffenhofen an der Ilm. She offers bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, homeopathy, ear acupuncture, Schüssler salts, colour therapy and nutrition counselling covering gut health, weight and metabolism. Her homeopathy follows Hahnemann's sixth Organon with LM and Q potencies. Pages cover the basics of healthy eating and weight gain or loss, and bioresonance is traced back to Paul Schmidt's work in 1975. Appointments are required, and the practice has wheelchair-accessible parking.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker
listings.description: This Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Kronach lists BICOM bioresonance sessions among its offers, alongside ear acupuncture, cupping, Baunscheidt therapy and courses in scent Qi Gong and Dorn-Breuss technique. The practice has a free parking lot and wheelchair-accessible parking and restroom, and recommends booking an appointment. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are available.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Corinna Scheler
listings.description: Heilpraktikerin Corinna Scheler in Rödelmaier is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who offers bioresonance sessions alongside naturopathy, Phylak, spagyrics and homeopathy. Opening hours are posted, wheelchair-accessible parking is available, and appointments are recommended. The practice lists naturopathy, Phylak, spagyrics and homeopathy.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin in Rückersdorf - Angela Will
listings.description: Heilpraktikerin Angela Will works in Rückersdorf mainly with homeopathy and bioresonance. Appointments are by arrangement only, and a conversation about your situation and wishes is offered first. The practice has a restroom and wheelchair-accessible parking.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Nicole Adler
listings.description: Nicole Adler is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a private practice in Schwarzenbruck, near Feucht. She offers individual naturopathic concepts with a focus on hormone counselling, bioresonance and classical homeopathy, and advises on orthomolecular nutrients on request. Appointments can be booked online, and the first introductory conversation is always free. Her pages also carry talks and articles, for example on how bioresonance works and how it can be used at home with an app. She also describes her training in naturopathy and bioresonance, and her practice is located on the Licht Campus in Schwarzenbruck.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Ute Kühner
listings.description: Heilpraktikerin Ute Kühner runs a practice in Kammeltal. Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) is the category she works under, and her listed offers are acupuncture, craniosacral therapy and bioresonance sessions. The practice has opening hours posted, asks for appointments in advance, and has wheelchair-accessible parking, entrance and seating. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are currently offered and how to book.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Susanne Fuchs
listings.description: Susanne Fuchs runs a Natur-Heilpraxis in Mömbris offering bioresonance therapy, classical homeopathy, psycho-kinesiology, family constellations, Bach flowers, therapeutic conversation, reincarnation therapy and deep breathing, plus courses and seminars. Appointments are recommended, and the practice has a restroom on site. Contact the practice directly to ask how a session is structured and how to book.

listings.name: Katja Schlüpfinger - energetische Bioresonanz, Organetik und bioenergetische Analyse
listings.description: Katja Schlüpfinger offers energetic bioresonance, Organetik and bioenergetic analysis from Kaufering. Sessions are presented as a way to bring balance to energy level, stress level and emotional wellbeing, and the work covers people and animals. Consultations take place conveniently online, or in person when needed. She also works with Feng Shui, including for business spaces and sleeping places, and a section of her work looks at family and ancestral systems. A personal analysis can be booked online, and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Alexandra Eilbacher
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Alexandra Eilbacher in Bürgstadt is run by a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who completed her training in 2016 after more than 20 years of interest in naturopathy. Her fields include homeopathy, bioresonance, cupping massage, body acupuncture, naturopathic pharmacology and talk-based counselling. Bioresonance sessions use hand and foot electrodes connected to a bioresonance device. Appointments are recommended, so call ahead.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Andrea Wenig
listings.description: Andrea Wenig, Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner), runs a naturopathic practice in Neubiberg focused on hormones and menopause, weight and back mobility. Bioresonance sessions are part of the range. Online booking is available, appointments are required, and the entrance, seating and restroom are wheelchair accessible. A hearing loop is installed.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Eva Schaal, Heilpraktiker für Bioresonanz und Akupunktur
