listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Eva Schaal in Altusried is led by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who also trained as a children's nurse. The practice focuses on BICOM bioresonance sessions, acupuncture, Chinese medicine and manual methods, with an initial detailed conversation before any sessions begin, and naturopathy for women. A non-binding first conversation is available for anyone whose concerns are not listed. Appointments can be booked online, opening hours are posted, and the practice has free parking on site, a hearing loop and wheelchair-accessible seating and restroom. The approach is laid out in three steps, starting with a detailed first conversation.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Grafrath - Tatjana Heinisch Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Grafrath is the practice of Tatjana Heinisch, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) for people and animals. She is trained in class 3B laser devices and in bioresonance, and her focus is laser therapy and laser acupuncture, bioresonance and manual therapy. The range also covers physiotherapy, osteopathy, craniosacral therapy, reflexology and aromatherapy. A free first conversation is offered, and she can be reached by mailbox, SMS or WhatsApp because she often cannot pick up during a session. Appointments are required, opening hours are posted, and the practice has accessible parking and a restroom. She is also linked to a professional association of Heilpraktiker.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Hermann Gratzl
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Hermann Gratzl in Irlbach offers a Metascan whole-body scan and bioresonance, together with homeopathy, plant-based therapy, acupuncture, Bach flowers, Baunscheidt therapy, laser therapy and Feng Shui. Appointments are recommended and parking is wheelchair accessible. Call ahead to confirm opening times.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Kathrin Huber
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Kathrin Huber in Essenbach offers a range of naturopathic methods: kinesiology, spagyrics with plant tinctures, Bach flowers, Schüssler salts and bioresonance sessions. Hours are posted. Call ahead to confirm how to book a first appointment.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Kerstin Sethuram
listings.description: Kerstin Sethuram runs a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Kaltental-Aufkirch with bioresonance therapy as one of her main areas. Other focus areas are nutrition and metabolism, fasting courses (Buchinger, base-fasting and modified fasting), plant-based therapy and manual jaw therapy. Training in BICOM 2000 bioresonance is listed among her qualifications. Free parking is in front of the practice, and Kaufbeuren, Buchloe and the Ostallgäu are within easy reach. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Petra Pongratz Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Petra Pongratz is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Jesenwang. Her sessions use the SCIO biofeedback and bioresonance system and heart rate variability measurement, which is also used to practise relaxation techniques. Other offers include stress management, holistic advice, earthing, galvanic micro-current therapy, home visits, and courses and talks. The practice focuses on vitality and zest for life, taking body, mind and soul together. Appointments are required, and parking is wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Tanja Hollmann
listings.description: Heilpraktikerin Tanja Hollmann has a naturopathic practice in Scheidegg-Lindenau. She works with a Delta-Scan bioresonance device and also offers cranio-sacral osteopathy and trauma therapy. Animal communication is another passion of hers, a way of connecting with your pet through telepathy. Appointments are arranged by phone. The practice is in Scheidegg in the Allgäu, and a contact form is available for enquiries.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Tatiana Krott
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Tatiana Krott sits in München-Sendling, right by the Brudermühlstraße U-Bahn station. The practice lists acupuncture and bioresonance among its methods and adds homeopathy for children, fascia massage and deep relaxation massage. Appointments can be booked online through the practice website, and the team takes time with each visitor.

listings.name: Präventive Humanmedizin und Gefäßchirurgie
listings.description: In Starnberg, Dr. med. Jörg Fuchs is a physician, a general and vascular surgeon who also works in preventive medicine. Alongside that work he offers a bioresonance wellness check, a longevity consultation, resilience training, stress management and coaching. Opening hours are posted. Call ahead to confirm which of these sessions are currently available.

listings.name: Praxis für klassische Homöopathie Angela Habigt
listings.description: Angela Habigt runs a practice for classical homeopathy in Sontheim. She also offers bioresonance and ear acupuncture for children, adults and seniors, adapted to individual needs, with the aim of supporting the body's own regulation.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Sigrid Maria Regner
listings.description: Sigrid Maria Regner runs a naturopathic practice in Dentlein am Forst. She trained as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in 2014 and offers bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, with Rayonex training dating from 2016. Other offers include Paracelsus-based and Hildegard von Bingen naturopathy, meridian work and acupressure, foot reflexology, Brain Gym, family constellations and energy work, plus therapeutic massage for women. Alongside naturopathy she works as an astrologer, with psychological astrology, horoscopes and life coaching. Seminars and a newsletter are available, and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Praxis letloveshine
listings.description: Praxis letloveshine is a naturopathic practice in Walting, Upper Bavaria. It offers bioresonance and energetic sessions, including aura work. Walting lies in the Altmühl valley in the Eichstätt district, and the practice is categorised as a naturopathic practitioner. Contact the practice to ask how a session is organised.

listings.name: Therapieraum Kasendorf
listings.description: Therapieraum Kasendorf is a naturopathic practice in Kasendorf. Its methods include Matrix Rhythm Therapy, bioresonance, heart rate variability (HRV) sessions, cupping and ear acupuncture, and the practice says it adapts its approach to each person. The practice has wheelchair-accessible parking, a restroom, and recommends booking an appointment. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are available and how to arrange a visit.

listings.name: Traumasensibles Coaching - Joachim Gericke
listings.description: Joachim Gericke offers trauma-sensitive coaching in München, based on the approach of Spiritual and Somatic Trauma Therapy. His range includes individual sessions, couples counselling, 'Von Trauma zu Liebe' constellation days and TimeWaver applications, which he uses to look at life themes on different levels in the information field. The focus is on finding a truthful path in life and in partnership. Appointments can be arranged through the contact page.

listings.name: Ulrich Galas, Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Ulrich Galas is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a practice at Mozartstr. 6 in Königsbrunn. The list of offers includes bioresonance therapy, Bach flower therapy, ear acupuncture, foot reflexology massage, spinal work after Dorn, nutrition counselling, EFT tapping and meditation. He is also listed with osteopathy and hypnosis training among his areas of work. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are offered and how to book.

listings.name: Vitalpraxis Andreas Fiederle
listings.description: Vitalpraxis Andreas Fiederle in München is led by Andreas Fiederle, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who works with information-based methods. His sessions use targeted frequency work, bioresonance, the NLS System (Hunter 4025 by Metatron), vital nutrient guidance and vital mushrooms, and he also reads faces and holds a FACS coder certificate. Appointments are by arrangement only, Monday to Wednesday 9:00 to 18:00, Thursday 10:00 to 20:00 and Friday 11:00 to 16:00. Between visits, guidance by phone is possible.

listings.name: von Taube health consulting
listings.description: von Taube health consulting in Bad Wiessee is the practice of Julia von Taube, listing bioresonance, radionics, Ayurveda, geopathology, micronutrient analysis, nutrition advice, vital mushrooms and colloids among its offers. Opening hours are posted, appointments are recommended and parking is wheelchair accessible. Call to confirm which sessions are available.

listings.name: Arztpraxis für Innere Medizin - Dipl. med. Marion Kleinert - TCM & Bioresonanz & Time Waver
listings.description: Arztpraxis für Innere Medizin, led by Dipl. med. Marion Kleinert, is a physician's practice for internal medicine in Kolbermoor. Rated 4.2 from 15 Google reviews, 12 of them five stars and 3 one star. Parking and entrance are wheelchair accessible. Call ahead to confirm whether it offers bioresonance or biofeedback sessions and which devices it uses.

listings.name: Eva Gerhard Gesundheits- und Mikronährstoffberatung, Bioresonanz
listings.description: Eva Gerhard in Augsburg is categorised as a beauty salon, and the business name points to health and micronutrient counselling and bioresonance. Opening hours are posted and appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are offered and how they work.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde, Naturheilverf., Bioresonanz, Allergiebehandlung
listings.description: Listed under alternative medicine practitioners in München, this practice carries a name that points to natural health methods and bioresonance. It holds a single Google review, a one-star rating, and shows no opening times. That is too little to say how the practice works or what a session involves. Phone ahead to confirm the services offered and whether the practice is currently seeing clients.

listings.name: Bioresonanz
listings.description: Bioresonanz is a business in Untergriesbach, a municipality in the Passau district of Lower Bavaria, close to the Austrian border. Call ahead to ask which services and equipment it uses before booking an appointment. Passau, the nearest city, is a short drive away.

listings.name: Bioresonanz Holzkirchen
listings.description: Bioresonanz Holzkirchen is an alternative medicine practitioner in Holzkirchen, with a restroom on site. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are offered, the opening times and how to arrange an appointment. Wheelchair-accessible parking is available.

listings.name: Bioresonanztherapie
listings.description: The practice listed as Bioresonanztherapie in München falls under alternative practitioners, a category that covers independent natural health providers. Its Maps entry gives no rating yet and no opening times, and it carries little else beyond the name and the city. Before planning a visit, call to confirm which sessions are offered, which devices are used and whether appointments are currently being taken.

listings.name: Lisas Wellnessmassagen, Bioresonanz & Klangstein
listings.description: Lisas Wellnessmassagen in Neuötting is a wellness centre offering massages in a relaxed atmosphere, with over 10 years of experience behind it. Appointments can be booked online. It has no posted opening hours, so call ahead to confirm availability.

listings.name: Praxis für Bioresonanztherapie & Naturheilkunde
listings.description: Praxis für Bioresonanztherapie & Naturheilkunde is a naturopathic practitioner in Karlsfeld, north of München. The practice has wheelchair-accessible parking and a restroom. Opening hours are not posted, so call ahead to confirm which sessions it offers, what a first visit involves and how to book an appointment.

listings.name: TimeWaver München
listings.description: TimeWaver München is a business in München under the Maps category Therapists, with a name that refers to the TimeWaver information field system. Its entry carries no rating yet and no posted hours, and it offers no further description. To learn what a session involves, whether TimeWaver is actually used and how to book, contact the practitioner directly by phone before visiting.

listings.name: TimeWaver TreeEvolution München
listings.description: TimeWaver TreeEvolution München is a life coaching business based in München, and its name points to TimeWaver and TreeEvolution. Its entry shows no rating or posted hours. Because there is little else to go on, contact the coach by phone to ask which services and devices are part of a session, and how to arrange a first appointment.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Ayurveda - Carmen Ploch, Heilpraktikerin Bioresonanz, Massage & HeadSpa
listings.description: Based in Kalkar with a second location in Oberhausen, Carmen Ploch has worked since 2002 as a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) focused on hormone balance counselling and women's health. Her range includes Ayurveda massage and courses, head spa, acupuncture and bioresonance sessions in both towns. Where travel to a bioresonance appointment is not possible, she offers a way to take part from home, and a free phone call can be booked before the first bioresonance appointment. Rated 5.0 from 105 Google reviews, 103 of them five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Carmen Ploch Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Carmen Ploch is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who has worked in naturopathy since 2008, with practices in Oberhausen and Kalkar near Kleve. Focus areas are Ayurveda therapy, Ayurveda massage, homeopathy, acupuncture, women's hormone balance and bioresonance, with hair analysis available too. A free phone call is offered before booking bioresonance in Oberhausen or Kalkar, and HeadSpa sessions are also on the list. Rated 4.9 from 99 Google reviews, 94 of them five stars.

listings.name: HNO-Praxis Georg Wünstel
listings.description: HNO-Praxis Georg Wünstel is an ear, nose and throat practice in Münster that also offers complementary sessions, including acupuncture, bioresonance and homeopathy, next to its conventional services. Rated 4.4 from 163 Google reviews, 131 of them five stars and 18 one star. Call ahead to ask how bioresonance sessions are booked.

listings.name: Abnehmzentrum Wuppertal Elberfeld
listings.description: Abnehmzentrum Wuppertal Elberfeld is a weight management centre in Wuppertal built on traditional Chinese medicine, serving the Bergisches Städtedreieck of Wuppertal, Solingen and Remscheid. The programme uses acupuncture, ear acupuncture, Chi Nei Tsang massage, magnetic field therapy, moxa and five-element nutrition, together with bioresonance sessions. A free consultation is offered. Rated 5.0 from 78 Google reviews, 77 of them five stars and one three stars.

listings.name: Physiotherapie Malamas
listings.description: Physiotherapie Malamas in Gladbeck combines physiotherapy, chiropractic and naturopathy. Services include chiropractic, classic physiotherapy, manual lymph drainage, connective tissue massage and foot reflexology, and the Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) side adds acupuncture, homeopathy and bioresonance. Rated 4.8 from 88 Google reviews, 84 of them five stars.

listings.name: Amerikanische Chiropraktik Lehrke & Stromberg ein Teil von Helix Vital
listings.description: Helix Vital is an alternative wellness centre with locations in Langenfeld and Krefeld, working under the name Amerikanische Chiropraktik Lehrke & Stromberg. It offers American chiropractic, neurofeedback training, Japanese acupuncture, massage, epigenetic coaching and BICOM bioresonance therapy in Langenfeld. The team says it helps clients pursue personal goals and proactive wellbeing. Rated 5.0 from 68 Google reviews, 67 of them five stars and 1 three star.

listings.name: Praxis Reem Kassem Fachärztin für Innere Medizin
listings.description: Reem Kassem is a physician specialising in internal medicine, with a practice in Erkrath-Hochdahl that also offers bioresonance sessions and acupuncture, alongside general practice care for local residents. Opening hours are posted and consultation times are updated regularly. Rated 4.6 from 95 Google reviews, 83 of them five stars and 9 one star. Call to confirm availability for bioresonance sessions.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Heike Dammann
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Heike Dammann in Ahaus is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice with a wide method range: acupuncture and ear acupuncture, Bach flowers, homeopathy, high-frequency and magnetic field therapy, bioresonance, pulsating Pneumatron therapy, Dorn therapy, relaxation, meditation, hypnosis and coaching. Heike Dammann has further training in BICOM bioresonance and also works with children. Appointments are required, and card and mobile payment are accepted. Women-owned, with a wheelchair-accessible entrance. Rated 5.0 from 58 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Kranz & Freund
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Kranz & Freund is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Kroppach in the Westerwald, serving Hachenburg, Altenkirchen, Bad Marienberg, Montabaur and the surrounding region. Bioresonance after Paul Schmidt is one of its main offers, next to nutrition counselling, weight management advice, orthomolecular advice and movement-related sessions. The team takes time for a detailed first conversation and an individual plan. Rated 5.0 from 55 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended, and cards and mobile payment are accepted.

listings.name: Osteopathie Praxis Ratingen
listings.description: Osteopathie Praxis Ratingen specialises in children's osteopathy, sports osteopathy and osteopathy for the whole body, and also offers bioresonance after Paul Schmidt. Rated 4.9 from 50 Google reviews, 46 of them five stars. Parking, entrance and restroom are wheelchair accessible, and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Anke Jacubasch Ästhetik & Heilkunde
listings.description: Anke Jacubasch Ästhetik & Heilkunde in Bonn is an alternative practice that includes bioresonance among its offers, alongside osteopathy, acupuncture, nutrition counselling, foot reflexology and back and abdominal massage. It also provides skin care with Dr. Hauschka cosmetics. Rated 5.0 from 44 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Appointments are required, there is a free parking lot, and the entrance and restroom are wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Ganzheitliche Beratung für Mensch und Tier
listings.description: Heike Gerull offers holistic consultations for people and animals in the Kreis Unna and the Hochsauerlandkreis. She is a Tierheilpraktikerin (animal alternative practitioner), dog physiotherapist and dog trainer, and her range includes bioresonance for animals using devices such as the Metronom Solar and the Medisend from AMS. She also works with laser therapy, Matrix rhythm therapy, Reiki, Bach flowers, Schüssler salts and nutrition advice. Energetic support is available online on request. Rated 5.0 from 39 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Hausärztliche Praxis Aachen Dr. med. Stefanie Fröschen-Behrens und Dr. med. Astrid S. Häfner
listings.description: This family practice in Aachen is run by the physicians Dr. Stefanie Fröschen-Behrens and Dr. Astrid S. Häfner and also offers naturopathy, including bioresonance sessions. The practice describes bioresonance as a gentle method that uses the person's own electromagnetic oscillations. It serves Aachen and Stolberg, offers home visits, and has a wheelchair-accessible entrance. Rated 4.1 from 75 Google reviews, 55 of them five stars and 16 one star.

listings.name: ThetaHealing & Naturheilpraxis Sandra Gallagher Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: ThetaHealing & Naturheilpraxis Sandra Gallagher is a practice in Krefeld-Hüls, open since May 2022. Sandra Gallagher is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and a ThetaHealing coach and teacher. Her sessions draw on homeopathy, bioresonance with frequency work, spagyrics and a nutrition and metabolism programme, while the ThetaHealing side covers coaching and a series of seminars and training courses. Rated 4.9 from 30 Google reviews, 29 of them five stars. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Therapiezentrum für ganzheitliche Naturheilkunde
listings.description: The Therapiezentrum für ganzheitliche Naturheilkunde in Krefeld is a naturopathic practice led by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with long experience. It describes a functional and regulatory approach, and the offers named include bioresonance, nutrition, weight management, metabolism and prevention. Appointments are required, and a free car park is on site with wheelchair-accessible parking and entrance. Rated 4.3 from 40 Google reviews, 31 of them five stars and 5 one star.

listings.name: Dr. med. dent. Anne Karl - Biologische Zahnmedizin Zahnarzt Köln
listings.description: Dr. med. dent. Anne Karl is a dentist in Cologne who practises biological and integral dentistry. Her listed services include bioresonance and ear acupuncture alongside her dental work, and she describes an approach that looks at the whole person. Rated 4.5 from 33 Google reviews, 28 of them five stars and 2 one star. Opening hours are posted and appointments are required.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Heike Jülkenbeck
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Heike Jülkenbeck is a naturopathic practice in Unna-Königsborn. Bioresonance sessions are done with the MORA Nova system from Med-Tronik, including Psychobiophonie sessions. The practice also offers homeopathy, herbal medicine, chiropractic, massage, cupping, magnetic field therapy, acupuncture and nutrition counselling. Rated 4.8 from 25 Google reviews, 23 of them five stars. The MORA devices come from Med-Tronik GmbH, a company with more than 40 years of research behind its equipment. Unna lies in the Ruhr region of North Rhine-Westphalia.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Christine Erlhöfer
listings.description: Christine Erlhöfer is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Gummersbach-Dieringhausen who centres her practice on bioresonance after Paul Schmidt. She tailors each plan and combines it with gut-friendly nutrition, micronutrients, mycotherapy, breathwork, aromatherapy, homeopathy and acupressure. Individually set bioresonance loan devices can be used at home between visits. Rated 4.9 from 22 Google reviews, 21 of them five stars. Her pages list further training and client experience reports, and phytotherapy and orthomolecular nutrition also feature. Online appointment reservation is available.

listings.name: Frau Dr. Eva Kalman
listings.description: Frau Dr. Eva Kalman runs a dermatology practice in Düsseldorf that also lists bioresonance among its services. Appointments are required and can be booked online. Rated 3.6 from 69 Google reviews, 43 of them five stars and 21 of them one star.

listings.name: Meliha Gök, gynecologist
listings.description: Meliha Gök is a physician specialising in gynecology and obstetrics in Moers, who also offers BICOM bioresonance sessions. Her range includes hypnosis sessions, consciousness coaching and constellation work, together with work on minerals and vitamins. A free 40-minute introductory meeting can be arranged by phone or online. Her practice describes a view of body, soul and mind working together. Rated 3.7 from 57 Google reviews, 38 of them five stars and 16 one star. The entrance, parking and restroom are wheelchair accessible, and parking is paid.

listings.name: Gesundheitsstudio Hör auf dein Herz
listings.description: Gesundheitsstudio Hör auf dein Herz in Löhne is run by a health counselor and offers HRV (heart rate variability) measurement, bioresonance and iLifeSOMM sessions for deep relaxation and energy build-up. Rated 4.9 from 19 Google reviews, 18 of them five stars. Appointments are required, and the studio has on-site parking including wheelchair-accessible spaces.

listings.name: Nicole Schmidt
listings.description: Nicole Schmidt in Hagen is a certified animal practitioner (Tierheilpraktikerin) who works with dogs, cats and horses. Her range covers nutrition advice for dogs and cats, bioresonance therapy, a Bicom Bodybalance Check, craniosacral therapy, biophoton and laser therapy, laser acupuncture, and seminars for animal owners. Rated 5.0 from 17 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Dr. med. Tanja Görner
listings.description: Dr. med. Tanja Görner is a physician (general practitioner) in Sankt Augustin who pairs conventional general practice with acupuncture, homeopathy and bioresonance sessions. Rated 4.3 from 26 Google reviews, 21 of them five stars. The practice has wheelchair-accessible parking and entrance.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Vera Hoen
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Vera Hoen in Asbach is the practice of a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her range includes synergetic homeopathy, phytotherapy, acupuncture, bioresonance, mental coaching after the Metikom method, breathwork sessions, energetic work, forest bathing and stillness seminars, plus monthly changing workshops. Opening hours are posted and appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 14 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Bernadette von Westphalen, Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Bernadette von Westphalen runs a naturopathic practice in Cologne's old town as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). She uses a BICOM Optima bioresonance device in her sessions and trained as a BICOM therapist. The range also includes acupuncture, traditional Chinese methods, stress regulation and immune system support. Appointments can be booked online or by phone, and the practice has a step-free entrance. Opening hours are posted. Rated 4.8 from 15 Google reviews, 13 of them five stars, and holds five stars on Jameda.

listings.name: Birgit Muhr, Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Birgit Muhr is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and animal Heilpraktiker in Dortmund. Her naturopathy practice offers bioresonance sessions for people and for dogs. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all five stars. Free parking and a step-free entrance are available. Appointments are required, so call ahead to book.

listings.name: Ens-Naturheilpraxis Anuk C. Ens, Essen
listings.description: Ens-Naturheilpraxis in Essen is led by Anuk C. Ens, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and member of the Verband Freier Heilpraktiker and the National Guild of Hypnotists. Bioresonance sessions use the BICOM device by Regumed, and a Body Balance Check is part of the range. Hypnosis, including for teenagers, is a second main focus, along with acupuncture, Dorn-Breuss back method, cupping, talk sessions and coaching. Courses and seminars are also offered. Appointments can be booked by phone or online, and online consultation hours are available. Rated 4.7 from 15 Google reviews, 14 of them five stars.

listings.name: Ärztliche Praxis mit naturheilkundlichem Schwerpunkt / Berthold Wehner, Arzt, Arzt f. Akupunktur.
listings.description: This Cologne practice has been run by physicians since 1993, with Berthold Wehner named as physician and acupuncture specialist. It offers a family-doctor service alongside a naturopathic approach, spread over 200 square metres on two floors in the city centre. The range of wellness offers includes a bioresonance method, acupuncture, traditional Chinese methods, homeopathy, nutrition counselling, health coaching and relaxation techniques. Rated 4.9 from 13 Google reviews, 12 of them five stars. Opening hours are posted and the entrance is step-free.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Dagmar Epe
listings.description: Heilpraxis Dagmar Epe in Attendorn is the practice of a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) focused on stress support, nutrition and lifestyle counselling. Sessions include bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, singing bowl massage, sound and vibration work, ear acupressure and energy work, and energy work and Akasha chronicle readings can also be booked online by Zoom. Appointments are required, and the practice has wheelchair-accessible parking, seating and restroom. Women-owned, and a personal conversation to plan your sessions is part of how she works. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Kordula Döring
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Kordula Döring in Bad Salzuflen is the practice of Kordula Döring, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who works across body, mind and spirit. Offers include traditional Chinese methods, eye acupuncture after Dr. Boel, Shiatsu, bioresonance sessions with electrodes, the Vegatest method, constellation work, and the harmonising of houses and places. Sessions can also be held online by video or phone. Appointments are required, opening hours are posted, and parking and entrance are wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Stefanie Floegel Praxis für ganzheitliche Medizin und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung
listings.description: Stefanie Floegel combines a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and psychotherapy practice in Bottrop, with work for adults, couples and companies. Methods named include bioresonance, psychotherapy, couples therapy, nutrition counselling, body psychotherapy, trauma work in the Somatic Experiencing approach and coaching. She also works with babies and young children as a Kinderheilpraktikerin, and offers walk-and-talk sessions, group sessions, mediation and executive coaching. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Atem- und Psychotherapie Köln - Gabriele Callegari - Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Gabriele Callegari is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Cologne. Her practice focuses on breathwork and breath training, energy work, support during pregnancy and bioresonance sessions. The practice is run by a woman owner, works by appointment and posts its opening hours. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Dieter Hermann Lucas
listings.description: Dieter Hermann Lucas runs a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Kaarst, with 18 years of experience as a Heilpraktiker and 12 years as a nurse on intensive-care wards. The practice is built around SCIO bioresonance sessions, along with an energy scan and energy session, psychokinesiology, psychosomatic energetics, personality development and metabolic typing. Appointments are required, and parking is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all at five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Niederrhein
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Niederrhein in Kempen is a naturopathic practice that lists frequency therapy, bioresonance therapy, vital field therapy, osteopathy and acupuncture. Its Maps categories include naturopathic practitioner and osteopath. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended, and the entrance is wheelchair accessible. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are on offer.

listings.name: Ralf Nusch und Birgit Nusch Heilpraktiker Phyto- Oberon- Schmerz- Bioresonanz- wie auch Hypnose Therapie
listings.description: Ralf and Birgit Nusch are Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioners) in Elsdorf who run Panchasana, a centre for modern Tibetan medicine. The approach pairs traditional pulse assessment with technical methods that include Oberon, and it uses more than 350 medicinal herbs in individually compiled formulas. Hypnotherapy is also offered. Consultations can be requested online, and an English version is available. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required, and the premises have wheelchair-accessible parking, entrance, seating and restroom.

listings.name: Annika Gersonde, Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Annika Gersonde is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a naturopathic practice at Krautstraße 11 in Solingen, easy to reach by public transport. Bioresonance therapy and osteopathy, including osteopathy for children, are the main offers. She trained in bioresonance, osteopathy and chiropractic at several schools. Appointments are best confirmed by phone. Her training includes osteopathy, chiropractic, analytical kinesiology and phytotherapy. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Frau Dr. med. Gabriele Weßling
listings.description: Dr. med. Gabriele Weßling runs a private practice in Bonn for naturopathic methods, built around bioresonance and Jin Shin Jyutsu. She is a physician specialising in general medicine. She has practised Jin Shin Jyutsu since 2007, trained as a bioresonance therapist after Paul Schmidt in 2008 and opened her own practice in 2010. Sessions start with a detailed conversation about your background and can include bioresonance, which she describes as working without electric current flowing through the body. She works with a Rayonex device, and the practice has recently added the Rayoscan from the same company. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis natürlich gesund Barbara Korthum-Mager -Heilpraktikerin-
listings.description: Barbara Korthum-Mager runs Naturheilpraxis natürlich gesund in Aachen, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice built around Bicom bioresonance, in which she has about 14 years of experience. Homeopathy, Bach flowers and Schüssler salts are offered alongside, for adults, children and babies. Appointments are recommended and the entrance is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Alternativmedizin - Julia Dickel
listings.description: Praxis für Alternativmedizin is the Freudenberg-Hohenhain practice of Julia Dickel, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Bioresonance sessions use the BICOM Optima system, and she describes the method as gentle and free of drugs or invasive steps. Other offers include interval altitude training, lymphatic drainage, body shaping and children's naturopathy. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required and can be booked online.

listings.name: Waldpraxis Lohmann
listings.description: Waldpraxis Lohmann is a naturopathic practice in Wilnsdorf, serving the Siegen and Siegerland area. Katrin Lohmann works as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and offers bioresonance sessions, back work after Dorn, vital mushroom guidance, Regenaplex and pulsation massage with the Pneumatron. Appointments are by arrangement and can be booked online. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin & Physiotherapeutin in Köln - Patricia Stein
listings.description: Patricia Stein has worked for over 20 years in Cologne as a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and physiotherapist. Her practice focuses on manual therapy, lymph drainage, bioresonance and acupuncture. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all five stars. The practice welcomes LGBTQ clients, works by appointment and posts its opening hours.

listings.name: Helix Vital Krefeld
listings.description: Helix Vital runs centres in Krefeld and Langenfeld for alternative approaches to performance and wellbeing. The range includes American chiropractic, neurofeedback training, Japanese acupuncture, massage, bioresonance and epigenetic coaching, plus an online course. BICOM bioresonance is offered at the Langenfeld location. Each location takes appointments through its own booking page, and a team is introduced for both Langenfeld and Krefeld. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Life Balance Naturheilpraxis Jutta Böhnert
listings.description: Life Balance is the naturopathic practice of Jutta Böhnert, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Krefeld-Verberg. She works with a whole-person approach aimed at wellbeing and balance, covering women's health and menopause, men's health and stress management. Bioresonance is among her methods, adapted to each person's situation. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all five stars. Free parking is available. Call ahead to book an appointment.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Barbara Dumke
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Barbara Dumke in Witten is the practice of Barbara Dumke, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). She offers bioresonance with electro-acupuncture after Dr. Voll, NLS sessions with the Oberon system and HRV analysis, together with osteopathy, nutrition counselling, homeopathy, neural therapy and cupping. Iris and face analysis and dark field microscopy complete the picture. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Bochum Christina Pillath
listings.description: Christina Pillath runs a Naturheilpraxis in Bochum Wattenscheid as a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her most common offers are classical homeopathy, bioresonance sessions, Dorn-Breuss gentle spine work, nutrition counselling and holistic animal therapy. She describes her aim as bringing body, mind and soul back into balance. Rated 4.6 from 10 Google reviews, 9 of them five stars. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Christine Weigel-Sydekum
listings.description: Christine Weigel-Sydekum runs a naturopathic practice in Siegen, with sister locations in Kreuztal and Olpe. Her main offers are chiropractic work and bioresonance therapy, alongside acupuncture and electro-acupuncture, mineral therapy and nutrition counselling. Visits are by prior appointment. The practice is run as a Naturheilpraxis with a few main areas. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to confirm opening times.

listings.name: medvital360 Naturheilpraxis & Diagnostik
listings.description: medvital360 Naturheilpraxis in Solingen is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice that combines naturopathic methods with technology such as bioresonance, IHHT training and HRV stress analysis. Health check-ups, gut microbiome analyses, chiropractic and craniosacral therapy are also on offer. The focus is on prevention and personal support toward more wellbeing. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis an der Volme - Heilpraktikerin Claudia Raderschatt (vorherRobbenmenke)
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis an der Volme in Hagen is the practice of Heilpraktikerin Claudia Raderschatt (state-licensed alternative practitioner), formerly Robbenmenke. Its focus areas include homeopathy, Dorn-Breuss therapy, ear acupuncture and bioresonance therapy, with paediatric care also named. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required, so call ahead to confirm what a session involves.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Sandra Debinski
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Sandra Debinski in Bonn is led by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who has practised since 2012. The work centres on balance and wellbeing on a physical, mental and emotional level. It combines plant medicine, complex homeopathy and frequency work with a bioresonance device after Paul Schmidt, which forms one part of the sessions. The practice is a protected space for quiet and personal development, with each session adapted to the individual. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all five stars. Fees are listed on the practice pages.

listings.name: Peter Hendler / Naturheilpraxis und Hypnose
listings.description: Peter Hendler is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Emmerich with more than 35 years of experience. His practice centres on hypnosis and Yager code sessions and also offers acupuncture, bioresonance and homeopathy, plus orthomolecular guidance on cell wellbeing. He presents himself as a certified hypnosis therapist. A short video introduces him, and he can be reached by email or phone. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Dr. med. Claudia Schönenstein
listings.description: Dr. med. Claudia Schönenstein is a physician in Witten with a naturopathy-oriented practice. The methods offered are hypnosis (OMNI certified), bioresonance therapy, acupuncture, laser light therapy and MediTaping. Rated 4.4 from 11 Google reviews, 8 of them five stars. Call ahead to confirm availability and how to book.

listings.name: Holisticly
listings.description: Holisticly in Kamen is the practice of Sven Haumann, who works as a Feng Shui consultant, breathing technique teacher and SCIO and bioresonance practitioner. Alongside SCIO biofeedback sessions he offers Feng Shui consultations, numerology and Chinese astrology readings, and breathing coaching. Online courses and webinars round out the range. Rated 4.9 from 8 Google reviews, 7 of them five stars.

listings.name: Harmonie für Mensch und Tier
listings.description: Harmonie für Mensch und Tier in Greven is an animal practice that takes a whole-animal view and works with bioresonance, including support for older animals. Appointments are recommended and card and mobile payment are accepted. Rated 4.6 from 9 Google reviews, 8 of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Minden
listings.description: Gabriele Franke-Schwerdt runs a naturopathic practice in Minden as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Sessions include bioresonance therapy with a body check and HRV measurement, plus kinesiology and tensor assessments. Further pages cover women's health and fertility support. Online appointment booking is available. Rated 4.6 from 9 Google reviews, 8 of them five stars. The practice is owned by women, has a hearing loop and offers free street and lot parking.

listings.name: Kräuter-Oile Tanja Burmann
listings.description: Kräuter-Oile is the practice of Tanja Burmann in Finnentrop, in the Sauerland. She works as an aromatherapist and independent dôTERRA wellness coach and offers wellness sessions with bioresonance, a field she has followed for more than 15 years. Alongside this she gives relaxation sessions based on essential oils, cold applications with Alpha Cooling Professional and a newer oxygen application. The practice takes appointments, has free parking and wheelchair accessible parking, and posts opening hours. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Martina Pohlmann
listings.description: Martina Pohlmann has been a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) since 1988 and opened her own practice in Nordhorn in 1992, after working as a nurse. Her biophysical methods include Ondamed, Bicom bioresonance, field therapy and SonoVital, which she describes as computer-controlled vibration methods. She also works with homeopathy, kinesiological testing and the Strukturogramm, gives seminars and talks, and sees people from infants to older adults. Rated 4.5 from 8 Google reviews, 7 of them five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Osteopathie und Naturheilkunde Michaela Berger Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Michaela Berger is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) running an osteopathy and naturopathy practice in Gevelsberg. She offers osteopathy for adults and children, acupuncture, bioresonance therapy, the Activator technique and foot reflexology. Online consultations can be booked through Doctolib for people who prefer to be supported from home. Appointments are by arrangement only. Rated 4.5 from 8 Google reviews, 7 of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Alexandra Olbermann
listings.description: Alexandra Olbermann is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Gummersbach-Dieringhausen, welcoming clients from Gummersbach, Lindlar and the Oberberg district. Her focus is energy, sleep routines, stress regulation, hormonal balance and gut wellbeing. Methods include bioresonance, homeopathy, spagyrics, mycotherapy and orthomolecular nutrition. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Kerstin Sedana Donner Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Kerstin Sedana Donner is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a naturopathy practice listed in Brüggen and also named after Nettetal. Her listing names BICOM bioresonance, foot reflexology and Touch for Health, and describes her work as guided by trust in nature. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to confirm hours and how sessions are arranged.

listings.name: Martin K. Michalowski, Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Martin K. Michalowski is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and osteopath in Neukirchen-Vluyn. His sessions combine Biokinematic therapy, osteopathy, chiropractic, Liebscher and Bracht techniques and bioresonance, and he also offers conflict management, stress management, nutrition counselling and massage. He is also listed as an osteopath. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required, and parking is free and wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Handan Grosser
listings.description: Handan Grosser has worked as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) since 2016 and runs a naturopathic practice in Lindlar. Her methods include classical homeopathy, Traditional Chinese Medicine, acupuncture, taping and bioresonance with BICOM devices from Regumed. Women's health and fertility support are special interests, and she holds certificates as menopause expert and fertility expert. Sessions are by appointment only, with no open consultation hours, and phone times run Monday to Friday from 10 to 18. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Vital-Praxis, Inh. Christine Diecks
listings.description: Vital-Praxis by Christine Diecks is a small naturopathic practice inside the Strandhof Möhnesee building, which also lets holiday apartments by the lake. It focuses on craniosacral therapy and bioresonance therapy, and also offers Dorn and Breuss work, visceral therapy, foot reflexology and quantum analysis. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars. Wheelchair-accessible parking is available. Phone and email contact are listed for appointments.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Berker-Josteit
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Berker-Josteit in Halver is led by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who has offered a home-visit service since 1 April 2023, with visits also possible by arrangement. The range includes bioresonance, homeopathy, acupuncture, autogenic training and nutrition advice. In the bioresonance sessions a tensor and a bioresonance device are used to work with the body's vibrations. Appointments are required, and the practice has wheelchair-accessible parking, seating and restroom. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Sandra Ronge
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Sandra Ronge in Asbach offers hypnosis therapy, Gestalt therapy, bioresonance, acupuncture and homeopathy. Appointments are required. Parking is free and card or mobile payment is accepted. Women-owned. Rated 5.0 from five Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Klaus Hans
listings.description: Klaus Hans is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Menden offering bioresonance therapy and radionics, a form of energy-based work. Appointments are recommended and hours are not posted, so call ahead to arrange a visit. Rated 4.3 from 6 Google reviews, 5 of them five stars.

listings.name: Andrea Hatlé, Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Andrea Hatlé is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Leichlingen, with over 20 years in practice. She offers bioresonance therapy, gentle osteopathic techniques, foot reflexology and Dorn massage, together with spagyric preparations and Bach flowers, aiming to bring body, soul and mind into balance. Each client is approached individually. Appointments are by arrangement, by message or phone. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Christina Ivonne Bieber
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Bieber in Essen-Kupferdreh is run by Christina Ivonne Bieber, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). The practice offers bioresonance alongside acupuncture, laser therapy and complex homeopathy. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars. The entrance is wheelchair accessible and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Erpel Silvia Gehrig
listings.description: Silvia Gehrig is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Erpel in the Rhein-Sieg-Kreis. Her practice offers bioresonance sessions and also traditional manual therapy, Reiki, energy work and coaching, systemic constellations, homeopathy, plant-based approaches and aromatherapy. A first-appointment page explains how to start, and she serves clients from Bad Honnef, Königswinter, Linz am Rhein, Bonn, Remagen and Unkel. Appointments can be requested by phone or email. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Kathrin Muschiol
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Kathrin Muschiol is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Willich, located in the Casinostahlwerk. Kathrin Muschiol began in 2017 as an animal practitioner for dogs, cats and horses and later added work with people. Her core methods are bioresonance sessions, acupuncture, ear acupuncture and moxa therapy, alongside gut health guidance, women's health topics and micronutrient counselling. Appointments are by arrangement. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: NATURLIA Praxis für Naturheilkunde und Frauenheilkunde
listings.description: NATURLIA in Hille is a practice for naturopathy and women's health. It offers bioresonance therapy, acupuncture after Boel, gut therapy, cupping and plant-based therapy. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all at five stars. Parking is wheelchair accessible. Call ahead to confirm opening times.

listings.name: Anke Doll Osteopathie
listings.description: Anke Doll is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who works in a shared practice in Cologne's Lindenthal district. She has offered osteopathy since 2015 and added bioresonance in 2020. Sessions include a conversation about lifestyle, nutrition tips and individual exercises. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Annette Koch, Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Annette Koch is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Essen working with a mind and body approach. Sessions use TimeWaver information-field technology and Healy microcurrent frequency technology, and the practice also draws on homeopathy, naturopathy and spiritual work after Horst Krohne. Psychoenergetic work with TimeWaver is paired with body-oriented methods, and the themes include relationship and parenting questions. The practice is women-owned and can be reached by phone or email. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars. Opening hours are posted and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Bioresonanz- practice
listings.description: Bioresonanz-practice in Arnsberg is run by Tatyana Papenkort, born 1972, who is certified in bioresonance after the Paul Schmidt method and has been a member of the Vereinigung zur Förderung der Schwingungsmedizin since 2016. The first appointment includes an analysis with the Rayoscan, which uses an ECG method, and a personal plan followed by a bioresonance session, and takes about one and a half to two hours. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from three Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to confirm opening times.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Ratingen - Ninetta Döhring - Naturheilpraxis für Bioresonanz und Naturheilkunde
listings.description: Ninetta Döhring runs a naturopathic practice in Ratingen-Tiefenbroich at Gerhart-Hauptmann-Str. 2 as a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Bioresonance and Vitalfeldtherapie are offered as complementary methods, and the BICOM device is used with electrodes, without needles. She has taken BICOM workshops and user days in Cologne, Dortmund and Kempen. The practice also offers nutrition and micronutrient advice, Pneumatron sessions, massage, Dorn Breuss, foot reflexology and classical homeopathy. A free first phone call of about 15 minutes is offered. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Herr Martin Bojé
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis am Zoo is the Wuppertal practice of Martin Bojé, working in naturopathy for more than 30 years. The methods include chiropractic, cupping and massage, homeopathy, Bach flowers, cold light laser and high-frequency energy, together with two versions of bioresonance, called Bioresonanz 1.0 and 2.0, plus physioenergetics and kinesiology. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars. Call to confirm how to book.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Friedrich Koller Naturheilpraktiker & Alternative Heilverfahren
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Friedrich Koller in Raesfeld, Westphalia, is run by Friedrich Koller, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and graduate biologist. He continues the tradition of his mother's practice with homeopathy, herbal knowledge and bioresonance, and has added systemic family constellation work and shamanic practice. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Heilpraktikerin Irina Lemke
listings.description: Irina Lemke is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Ahaus. Her practice offers aromatherapy, acupuncture, energetic massages, phytotherapy, nutrition therapy and bioresonance sessions, and she also uses pulse analysis when planning an individual approach. Appointments are made by phone or email, and she asks clients about their background and can draw on reports they bring along. Parking is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from three Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Tanja Rohde
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Tanja Rohde in Neuss combines several naturopathic methods in individual sessions: Cranio-Sacrale Balance, Dorn therapy, fascia work, kinesiology and bioresonance, with a particular focus on the musculoskeletal system. The practice also runs courses in movement learning after Roland Pausch and further training in Cranio-Sacrale Balance. Rated 5.0 from three Google reviews, all five stars. Parking is free nearby, and the practice has a hearing loop and wheelchair-accessible seating.

listings.name: siete gelsenkirchen
listings.description: Siete is a wellness centre in Gelsenkirchen whose Maps entry lists cosmetics, make-up, massage, osteopathy, nutrition counselling and bioresonance, with a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) on the team. The entrance is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars. Opening hours are not posted, so call ahead.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Elke Picker
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Elke Picker in Hamm lists bioresonance sessions among its natural therapy options, from homeopathy to Dorn and Breuss spinal therapy. The practitioner works with body, mind and spirit as a whole and describes a holistic view of each person. Appointments are recommended, and the entrance, parking and restroom are wheelchair accessible. Rated 4.0 from 3 Google reviews, two at five stars and one at two stars.

listings.name: Anthropos - Praxis für ganzheitliche Gesundheitsberatung
listings.description: Anthropos is a practice for holistic wellbeing advice on Bismarckstraße in Düsseldorf, combining psychological counselling, bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, micronutrient consulting and a weight-management programme. Tatiana Coutseli and Anasthasia Coucouriki lead it as an interdisciplinary team: a psychologist (M.Sc.), mental health coaches and bioresonance practitioners who are also micronutrient advisers. The focus is stress management, sleep routines and energy. Appointments can be booked in the practice or online. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews.

listings.name: Christa Lewicki Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Christa Lewicki founded her Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Bottrop in 1995. Sessions are built around a 3D whole-body scan with the Oberon device, an NLS system, and the practice also works with Tricombin and BICOM bioresonance. Other offers include the SCENAR method, progressive muscle relaxation and talk-based sessions. A first visit leads to an individual plan, with the stated goal of supporting physical, mental and emotional wellbeing. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. The practice is women-owned, and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: gesund-in-balance
listings.description: Gesund-in-balance is a health counselling practice in Cologne-Dellbrück supporting a healthy lifestyle and everyday balance. Its focus is energy, frequency and information methods, including bioresonance. The aim is to balance four life areas: health, work, relationships and personal development. Sessions take place in its own room in Dellbrück, and some services are also offered online or at the client's home by arrangement. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Institut Delphin
listings.description: Institut Delphin in Düsseldorf is a wellness studio led by a woman owner, offering yoga and Qi Gong courses in person and online, Shiatsu relaxation massage and individually arranged relaxation programmes. Its bioresonance vital measurement sessions sit within a broader movement, relaxation and nutrition concept for individuals and companies. Gift vouchers are available. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Alena Stürzbecher
listings.description: Alena Stürzbecher is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Overath. The practice offers bioresonance with a dedicated bioresonance device, ear acupuncture, cupping massage, micronutrient and gut-health counselling, and courses on women's and pelvic floor health. Focus areas are gut health, resilience to stress and exhaustion, and women's health, and the practice takes card and mobile payments. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Marita Vogel
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Marita Vogel in Dortmund offers acupuncture, bioresonance, kinesiology and ThetaHealing. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Opening hours are posted, appointments are required and there is free on-site parking. Call ahead to confirm session details.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Schön
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Schön in Bergisch Gladbach is a practice for bioresonance and classical homeopathy, with an approach built on the idea that everything vibrates. Bioresonance follows the method of Paul Schmidt, and the practice shows a video about it. Appointments can be booked online, opening hours are posted, and the practice has free on-site parking and wheelchair-accessible parking. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Karin Kossek, Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Karin Kossek has run her Naturheilpraxis in Duisburg Rumeln since 2001 as a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her offers include the BICOM bioresonance method and manual methods. Questions can be sent by phone or email. Rated 4.5 from 2 Google reviews, one at five stars and one at four. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Gudrun Flosdorff, Praxis für Naturheilkunde in Roetgen
listings.description: Gudrun Flosdorff's Praxis für Naturheilkunde in Roetgen sits on the northern edge of the Hohes Venn, surrounded by forest. It offers homeopathy, acupuncture, Vegatest, bioresonance, laser, nosode therapy, Bach flowers and shiatsu. Rated 3.0 from 4 Google reviews, 2 of them five stars and 2 one star.

listings.name: gesund-leben-wuppertal.de
listings.description: Gesund-leben-wuppertal.de is a nutrition practice in Wuppertal focused on metabolic therapy, Metabolic Balance since 2007 and nutrition counselling. Further methods are acupuncture, bioresonance and NLP coaching, which has been offered since 2002. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call to ask which sessions are available.

listings.name: Heilpraktik - Heilpraxis Jungbluth
listings.description: Heilpraxis Jungbluth in Adenau is run by Anja Talboys, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and hypnosis therapist. She offers bioresonance after Paul Schmidt on a Rayonex PS 1000 polar 4.0 device, which she combines on request with hypnosis or EMDR. Hypnosis for birth preparation is one of her specialities. Other offers are Access Bars, KinFlex and Schüssler salts. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Elke Urbschat
listings.description: Heilpraktikerin Elke Urbschat works in Barntrup and lists bioresonance sessions among her methods, next to Penzel acupressure massage, fascia therapy, medi-taping, Dorn and Hock joint therapy, Tuina massage and colour light therapy. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Appointments are made by phone, so call ahead to confirm what a visit involves.

listings.name: Ilona Tasch, Heilpraktikerin, Praxis für Naturheilkunde und Ernährung
listings.description: Ilona Tasch is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Rheine whose practice centres on nutrient and micronutrient consulting. A personal vitamin plan follows a detailed intake conversation. She also works with Vitalfeld technology from Vitatec, described as a further development of classic bioresonance, with bioresonance, high frequency and magnetic field options. Women's health is another area, and appointments can be made online or by phone. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Nicola Hirsch
listings.description: Nicola Hirsch is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) running the Integrale HeilPraxis in Bonn. Bioresonance, frequency and vital-field sessions are done with a full Vitatec equipment set that includes the Digisoft and Mito units. The practice also offers psychotherapy and coaching, classical homeopathy, orthomolecular nutrition, biophoton work and stress and resilience training. Individual session plans combine these approaches around the person's own goals. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call to confirm opening hours and how to book.

listings.name: Uschis TierBalance
listings.description: Uschis TierBalance is a mobile animal Heilpraktiker (alternative practitioner for animals) service in Wuppertal and the surrounding area. It works with dogs, cats, horses and small animals, visiting at home. Offers include a bioresonance-based vital scan for dogs and cats that takes about one minute, homeopathy, kinesiology tape and grief support. An information call can be held on site or by phone, and rates are given on request. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call or message to arrange a home visit.

listings.name: Vital-Praxis Inge Kowalewski
listings.description: Vital-Praxis Inge Kowalewski sits on Gut Elsfeld in Königswinter and is set up as a space for people and animals. For animals, Inge Kowalewski offers Oberon bioresonance (Metavital), bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, radionics and mushroom therapy. For people, the focus is hypnosis coaching, chakra hypnosis and Instant Change. She works with animals, with people, and with both together, with a particular love of cats. The practice describes its animal work as bioresonance and radionics, and its work for people as hypnosis coaching and Reconnection-style energy sessions, and invites contact through a form to arrange an appointment. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis für Bioresonanz Therapie, manuelle Therapie und Naturheilkunde Stefanie Heine Heilpraktikerin, Mülheim
listings.description: Stefanie Heine is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a practice for bioresonance therapy, manual therapy and naturopathy, serving Mülheim an der Ruhr and Mettmann. The offers include bioresonance therapy, craniosacral therapy, mycotherapy with vital mushrooms, a nutrition concept, massages and relaxation techniques. A free first conversation of about 15 minutes is available. Rated 1.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Biokybernetische Praxis Haaranalyse ob Mensch oder Tier
listings.description: Biokybernetische Praxis Birgit Vogels in Schwalmtal offers hair analysis for people and animals, based on bioresonance and biocybernetics with a CyberTrone device. It runs as a mobile practice for small and large animals and also works with families and individuals. Mycotherapy and gift vouchers are available. A free consultation appointment is offered for any questions, and a hair sample can be brought in or sent. Sessions are open to families as well as to individual clients and their animals. The practice is at Dorfstraße 8 in Schwalmtal.

listings.name: Bioresonanz Warendorf - Heilpraktikerin Alejandra Villa
listings.description: Alejandra Villa runs a naturopathic practice in Warendorf as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner), working with gentle holistic methods aimed at wellbeing. Bioresonance sessions follow Paul Schmidt's method, and the practice also covers stress reduction. Building biology and dowsing are offered together with Werner Schimmelpfennig. Appointments are by arrangement. Warendorf lies east of Münster in North Rhine-Westphalia. A notice on the practice pages states that remarks on the effect of bioenergetic vibrations are not recognised by conventional medicine.

listings.name: Bioresonanz-Liedberg Dr. Gudrun Böhm
listings.description: Bioresonanz-Liedberg is the practice of Dr. Gudrun Böhm, based in a farmhouse in the historic centre of Liedberg, Korschenbroich. It offers bioresonance therapy sessions with a BICOM Optima device, and the first appointment is a session of about 90 minutes using the BICOM BodyCheck. The practice describes the method as part of regulative medicine, supporting the body's own regulation. A practice tour and online appointment request are available. Parking and restroom are wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Bioresonanz-Therapie Köln
listings.description: Bioresonanz-Therapie Köln is the practice of Karen Laß, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a Dr. phil. title. She offers bioresonance sessions with a device that picks up the body's oscillations and feeds them back. Sessions are described as painless, often pleasant, and suitable for children. She says she accompanies clients personally and comprehensively, and the practice is in Cologne. Opening hours are posted.

listings.name: Christa Durgeloh-Netta
listings.description: Heilpraxis Christa Durgeloh-Netta in Münster has been run by Christa Durgeloh-Netta, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner), in her own practice since 1992. Her fields are bioresonance, acupuncture and shiatsu. She has also worked as an application consultant for Regumed, the bioresonance device maker, since 2024. Appointments are by phone. Call to ask which device is used in a session.

listings.name: EAV - Praxis Für Elektroakupunktur und Bioresonanztherapie
listings.description: The EAV practice in Cologne is named for electroacupuncture and bioresonance sessions. It also offers the Dorn method, a gentle manual technique. Opening hours are posted and appointments are recommended. Call to confirm which sessions are currently available.

listings.name: EnergieQuelle
listings.description: Tatjana Rosin runs EnergieQuelle in Leverkusen as a certified health counselor and nurse. Her focus areas are TCM and nutrition concepts, bioresonance analysis with the WebWellness system, and energy work such as ThetaHealing and meditation. She also offers bioenergetic massages aimed at energy balance. Contact is through WhatsApp.

listings.name: Frau Nicole Janning-Hölscher
listings.description: Nicole Janning-Hölscher has worked as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Wettringen since 2001. Her sessions include bioresonance, Reiki and subtle energy work, Schüßler salts, chakra essences, Aura-Soma, Bach flowers and meridian tapping. Appointments are made by phone.

listings.name: Ganzheitliche Energetische Praxis Siegen
listings.description: Ganzheitliche Energetische Praxis Siegen is run by an animal Heilpraktikerin (alternative practitioner for animals) who has been self-employed in her own practice since September 2001. She offers bioresonance for people and for animals, using the Bicom Body Balance Check, together with Matrix Rhythm Therapy and classical homeopathy. Call ahead to confirm session details and opening times.

listings.name: Health Place, Heilpraktikerin in Köln
listings.description: Health Place is the Cologne practice of Katrin Haux, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). It works with adults who pay privately and combines bioresonance, hypnosis and hypno-coaching, and micronutrients in programmes aimed at feeling lighter in body and mind. Further offers include bioenergetic scans, oxygen-based sessions and a nutrition focus on gut and cell energy. A team page introduces the people behind the practice. Appointments are recommended; opening hours are not posted.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Hiltrud Brandt
listings.description: Hiltrud Brandt is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Rheda-Wiedenbrück who is also a chiropractor and a pharmaceutical technical assistant. Her range covers chiropractic, bioresonance sessions, classical naturopathy and iris analysis. She is a member of the Bund Deutscher Heilpraktiker. Opening hours are posted, the practice has wheelchair-accessible parking, and appointments are recommended. Further bioresonance information is linked from regumed.de.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Kerstin Dammers
listings.description: Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Kerstin Dammers runs a practice in Neukirchen-Vluyn where massage is combined with bioresonance or light therapy, with music of the client's choice. Free phone or video consultations can be booked. Sessions are by appointment only.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Liljana Brodowski
listings.description: Liljana Brodowski is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Dortmund whose main focus is bioresonance with a BICOM device. Her sessions are tailored to the individual, with a link to the BICOM manufacturer's information pages for those who want to read more, and are combined with kinesiology, Yager therapy, conversation and nutrition counselling. The practice is women-owned and has on-site services, street and lot parking, a hearing loop and wheelchair-accessible seating. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Hahne
listings.description: Heilpraxis Hahne in Oelde offers bioresonance therapy, Dorn-Breuss massage and Vitalwellen therapy. Appointments are required, and the practice has wheelchair-accessible parking. Call to confirm which sessions are available and how to book before you plan around it.

listings.name: Institut Werden und Sein Rolf Binar
listings.description: Institut Werden und Sein is the practice of Rolf Binar, a freelance psychologist and therapist in Düren, between Cologne and Aachen, who has worked for more than 15 years and also lectures in psychology. His approach is spiritual as well as psychological, covering body, mind and soul. Since 2015 he has used the TimeWaver system alongside his work. The practice offers marriage counselling, family constellations, systemic family therapy, kinesiology and coaching. Telephone consultations and phone office hours are available, and a free, non-binding first meeting can be arranged.

listings.name: Maria Elena Muresan. Praxis für Traditionelle Chinesische Medizin
listings.description: Maria Elena Muresan practises in Düsseldorf as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a focus on traditional Chinese medicine and information medicine. Her sessions use the TimeWaver information field system and a counselling approach she calls bioenergetic reprogramming, for which she holds a certificate from the Accademia per la Riprogrammazione in Rome. She speaks German and Romanian fluently. The TimeWaver system is a computer-based information field technology, and the counselling is offered for self-awareness and quality of life. Appointments are recommended; the practice can be reached by phone or email in German, English or Italian.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Christina Jostarndt
listings.description: Christina Jostarndt runs a naturopathic practice in Espelkamp that also serves Rahden and the surrounding area. Her main offer is bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, using Rayonex technology, described as a gentle computer-controlled vibration method. She also works with plant-based approaches and has pages on eye and gut wellbeing. A telephone consultation hour is held on Mondays and other appointments are by arrangement. She is a member of the Bund Deutscher Heilpraktiker (BDH), an association of state-licensed alternative practitioners. A page covers costs and cover.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Friedrich Koller Naturheilpraktiker & Alternative Heilverfahren
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Friedrich Koller in Münster is run by Friedrich Koller, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and graduate biologist who learned in his mother's practice from 2010. The practice carries on a tradition of homeopathy, herbal lore and bioresonance, and adds systemic family constellations and shamanic work. Call ahead to confirm hours and booking.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Gerda Kozik
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Gerda Kozik in Attendorn offers bioresonance alongside gentle manual methods such as Dorn and Breuss massage and Popp spinal therapy, plus classical naturopathy, Bach flowers and homeopathy. Opening hours are posted, appointments are recommended and there is parking on site. Call ahead to confirm how a bioresonance session is run.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Helga Ellerkamp
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Helga Ellerkamp in Bad Sassendorf is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice where bioresonance is one of the stated focus areas. Opening hours are posted, appointments are recommended, and parking is wheelchair accessible. Call to confirm which sessions are offered and how to book.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Petra Schumacher
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Petra Schumacher is a naturopathic practice in Kamp-Lintfort on the Lower Rhine. Petra Schumacher works as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and describes more than 30 years of experience. Her approach is built around kinesiology, including psycho-kinesiology, combined with homeopathy, Schüssler salts, natural preparations, Bach flowers, nutrition and supplement advice, bio-photon therapy and bio-resonance therapy. She describes frequency medicine as part of the concept and aims to tailor each combination to the individual. Appointments are required, and the practice has wheelchair-accessible parking, seating and restroom.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Pia Trittmann Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Pia Trittmann is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Kreuztal. Its listed offers include bioresonance therapy, soft laser sessions, children's naturopathy and ear acupuncture. Appointments are required, so call ahead to confirm which sessions are currently offered and how to book.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Sindern
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Sindern in Aldenhoven offers bioresonance combined with electroacupuncture after Voll (EAV), where measurements are taken at points on the fingers and toes. Other offers include Dorn-Breuss spine and joint work, systemic constellations, kinesiology and the Physiokey. The practice has posted opening hours, recommends booking an appointment and has a wheelchair-accessible entrance. Contact is through a form on the practice pages.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Tanja Boele
listings.description: Tanja Boele is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a naturopathic practice in Meinerzhagen built around the whole person. Her offers include classical homeopathy, ear acupuncture, vital nutrient therapy and bioresonance therapy. The practice has a free parking lot and requires appointments.

listings.name: Offiah, Dr. med. Gabriele
listings.description: Dr. med. Gabriele Offiah is a physician in Nordwalde who lists energy medicine, synergetic homeopathy, bioresonance, acupuncture and psychosomatics among her areas of work. The practice has wheelchair-accessible parking. Call to confirm the details of a bioresonance session before you plan around it.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Dr. rer.nat. Bärbel Isenberg
listings.description: Dr. rer. nat. Bärbel Isenberg is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a naturopathic practice in Schieder-Schwalenberg. Her range includes ear acupressure, bioresonance with frequencies, classical homeopathy, Schüssler salts and micronutrients. Clients book by phone or through the practice website, and a short message with name and phone number is enough to arrange a non-binding first conversation. The practice is in Schieder-Schwalenberg, in the Lippe district of North Rhine-Westphalia, and she holds a doctorate in natural sciences.

listings.name: Praxis für NaturMedizin
listings.description: Praxis für NaturMedizin in Rahden lists chiropractic, osteopathy, bioresonance sessions and other naturopathic methods. The practice has wheelchair-accessible parking and a restroom, hours are not posted, and appointments are recommended. The listed range is chiropractic, osteopathy and naturopathic methods.

listings.name: Praxis KÖRPERLEICHT A. u. M Knüpp
listings.description: Praxis Körperleicht in Ochtrup is run by Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) sisters Anna and Mareen Knüpp and combines physiotherapy with osteopathic sessions and manual chiropractic. It offers bioresonance after Paul Schmidt with the PS 1000 polar bioresonance device and a whole-body scan, plus kinesiological testing, homeopathy and magnetic field sessions. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Privatärztliche Praxis Heidelinde Eckert
listings.description: This private physician's practice in Neuss is run by Heidelinde Eckert and takes an integrative approach. It offers bioresonance sessions, which the practice describes as working with the body's own oscillation pattern.
