Individual nutrition counselling, Bach flower therapy and lymphatic drainage are also on the menu. Opening hours are posted and appointments are required. The practice is women-owned and has a wheelchair-accessible entrance and a restroom. Call to ask how a bioresonance session is run.

listings.name: Rainer Krumbiegel Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Rainer Krumbiegel runs a naturopathic practice in Münster as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) specialising in bioresonance, where he measures the individual electromagnetic frequency pattern of a person. He also specialises in chiropractic, using manual techniques. Call to confirm hours and how to book.

listings.name: Sabine Mühlisch InformationsFeld Analysen & Coaching IFM. TimeWaver.
listings.description: Sabine Mühlisch offers information-field analyses and coaching in the Cologne area using the IFM and TimeWaver systems. Sessions can be done remotely, as no personal presence is required, and phone coaching is part of the offer. The analyses can be requested for people, animals, buildings and surroundings. Opening hours are posted.

listings.name: Sarah Janßen Bioresonanz und ätherische Öle
listings.description: Sarah Janßen offers bioresonance and essential oils for balance, energy and everyday wellbeing in Wissel on the Lower Rhine, listed under Kalkar. Individual consultations are available for adults and children. Call ahead to confirm session details and availability.

listings.name: Wamper Claudia Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Claudia Wamper is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Jüchen. Her practice offers MORA bioresonance sessions with a MORA device, combined with hypnosis, LomiLomi massage, homeopathy, ear acupuncture, Bach flowers, spagyrics and stress management. The MORA method is presented as combining Chinese acupuncture and meridian knowledge with biophysical information. The practice also offers ADI therapy and lists its fees on a separate page. Parking is wheelchair accessible and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Bioresonanz-Kleve
listings.description: Bioresonanz-Kleve is a health consultant in Kleve with posted opening hours and wheelchair-accessible parking. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to confirm which sessions and devices it offers before booking.

listings.name: Gesundheitspraxis Uhlig
listings.description: Gesundheitspraxis Uhlig is a counselling and life coaching practice in Bielefeld. The owner is a certified Gesundheitspraktikerin with further training in psychological counselling, nature coaching, hypnosis, systemic counselling and bioresonance. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Appointments are required, so call ahead to confirm which sessions are offered.

listings.name: Naturheilkunde - Psychologie - Homöopathie Bioresonanz - Hand - Ohrakupunktur
listings.description: Listed in Duisburg as an alternative medicine practitioner. Rated 2.0 from 1 Google review, with a single two-star rating. Call ahead to confirm opening times, which sessions are offered and how to book. Call ahead to ask which sessions are offered and whether any bioresonance or biofeedback device is used.

listings.name: Allergie-Bioresonanz-Naturheilpraxis Renate Gleiß - Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Renate Gleiß's naturopathic practice in Dinslaken is listed under alternative practitioners, and its name presents her as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Call ahead to confirm hours, which sessions are offered and how to book an appointment.

listings.name: Annette Zyto
listings.description: Annette Zyto works in Bochum and is listed as a psychotherapist and alternative medicine practitioner. Appointments are recommended rather than walk-in visits. Call ahead to ask which sessions are offered, how a first appointment works and whether any scan or biofeedback equipment is used before you plan a visit.

listings.name: Bioresonanz Neuss
listings.description: Bioresonanz Neuss is a naturopathic practitioner in Neuss, working by appointment. Maps shows a restroom on site and recommends booking ahead. Call before you visit to confirm opening hours, which sessions are offered and how to book.

listings.name: Bioresonanz Telgte
listings.description: Bioresonanz Telgte is a Reiki therapist practice in Telgte, a town in the Warendorf district of North Rhine-Westphalia, close to Münster. Phone the practice to ask about opening hours and the sessions it offers.

listings.name: Dr. Stefan Kerber - Praxis für Bioresonanz Düsseldorf
listings.description: Dr. Stefan Kerber runs a practice in Düsseldorf whose name points to bioresonance. It is listed as a doctor's practice, and an appointment is recommended. Call to confirm which sessions are offered and how to book.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Karlsruhe - Elke Gerhardt - Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Elke Gerhardt is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a Naturheilpraxis in Karlsruhe Durlach, in practice since 1986. Bioresonance is a main focus, done with a BICOM optima device, and an individual plan is drawn up for each client. The practice also offers homeopathy, acupuncture and kinesiology, runs seminars and lectures, and runs wellness programmes. Seminar dates include kinesiology courses in November 2026 and a holiday seminar on Lesbos in August 2027. Rated 4.9 from 109 Google reviews, 105 of them five stars. Appointments are required, the practice is women-owned and it is wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Carolin Falter Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Carolin Falter is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Nürtingen who works with health kinesiology, bioresonance therapy, traditional Chinese medicine and Brain-Gym. Appointments are by arrangement, by phone or through the contact form. She looks at the person as a whole and describes each of her methods in detail, with prices and appointments set out separately. Rated 5.0 from 74 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Alexander Tripathi, Osteopathie, Akupunktur, Neuraltherapie, Heilpraktiker,
listings.description: Alexander Tripathi is an osteopath and Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with practices in Zell unter Aichelberg and Dürnau, serving Göppingen, Kirchheim unter Teck and Weilheim an der Teck. Osteopathy is the main offer, including sessions for babies and children, combined with osteopressure after Liebscher and Bracht and Chinese medicine with acupuncture and cupping. Matrix bioresonance sessions run on a Trikomb device. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 69 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Dr. med. Brigitte Krug
listings.description: Dr. med. Brigitte Krug is a physician and ear, nose and throat specialist in Weinheim who also offers naturopathic methods, including bioresonance sessions. Opening hours are posted, appointments are recommended, and parking and the entrance are wheelchair accessible. Rated 3.8 from 174 Google reviews, 113 of them five stars and 39 one star.

listings.name: Praxis Beate Braun
listings.description: Praxis Beate Braun in Ludwigsburg is a naturopathic practice offering homeopathy, acupuncture and bioresonance therapy, alongside psychotherapy and couples counselling. The same practice runs birth preparation courses, doula support, postnatal care and bereavement support. Rated 5.0 from 49 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: TIME4HEALTH - Hypnose und Bioresonanz Praxis Maritta Schmid
listings.description: TIME4HEALTH is the practice of Maritta Schmid, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Schwäbisch Gmünd, offering hypnosis sessions and bioresonance. The bioresonance sessions are described as a gentle, non-invasive method aimed at stress reduction and energetic balance. The practice also serves the Lake Constance region and takes appointment requests through its contact page. Rated 4.9 from 47 Google reviews, 46 of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Nadja Engel
listings.description: Heilpraktikerin Nadja Engel runs a naturopathy and aesthetics practice in Laupheim. Her listed offers include bioresonance, frequency therapy, lymph drainage, neural therapy and women's health counselling. Rated 5.0 from 39 Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are offered and how to book.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Renate Nienaber
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Renate Nienaber in Weinheim is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice combining naturopathy with natural aesthetics. Renate Nienaber combines methods such as TCM, mineral supplements, bioresonance and skin analysis, and the practice names Regumed bioresonance among her qualifications. She also runs an academy that trains Heilpraktiker in aesthetic practice, with courses and further training for practitioners. A free first conversation can be requested without obligation, and a published client review mentions an initial scan analysis. Rated 5.0 from 38 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Kempter Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Elisabeth Kempter in Aidlingen (Deufringen) is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice where bioresonance is the main focus. Elisabeth Kempter works with Rayonex devices and combines sessions with cupping massage using a Pneumatron, Dorn-Breuss and trigger point massage, fascia work, therapeutic fasting and iris analysis. Practice rooms are at Gänsbergweg 14, with free parking, a hearing loop and wheelchair access. Appointments are required and booked by phone or email. Rated 5.0 from 36 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Opening hours are posted.

listings.name: Bodycare-Hall, Naturheilpraxis, Alexandra Lucke, Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Bodycare-Hall is the naturopathic practice of Alexandra Lucke, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Schwäbisch Hall. Her focus areas are gut health, women's health with hormone topics, and bioresonance. Massage is part of the range, including Dorn-Breuss, therapeutic women's massage and classic massage, within a whole-person approach. Rated 5.0 from 34 Google reviews, 33 of them five stars.

listings.name: Bioresonanztherapie - Arztpraxis Dr. Gregor Dietze
listings.description: Arztpraxis Dr. Gregor Dietze in Überlingen is a physician's practice that offers bioresonance therapy using the BICOM method, where harmonic frequency patterns are played back to support the body's self-regulation. The BICOM Bodycheck is offered as a related session, and fees follow the GOÄ scale. Rated 5.0 from 32 Google reviews, 31 of them five stars. Bioresonance is presented as applicable to people, animals and plants alike. Call ahead to confirm how sessions are booked and what a visit involves.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Dr. Michael Hoster - Naturheilpraxis kerngesund²
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis kerngesund² in Mannheim is the practice of Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Michael Hoster, who holds a Heilpraktiker licence dated 2010. The concept combines a Vitalstoff scan, bioresonance, magnetic field sessions, movement training with SRT and nutrient support. Rated 4.8 from 36 Google reviews, 34 of them five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Heilpraktiker Kreuer in Wernau bei Stuttgart und Esslingen
listings.description: Arno Kreuer has worked full time as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) since 1992, with his practice in Wernau near Stuttgart and Esslingen. He combines classic naturopathy with bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, including frequency harmonisation sessions. His range also covers acupuncture, classical homeopathy, biohacking and heart rate variability measurement. Rated 4.7 from 37 Google reviews, 33 of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Poeffel
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Poeffel is the Buchen im Odenwald practice of Silke Poeffel, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Methods include Dorn therapy, Breuss massage, acupuncture, taping, Bemer, Novafon sound waves, pneumatic pulsation, hypnosis and bioresonance with a Rayonex device. The practice also covers aesthetics and gives seminars and talks on its methods. She came to the field after years in dental technology and works with both adults and children. Rated 5.0 from 28 Google reviews, all five stars. Online appointment booking is available.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Birgit Mark
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Birgit Mark in Durmersheim is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice offering bioresonance sessions, micronutrient guidance, stress support and nutrition counselling, with a focus on the wellbeing of children and adults. A separate learning coaching offer helps children build study strategies, concentration and motivation. Rated 5.0 from 26 Google reviews, all five stars. Women-owned, LGBTQ-welcoming, appointments required.

listings.name: Osteopathie & Naturheilpraxis Sabine Kraus
listings.description: Osteopathie & Naturheilpraxis Sabine Kraus is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Unterkochen, Aalen. It offers fascia therapy, osteopathy and bioresonance therapy. Rated 5.0 from 26 Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to confirm availability.

listings.name: Claudia Beilicke, Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Claudia Beilicke is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Graben-Neudorf with a focus on thyroid and hormone balance. Her approach combines bioresonance sessions with gut health, acid-base balance, nutrient support, plant medicine and systemic work. Rated 5.0 from 25 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: arcus caeli vitalis Naturheilpraxis Birgit Nagel
listings.description: Arcus caeli vitalis in Baienfurt, near Ravensburg, is the practice of Birgit Nagel, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). It centres on BICOM bioresonance sessions and also offers hybrid field and vital field sessions, Dorn and Breuss spine work, acupuncture from Traditional Chinese Medicine, plant-based naturopathy, hypnosis, naturopathy for women, BEMER vascular sessions and micronutrient advice. Appointments are made by phone at 0751 79165537, and opening hours are posted. Parking is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 24 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Pfeiffer
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Pfeiffer in Bühl is the practice of Roxane Pfeiffer, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her background includes holistic health counselling, and she offers acupuncture, bioresonance, chiropractic, reflexology, cupping, acupressure, mental field tapping acupressure and Japanese acupuncture. Rated 5.0 from 23 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required, and the practice has on-site parking, a unisex restroom and wheelchair access. Opening hours are posted.

listings.name: Praxis Symphonie - Katharina Hopfner, Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Katharina Hopfner is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and physiotherapist with more than 20 years of experience, running Praxis Symphonie in Weil der Stadt. Her bioresonance sessions use the BICOM optima, either in the practice or from home with a hair sample, and online consultations are offered. The range also covers acupuncture, cupping, manual therapy and massage, and the practice runs courses such as SoulFlow and Mind Body Pilates. Rated 5.0 from 23 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Olas Studio
listings.description: Olas Studio in Offenburg combines beauty with whole-person wellbeing, offering skin and hair analyses, bioresonance, face yoga, workshops, and bridal and event styling. Personal consultation and individually tailored sessions are at the centre. Rated 5.0 from 22 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Daniela Findeisen Feng Shui und Bioresonanz
listings.description: Daniela Findeisen works from Kißlegg with several strands: business consulting, coaching, Bioresonance ORGANETIK, Feng Shui and nutrient counselling. Her ORGANO Feng Shui work helps people shape bedrooms and workspaces without renovation, with a focus on sleep, concentration and a calmer home. She describes her approach as down to earth. Rated 5.0 from 21 Google reviews, all five stars. On-site services are offered, and the premises have wheelchair-accessible parking and entrance.

listings.name: Öznur Kaya Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Öznur Kaya is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Stuttgart whose practice offers bioresonance, bioenergy sessions, homeopathy and Matrix regeneration. Rated 5.0 from 20 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Opening hours are posted and an appointment is recommended. Call to confirm what a first visit involves.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Christine Fux, Migräne- und ganzheitliche Therapie
listings.description: Christine Fux practises as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Ammerbuch. Her offers include Organetik, a bioresonance method used to bring energetic balance, along with Schüssler salts, Access Bars, ear and eye acupuncture, lymph drainage and kinesiology taping. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 19 Google reviews, all five stars. The practice has wheelchair-accessible parking and a hearing loop. Call ahead to confirm opening times.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Petra Franchini
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Petra Franchini in Langenau is a naturopathic practice for magnetic field and bioresonance therapy. Rated 5.0 from 19 Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are offered, which devices are used and how to book.

listings.name: Dr. med. Volker Wintermantel
listings.description: Dr. med. Volker Wintermantel runs a dermatology practice in Freiburg im Breisgau. Alongside skin care and aesthetic offers with a laser department, he has integrated bioresonance sessions into his daily work, taking a wider look at the whole person. Appointments are made by phone only, not by email. Rated 4.0 from 39 Google reviews, 28 of them five stars and 9 one star. Call to ask about bioresonance sessions specifically before booking.

listings.name: Tatjana Schwab, Fachärztin für Allgemeinmedizin, Akupunktur
listings.description: Tatjana Schwab is a specialist physician for general medicine with an additional acupuncture qualification, running a practice in Welzheim. Her special consultations include acupuncture, bioresonance, homeopathy and kinesio taping. Rated 4.3 from 27 Google reviews, 21 of them five stars. Welzheim lies in the Rems-Murr district of Baden-Württemberg, east of Stuttgart. The practice runs as a family practice with posted consultation hours.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Ehret Konstanz
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Ehret is a naturopathic practice in Konstanz that offers bioresonance and high-frequency sessions as well as Oberon sessions, an NLS system available since January 2020. Ear acupuncture is also on the list. Rated 4.6 from 21 Google reviews, 19 of them five stars. The practice is women-owned, offers on-site services, welcomes LGBTQ and transgender visitors, and has paid parking nearby. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Anja Vedie
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Geislingen is the practice of Anja Vedie, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Geislingen-Türkheim. Her methods include bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, Peter Hess sound massage, craniosacral therapy and traditional Chinese medicine. She also runs workshops on singing bowl meditation, Ho'oponopono and energetic constellation work, and teaches craniosacral self-help for relaxation. Rated 5.0 from 16 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Balance Oase Praxis für Körperanalysen und Ernährung
listings.description: Balance Oase in Metzingen is a practice for body analyses and nutrition. It offers a bioresonance practice, personal body analyses including a DNA-based nutrition analysis done with a partner lab through saliva samples, and individual nutrition counselling. Holistic yoga, air and water filters and foot care round out the range, and appointments are booked through Calendly. Rated 4.9 from 16 Google reviews, 15 of them five stars. Wheelchair-accessible parking, seating and restroom are available.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Bodo Schmidt
listings.description: Bodo Schmidt runs the Naturheilpraxis "be in touch" in Reutlingen, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice open since 1991 that also serves Tübingen and Nürtingen. The range covers Traditional Chinese Medicine, body work and massages, bioresonance and coaching. Bioresonance is presented as a gentle method that works with electromagnetic oscillations to bring the body into energetic balance. Appointments are required. Rated 4.9 from 16 Google reviews, 15 of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Christa Kunz aus Plieningen / Stuttgart
listings.description: Christa Kunz is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a Naturheilpraxis in Plieningen, Stuttgart. She offers Bicom bioresonance and the Bicom Body-Check, which she describes as a non-linear system built on findings from quantum and biophysics. The method starts from the idea that the body's cells communicate through oscillations. Her practice also works with homeopathy, spagyrics, Bach flowers, phytotherapy and connective tissue revitalisation. Appointments are made by phone. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all of them five stars, with opening hours posted.

listings.name: Gaile Olga Vita Holistische Heilung
listings.description: Olga Gaile runs a Naturheilpraxis in Leutkirch-Herlazhofen in the Allgäu and has worked as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) since 2016. Her practice combines naturopathy and bioresonance with astrological health guidance and body-oriented methods such as the Dorn method and Liebscher & Bracht. Appointments can be booked online, and a free introductory phone call helps clarify what suits a client's concern. Contact is possible online, by phone or by WhatsApp. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The practice also runs seminars and workshops.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde & Podologie Katja Schlotter
listings.description: Katja Schlotter is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Ettenheim whose practice combines podiatry with naturopathy. Bioresonance has its own page, where it is described as a gentle method working with individual vibrations that suits children as well as adults. Bach flower therapy also appears among the offers. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde, Kinesiologie und Psychotherapie
listings.description: This practice in Schallstadt serves the Freiburg and Bad Krozingen area and South Baden. It is run by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and covers naturopathy, bioresonance, kinesiology, phytotherapy, homeopathy, Bach flower work, psychotherapy, coaching and learning support. Nutrition counselling and naturopathic work with children are part of the range. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all 13 of them five stars.

listings.name: Zentrum der LEBENSkraft - PRAXIS für Ästhetik & Heilkunde - Tanja Michaela Erbele-Wiest - Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Zentrum der Lebenskraft in Bondorf is the practice of Tanja Michaela Erbele-Wiest, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner), combining naturopathy with aesthetic skin care. Naturopathic offers include bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, hypnoanalysis, Traditional Chinese Medicine with body, ear and skull acupuncture, craniosacral therapy and classical homeopathy. The aesthetic side covers skin rejuvenation care. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: quantum aid - Björn Hötzel
listings.description: Björn Hötzel runs quantum aid, a life coaching practice in Bad Schönborn for people going through phases of change. Sessions use TimeWaver technology together with Akasha work and intuitive perception, aimed at clarity, new perspectives and personal development. Sessions take place online or in person. Rated 4.7 from 15 Google reviews, 14 of them five stars. Opening hours are posted.

listings.name: Therapiezentrum Geiger
listings.description: Therapiezentrum Geiger in Bad Boll combines naturopathy, osteopathy and physiotherapy under one roof. Christian and Wolfgang Geiger work as Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioners), osteopaths and physiotherapists, serving Bad Boll, Göppingen, Kirchheim and the surrounding area. Naturopathic offers include acupuncture, acupuncture massage and meridian therapy, homeopathy, craniosacral osteopathy and bioresonance, used as a complementary method. Rated 4.7 from 15 Google reviews, 13 of them five stars. Appointments by arrangement; the practice is wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Martin Jagfeld
listings.description: Martin Jagfeld is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Filderstadt who calls bioresonance his special field. His practice for vibrational medicine also offers vital field sessions, magnetic field sessions, craniosacral sessions and a body composition analysis. He draws on the Therapeutic House concept after Martin Keymer. It works with six pillars of wellbeing, including eating and drinking. Contact is by phone on 0711 2842770 or by form. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Simone Marquardt
listings.description: Heilpraxis Simone Marquardt is the practice of a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Neubulach, in the Oberhaugstett district. Bioresonance therapy sits alongside osteopathy, chiropractic, homeopathy, ear acupuncture, spagyrics, cupping, an electrolysis foot bath and the Medkey approach. Clients can call or email to ask whether the practice suits their situation, and costs are discussed in advance. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Gabriele Woschek Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Gabriele Woschek is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a Naturheilpraxis in central Karlsruhe, reachable by car or public transport. She works with Bowtech (Bowen technique), Matrix Rhythm sessions, Bicom bioresonance, Regenaplex, Schüssler salts, Luxxaned microcurrent and IHHT, with the aim of bringing body and mind into balance. Online appointments are available on request. Clients come from Pforzheim, Ettlingen, the Enzkreis, Graben-Neudorf and Bruchsal as well as Karlsruhe. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The practice is women-owned and an appointment is recommended.

listings.name: Privatpraxis AcuraVita
listings.description: Privatpraxis AcuraVita is a private practice in Kuppenheim led by Anja Blaß, a physician specialising in general practice and anaesthesia. Alongside her specialist work the practice lists acupuncture, neural therapy, complementary medicine and bioresonance. Appointments are by phone only, with set weekday hours on Tuesday and Wednesday. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all five stars. The practice also names the Gaggenau Oberweier area and lists complementary medicine and magnesium-oxygen sessions among its offers, with a small team that includes a trainee.

listings.name: Physiotherapie Andrei Vrabie
listings.description: Physiotherapie Andrei Vrabie in Bad Bergzabern is a physiotherapy practice offering exercise-based physiotherapy, manual therapy, fascia work, kinesiology taping, electrotherapy, strength training, bioresonance with magnet, and heat packs. Staff speak German, Romanian and Russian. Appointments are arranged by phone. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all five stars, with opening hours posted.

listings.name: BrandauVital - Integrative Gesundheit & Naturheilkunde Praxisinstitut & Akademie
listings.description: BrandauVital is a naturopathic practice and academy in Schönaich near Stuttgart, led by Elisabeth Brandau, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and former Olympic mountain biker. Its methods include TimeWaver frequency work, kinesiology, movement and breathing work, back school, personal training and advice on electrosmog. The team also runs an online practice. Appointments are in person, by phone or as remote sessions, and the free first conversation helps decide what can be done online and what is better on site. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Dr. med. Ursula Scherzinger
listings.description: Dr. Ursula Scherzinger runs a private paediatric practice in Friedrichshafen on Lake Constance and is a physician specialising in paediatrics for over 30 years. On request the practice adds classical homeopathy, laser acupuncture, magnetic field therapy and bioresonance. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars. New families register by phone, and online booking is open to existing clients.

listings.name: Praxis für Bioresonanz und Naturheilverfahren Martina Kluge Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Martina Kluge is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Efringen-Kirchen whose practice is built around bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, described as a regulation method borrowed from quantum physics. Separate pages explain what happens at the first appointment and in follow-up sessions. Other offers include the Physiokey, orthomolecular guidance, mycotherapy and homeopathy, and she runs seminars. The practice recommends booking ahead. Fees are listed on a dedicated page. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars. Women-owned, with wheelchair-accessible parking; appointments are recommended.

listings.name: ZAM - Zentrum für alternative Medizin Ulm Gerberhaus
listings.description: ZAM is a centre for alternative medicine at Weinhofberg 9 in Ulm, run by three Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioners). The offer covers TCM acupuncture, ear acupuncture, women's health, biodynamic craniosacral therapy, osteopathy, bioresonance, talk therapy and speech therapy. Bioresonance is presented as part of naturopathy and as a way to bring body, mind and soul into harmony. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerpraxis Menne-Wita
listings.description: Heilpraktikerpraxis Menne-Wita in Freiburg im Breisgau combines naturopathy and physiotherapy under Sabine Menne-Wita, who is both a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and a physiotherapist. Offers include classical homeopathy, manual therapy, Reiki, sleep counselling and Feng Shui consultations. Bioresonance sessions use the Quex Eductor, presented as a biofeedback system with over 12,000 parameters, built on quantum physics and described as non-invasive. Appointments are made by phone only. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all five stars. Free parking is available.

listings.name: Just Energetic Life - Stephanie Lecke
listings.description: Just Energetic Life is the Brühl practice of Stephanie Lecke, offering spiritual coaching and guidance for more than 20 years on partnership, career and life direction. The range includes kinesiology, psychological counselling, energy work, Spagyrik, human neuro cybrainetics, mediumistic readings and TimeWaver sessions, alongside jenergetic. Clients can also find a page on dog and human harmony. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all five stars. The practice also offers coaching, body intelligence and career direction sessions, with a fee page. Call ahead to confirm how sessions are booked.

listings.name: Om Shanti Natural Healing by Sonja
listings.description: Om Shanti Natural Healing by Sonja in Bad Peterstal-Griesbach makes and sells jewellery, prayer beads and accessories online, with custom pieces, repairs and reworking. Newly added are coaching, resonance and aura sessions for people and animals, and work with bioresonance, all possible online. Rated 5.0 from nine Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required, so call to confirm what is offered.

listings.name: Praxis Jörg Dieter Günther
listings.description: Praxis Jörg Dieter Günther is a private practice at Hardäckerstrasse 1 in Baden-Baden, run since 2008 by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who holds a Master of Medicine (yixue shuoshi) from Tianjin University, awarded in 2013. Since 2017 the practice has worked with the current Metapathia HOSPITAL version of the Metatron NLS system. Acupuncture is also among the listed specialties. Appointments are required, and credit and debit cards are accepted. Rated 5.0 from nine Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Kaiserstuhl
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Kaiserstuhl in Bötzingen am Kaiserstuhl is the practice of Simone Hohwieler, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, acupuncture and spinal therapy form the core of her work, supported by homeopathy, Bach flower therapy, phytotherapy, Dorn and Breuss spinal therapy, Pneumatron pulsation therapy, cold laser and family constellations. Rated 4.9 from 9 Google reviews, 8 of them five stars. The practice sits in a quiet setting.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Mannheim-Feudenheim Ute Schreieder
listings.description: Ute Schreieder works as a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Mannheim-Feudenheim, using a Rayonex bioresonance device in her sessions along with a second system from OrthoCell. Appointments are by arrangement. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Karra
listings.description: Maria Karra has worked as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) since 2001, with a main practice in Stuttgart-Bad Cannstatt and a branch in Meersburg on Lake Constance. Her focus areas are Traditional Chinese Medicine, acupuncture, BICOM bioresonance, EAV electroacupuncture measurement, cupping and homeopathy. A separate laser aesthetics service sits alongside. A first visit starts with an intake conversation, followed by an individual plan. Appointments can be booked online through Doctolib, by WhatsApp or by phone. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The practice is women-owned.

listings.name: GROW medical GmbH
listings.description: GROW medical GmbH is the parent company of the GROW group in Lahr in the Black Forest. Its units include BioKat Systeme GmbH, which develops and makes bioresonance and magnetic field devices for the wellness sector, via inventa essences, wirkend (psychological and family counselling) and the GROW Bioresonance Practice for energetic regulation. The group also supports therapists in setting up their own private practice. The practice offers a free introductory call of up to 15 minutes by phone or Zoom, and a first session with an energetic analysis lasts 1 to 2 hours. Managing director Andre Rasche also gives talks. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Juliane Stahnke
listings.description: Juliane Stahnke is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) for psychotherapy and bioresonance, with a Naturheilpraxis in Stuttgart West. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Opening hours are posted, and free and paid parking is available nearby.

listings.name: Bioresonanztherapie in Karlsruhe
listings.description: Elke Gerhardt is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who has run her Naturheilpraxis in Karlsruhe since 1986 and focuses on bioresonance with Regumed devices. The method is described as experience-based and not recognised by conventional medicine. It describes the body as a whole, and the practice offers a first-visit information page, seminars and lectures. She also trains licensed Heilpraktiker and physicians on the Bicom Optima. Appointments are required and are agreed by phone. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The practice is women-owned, welcomes LGBTQ clients and has free parking.

listings.name: Claudia Fügel
listings.description: Claudia Fügel runs a Naturheilpraxis (naturopathic practice) in Stuttgart that joins psychotherapy and natural medicine for body, mind and soul. The conversation-based methods include depth psychology, dream work and guided imagery, and the natural methods include bioresonance and plant-based approaches. Astrology is also used to explore deeper themes. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars. An appointment is recommended and opening hours are posted. Parking, entrance, seating and restroom are wheelchair accessible, and there is a hearing loop.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Remstal
listings.description: Heilpraxis Remstal in Remshalden is the practice of Anja Schneider-Leibbrand, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and osteopath. Bioresonance is a main method: sessions use a BICOM device and last about 30 to 60 minutes, with the client seated or lying comfortably while connected. A BICOM BodyCheck is also offered, alongside osteopathy. The practice has free parking and wheelchair-accessible parking, and appointments are by phone or through an online request, Tuesday to Thursday from 8:30 to 13:00 and 14:00 to 18:00. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Tanja Müller-Willis
listings.description: Tanja Müller-Willis is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a naturopathic practice in Schorndorf. She combines Traditional Chinese Medicine, including acupuncture, ear acupuncture and Chinese herbs, with bioresonance sessions that use a device after Paul Schmidt from Rayonex. Bioresonance is offered as a needle-free option, for example for children. The practice also offers Sound of Soul sessions for relaxation. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Johanna Chatti Inner Balance - Bioresonanz
listings.description: Inner Balance is the Friedrichshafen practice of Johanna Chatti, offering ORGANETIK bioresonance sessions with a holistic and individual approach. Sessions can also be held remotely, and a no-obligation first conversation is available by request. She states plainly that no outcome is promised. Organetik is presented as a bioresonance method that works on a subtle-energy level, aimed at inner balance for body, mind and soul, in a holistic, individual and solution-oriented way. Her pages also carry client references. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Regina Nicolaidis, M.A., Heilpraktikerin - Praxis für Biologische Medizin
listings.description: Regina Nicolaidis, M.A., is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Ehningen with a practice for what she calls biological medicine. Her bioenergetic procedures include bioresonance and the Bioscan, which work with the body's individual energy patterns. She also offers orthomolecular guidance on supplying the body with vitamins, minerals, trace elements and amino acids. Consultations are by appointment. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all five stars. Wheelchair-accessible parking is available.

listings.name: Armonia Gesundheitspraxis
listings.description: Armonia Gesundheitspraxis in Rainau offers bioresonance alongside health counselling, nutrition counselling, hormone counselling, chakra work and balance sessions. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars. Wheelchair-accessible parking is available, and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Dr. med. Heide Freifrau von Lüttwitz Ärztin
listings.description: Dr. med. Heide Freifrau von Lüttwitz is a physician in general practice in Eberhardzell who specialises in naturopathic methods, acupuncture and bioresonance. The practice lists holistic care, naturopathy, bioresonance and acupuncture, with appointments by arrangement. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars. The practice is at Lilienweg 18 in Eberhardzell and can be reached on 07355 91213. Wheelchair-accessible parking and entrance are available.

listings.name: Frau Kerstin Probst
listings.description: Kerstin Probst runs a naturopathic practice in Birkenfeld that works with homeopathy, phytotherapy, Bach flower therapy, electroacupuncture, ear acupuncture, bioresonance, Dorn and Breuss therapy, and nutrition counselling including supplements. First consultations are an extended intake session, and gift vouchers for them can be ordered by phone. Opening hours are posted and appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from four Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Mike Konzelmann
listings.description: Mike Konzelmann is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Ilsfeld. His sessions combine kinesiology, life counselling and hypnosis with electroacupuncture after Dr. Voll and bioresonance. He also offers classical homeopathy and psychokinesiology, under the heading of therapy for body, mind and soul. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all at five stars. Appointments are recommended, and parking is wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Anke P. Baß
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Anke P. Baß in Heidenheim offers bioresonance therapy alongside ear acupuncture, hypnotherapy, Bach flower therapy and gut rehabilitation. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all at five stars. The entrance is wheelchair accessible and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Esther Krais-Gutmann
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Krais-Gutmann in Freiburg im Breisgau is led by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) whose main areas are bioresonance, plant medicine, breathing therapy, ear acupuncture and nutrition counselling. Bioresonance programmes are put together for each person using a testing device in the practice. A short, free and non-binding first conversation can be arranged through the contact form, and appointments are by arrangement. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Karra
listings.description: Maria Karra has worked as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) since 2001 and runs a main practice in Stuttgart-Bad Cannstatt with a branch in Meersburg on Lake Constance. The range covers TCM and acupuncture, cupping, homeopathy, orthomolecular methods, EAV electro-acupuncture sessions and BICOM bioresonance, with laser aesthetics as a separate offer. A visit follows four steps: first conversation and intake, a review of the situation, an individual plan, then sessions with follow-up. Appointments can be booked online through Doctolib or requested by form, and invoices follow the Heilpraktiker fee schedule GebüH. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Susanne Schäuble
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Susanne Schäuble is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice at Segeten 29 in Görwihl. Susanne Schäuble works with plant-based therapy, Jin Shin Jyutsu and bioresonance sessions, and nutrition coaching is part of her approach. The practice also runs seminars. Sessions are individually planned and the focus is on wellbeing, stress management and a more balanced everyday life. Appointments are recommended, and the practice has free parking and wheelchair-accessible parking. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all four at five stars.

listings.name: NECK Lebensart / ThinkingPink
listings.description: NECK Lebensart in Bretzfeld-Dimbach is a wellness and mentoring practice led by Nicole Engelhardt. It offers wellness, aroma and sports massages, one-to-one mentoring and energetic resonance analyses, working with frequency systems such as ZYTO, Visera and Healy. Aura and coaching analyses with a written report can also be done at a distance. A free 20-minute introductory call is held online by Zoom or phone. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars. The venue describes a wellness programme for work and life balance, and the venue has free parking and welcomes LGBTQ clients.

listings.name: Privatärztliche Praxis Wolfgang Krätzler
listings.description: Privatärztliche Praxis Wolfgang Krätzler in Vogt is a private practice led by a general practitioner. Alongside conventional work it offers a range of naturopathic methods, among them acupuncture, bioresonance, herbal medicine, nutrition medicine, Scenar therapy and preventive well-aging care. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Schwarzwald-Tierheilpraxis Birgit Thurau
listings.description: Schwarzwald-Tierheilpraxis Birgit Thurau in Laufenburg is run by a certified Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who is also an animal Heilpraktiker, animal behaviour therapist and bioresonance therapist. She works with people and animals using homeopathy, Bach flowers, bioresonance therapy and vital mushrooms. The practice website also runs an online shop that sells hoof boots for horses and supplements for horses, dogs and cats, as well as products for people. The shop also has a bioresonance analysis and hair analysis section. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Therapiezentrum Birkenfeld Bernhard Rambach
listings.description: This Birkenfeld center, led by Bernhard Rambach, offers osteopathy including osteopathy for children, bioresonance, Penzel acupressure massage, chiropractic work and naturopathy. Opening hours are posted and appointments are recommended. Parking is free and the entrance, seating and restroom are wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from four Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: vitalvita Praxis Ariane Nickel
listings.description: vitalvita is a practice in Ravensburg for whole-person wellbeing and quality of life. Its offers for body, energy and vitality include biofeedback and bioresonance with SCIO and Neuroremotebalance, kinesiology and psycho-kinesiology, and wellness consulting with life-balance and vital-balance profiles. Appointments are booked online, and sessions can run over Zoom, with a link and reminders sent by email. Advice beforehand is free of charge. A monthly online group practice, a guided meditation of about 35 minutes, meets on Zoom on the last Wednesday of the month at 20:00. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Carmen Büge
listings.description: Carmen Büge is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a Naturheilpraxis in Karlsruhe and Pfinztal. Her specialities include hypnosis after Milton Erickson, Subliminal Therapy after Edwin Yager and the TimeWaver Med and TimeWaver Frequency information-field systems, with a TimeWaver Home option also on offer. She adds classical natural medicine with homeopathy and phytotherapy, Ortho Bionomy, applied kinesiology, Touch for Health, Brain Gym, Ayurveda, Reiki and Jin Shin Jyutsu. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. An appointment is recommended.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Christina Kreiselmeyer
listings.description: Heilpraxis Christina Kreiselmeyer is a naturopathic practice in Schrozberg with a focus on homeopathy and bioresonance sessions, alongside other natural methods. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars. The practice is in Schrozberg, a small town in the Schwäbisch Hall district of Baden-Württemberg.

listings.name: Julia Zeller Heilpraktikerin - Dunkelfeldmikroskopie, Bio- Thermologie, Craniosacrale Osteopathie, Kiefer RESET
listings.description: Julia Zeller is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Reutlingen with a naturopathic practice. Her offer includes bioresonance, craniosacral osteopathy, Dorn-Breuss, Kiefer R.E.S.E.T. and BEMER, and she teaches courses in dark-field microscopy and an introduction to craniosacral osteopathy. Appointments are recommended and can be booked online or by phone. The practice also belongs to a local naturopathy association. Rated 5.0 from three Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Claudia Diekmann (Heilpraktikerin)
listings.description: Claudia Diekmann is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a practice on Austraße in Frickingen, near Überlingen, Salem and Heiligenberg in the Bodensee district. Her site is organised around biofield and bioresonance sessions. The practice has wheelchair accessible parking and a restroom, is reachable by phone and email, and recommends booking an appointment. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Kunert, Bioresonanz, Kinesiologie, Homöopathie
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Kunert in Weinheim is run by Dr. rer. nat. Katrin Kunert, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and biologist. Her three main areas are kinesiology, bioresonance and homeopathy, which she groups together as regulation methods, alongside naturopathic care for children and women. Rated 5.0 from three Google reviews, all five stars. Parking is wheelchair accessible, and appointments are recommended. Call or write to ask how a bioresonance session is run.

listings.name: Praxis Leuchtkraft am Kaiserstuhl
listings.description: Praxis Leuchtkraft is a naturopathic practice at the Kaiserstuhl in Vogtsburg, run by Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Inge Jakob-Jackl and serving the Emmendingen, Freiburg and Bad Krozingen area. Bioresonance sessions use the NLS system. The practice also offers foot reflexology, ear acupuncture, holistic pulsing, cupping and health coaching with EFT, family constellations and meditation. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: private Kinderarztpraxis
listings.description: This private practice in Stuttgart-Zuffenhausen is run by Dr. med. Stefanie Krohne-Reichert, a physician specialised in paediatrics and adolescent medicine. Its approach sees the person as a unity of body, soul and mind. Bioresonance sessions are done with a BICOM optima device from Regumed, and an individual plan is drawn up with the client. The practice also offers nutrition counselling. Appointments can be booked online, by phone or by email. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Opening hours are posted and an appointment is recommended.

listings.name: Rebeccas mobile Tierheilpraxis
listings.description: Rebeccas mobile Tierheilpraxis serves Konstanz and the surrounding area. Rebecca Bloch is an animal Heilpraktiker (alternative practitioner for animals), dog nutrition adviser and life coach who supports dogs and their owners. Sessions use the TimeWaver system, which works without touch and independent of location, alongside Bach flower therapy and nutrition counselling for dogs. She also uses TimeWaver sessions for people. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars. Online appointments are offered. Further training with the TimeWaver Academy has run since 2023, and the practice works as a mobile service.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Trinkle
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Trinkle in Gschwend focuses on nutrition and metabolism, classical homeopathy, acupuncture and bioresonance after Paul Schmidt. It also offers massage, Osteobalance, Shiatsu and Sotai, Shonishin, moxibustion and talks under the heading of easier healthy living. After a session, an individual plan is drawn up together with the client. Appointments are recommended. Rated 4.3 from 3 Google reviews, 2 of them five stars.

listings.name: Bianca Hommer Naturheilpraxis Gezeiten Mutterland
listings.description: Bianca Hommer is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Schutterwald in the Ortenaukreis. Her practice, Gezeiten Mutterland, combines spinal therapy, bioresonance sessions, essence shamanism, spagyrics, mycotherapy and Essence Key coaching. Offers for animals include massage and sound therapy for horses and dogs, and some sessions can be done at a distance. Colour light, frequency and magnetic field therapy are also part of the range. The team is looking for a small farm in the region to build a place where people and animals support each other.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Marion Teufel
listings.description: Marion Teufel is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Fellbach. Her practice offers bioresonance sessions, foot reflexology, classical homeopathy, mycotherapy with vital mushrooms and individual nutrition counselling, for children and adults. A first conversation is used to set up a plan that fits each person. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Petra Hehle-Schipke
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Petra Hehle-Schipke in Reutlingen offers Ayurveda, bioresonance, ear acupuncture, nutrition counselling and family constellations. Opening hours are posted and appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from two Google reviews, both five stars. Call ahead to ask how a bioresonance session is run.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Yaping Wu-Gottwald
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Yaping Wu-Gottwald in Graben-Neudorf is run by Yaping Wu-Gottwald, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) trained in traditional Chinese medicine. Sessions include Regumed bioresonance, foot reflexology, Breuss and Dorn work and Bach flower therapy. Training listed includes Bach flower therapy and foot reflexology, and she has assisted a Regumed bioresonance practitioner in Rheinstetten. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Praxis für Osteopathie und Naturheilkunde Sabine Pander
listings.description: Sabine Pander's practice in Eisenbach offers osteopathy, Dorn spinal work, craniosacral therapy, bioresonance, hydroxypathy and general naturopathic methods. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Wheelchair-accessible parking is available and appointments are recommended. Call to confirm hours and how to book.

listings.name: via inventa
listings.description: Via inventa is a practice in Freiburg im Breisgau, at Rehlingstraße 16, led by Dr. Juliane Hesse. It focuses on classical homeopathy and bioresonance, offered together in an integrative concept that can run alongside conventional care. Sessions cover common wellbeing topics such as sleep, stress and life phases like pregnancy and menopause. The via inventa publishing house and a research section run under the same name. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Britta Rast Heilpraktikerin Komplementärmedizin
listings.description: Britta Rast is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Großbottwar who offers advice and support with MORA bioresonance sessions. Her range also includes interval hypoxia-hyperoxia training (IHHT), an altitude-style programme, and sports performance optimisation. The practice has wheelchair accessible parking and a restroom, and appointments are recommended. Her practice is listed as complementary medicine, contact is by email, and opening hours are not posted. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Karin Linzmeier - Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Karin Linzmeier in Angelbachtal is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice offering bioresonance, kinesiology, classical homeopathy, acupuncture, Schüssler salts, nutrition advice, autogenic training and meditation, and foot reflexology after Hanne Marquardt. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call ahead to confirm opening times and availability.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Laucken, Heilpraktiker Jan Laucken
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Laucken is a naturopathic practice at Käsenbachstraße 18 in Tübingen, run by Jan and Eva Laucken. Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Jan Laucken offers bioresonance therapy next to homeopathy, acupuncture, ear acupuncture, laser therapy, phytotherapy and foot reflexology. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: 360 gesund Martina Mahner Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: 360 gesund is a naturopathy practice in Calw run by Martina Mahner, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner), for people who feel tired, stressed or out of balance. Bioresonance is listed among its offers, alongside dark-field microscopy, cupping, Dorn therapy and the Yager Code. Call ahead to confirm sessions and appointments.

listings.name: Bioresonanz HM
listings.description: Bioresonanz HM in Obersontheim is a coaching centre that offers energetic coaching with the TimeWaver system. Maps categorises it as a coaching center. Call to confirm availability and how a session works before you plan around it.

listings.name: Bioresonanz Kaltenbach
listings.description: Sabine Kaltenbach offers bioresonance in Villingen-Schwenningen. She qualified in 2015 as an animal practitioner (Tierheilpraktikerin, VDT) at the Paracelsusschule and began offering bioresonance after seeing results in her family and circle of friends. Besides sessions in person, a hair sample can be sent from anywhere in Germany, with the results discussed in a phone call. The practice describes bioresonance as an alternative concept that is not scientifically recognised. Villingen-Schwenningen lies in the Black Forest-Baar district of Baden-Württemberg. Appointments are made through the contact page or by phone.

listings.name: Dentosophie am Rhein
listings.description: Dentosophie am Rhein is a private dental practice in Bietigheim that takes a whole-person approach, with a focus on jaw function and on children's development. Alongside its dental work it lists kinesiology, acupuncture, anxiety coaching, neural therapy and bioresonance sessions. Its dentistry also covers jaw orthodontics for children and teenagers, ceramic implants and care for babies and small children. Appointments are recommended, and the practice has wheelchair-accessible parking, so call ahead to ask about bioresonance.

listings.name: GanzMensch - Praxen für Gesundheit
listings.description: GanzMensch is a group of practices in Karlsruhe covering gut health and phytotherapy, psychotherapy, hypnosis, TimeWaver, craniosacral work, osteopathy and yoga with a focus on the jaw joint. Appointments are required. There are no Google reviews yet, so call to confirm availability and which of these offers each practitioner provides.

listings.name: Heilendes Wissen
listings.description: Heilendes Wissen in Erlenbach bei Dahn is listed as a massage spa. Its offers include bioresonance measurement sessions, high-frequency vitalisation, aura work, energetic house cleansing, galvanic fine current and energy seminars. Hours are posted. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are currently available.

listings.name: Körper & Klang
listings.description: Körper & Klang is the practice of Claudia Gabriele Horn, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Obernheim who works with children, families and adults. Her methods are Ortho-Bionomy, KinFlex, neurocentred training, sound therapy and sound pedagogy, coaching and relaxation. She also offers sessions that connect with the information field using TimeWaver. A free first conversation is available. Her practice also offers parent coaching, a sound room and learning support for children, as well as relaxation and mindfulness training, youth coaching and spiritual numerology.

listings.name: Naturheilkundezentrum Langenargen GmbH
listings.description: Naturheilkundezentrum Langenargen is a naturopathy centre on Lake Constance in Langenargen, led by Dr. Markus Tebartz, a specialist physician in general medicine with a focus on naturopathic methods and acupuncture. It lists MORA bioresonance therapy next to acupuncture, cupping, laser therapy, scalar and biophoton therapy, computer magnetic field therapy, craniosacral therapy, lipo-massage and nutrition counselling. The centre describes natural and conventional medicine as one energetic whole and also announces Christian meditations and talks.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis für Homöopathie Hans Christian Hinne
listings.description: Hans Christian Hinne runs a naturopathy practice in Isny im Allgäu with homeopathy as its main method. Plant-based therapy, orthomolecular nutrition, bioresonance and magnetic field therapy with special devices complete the range. The bioresonance sessions are described as working with the body's own vibrations. The practice also publishes articles and a talk on its methods. Appointments are by arrangement.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Heidi Herdel-Furtner
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Heidi Herdel-Furtner in Obersulm is the practice of a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who uses the BICOM bioresonance method. A bioenergetic health check scans the frequency patterns of the whole body. She supports women through menopause with bioresonance, homeopathy and Bach flowers. A free first phone conversation is offered to work out how she can best help. The check gives an overview of the current energetic state, and an individual plan of sessions follows from it. The practice also describes the BICOM method and explains what bioresonance is.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Helga Geiger
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Helga Geiger in Tübingen offers acupuncture, foot reflexology massage, Shiatsu, gentle spinal work after Dorn, Breuss massage, BEMER physical vascular therapy and Oberon analysis. Call ahead to confirm opening times and how a session is booked.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis-Manfredi
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis-Manfredi in Ludwigsburg combines traditional Chinese medicine with bioresonance, using a BICOM device in its sessions. Body, skull and ear acupuncture, cupping, Gua Sha and talk therapy after Carl Rogers complete the range, and the practitioner cites more than 30 years of experience with an approach of listening, understanding and accompanying. Hours are posted and appointments are recommended. Call ahead to book.

listings.name: Naturmedizin bodensee
listings.description: Naturmedizin Bodensee is a naturopathic practice in Überlingen run by Viola Wider, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who has practised in the second generation since 2011. The focus is bioresonance and biofeedback, with acupuncture, homeopathy, kinesiology, iris analysis and colour therapy. Children are also seen. Telephone consultation and sessions are available for clients who live further away, and a first visit in the practice includes a detailed conversation, where clients bring their supplements.

listings.name: Peter Gehrke Gesundheitspraxis
listings.description: Peter Gehrke runs a health practice in Deizisau focused on frequency technology and bioresonance with the Lakhovsky multiwave oscillator. He also offers fascia impulse regulation and Bowtech, the original Bowen technique, for deep muscular relaxation. The practice has wheelchair-accessible parking. Call ahead to confirm how sessions are booked.

listings.name: Pia Enderle, Naturpraxis Lichtblick
listings.description: Naturpraxis Lichtblick in Ettenheim is led by Pia Enderle and offers frequency-based sessions, including TimeWaver sessions, plus Healy consultations. The practice also provides awareness training in the style of Kurt Tepperwein with coaching, seminars and a practice group, along with aroma massage, cupping massage and alkaline applications after P. Jentschura. Call ahead to confirm what a visit involves.

listings.name: Praxis für Psychotherapie nach HPG, Psychosomatik und Bioresonanztherapie
listings.description: This Konstanz practice for psychotherapy offers bioresonance sessions with a bioresonance device. It also provides psychotherapy based on behavioural therapy, Gestalt therapy, Rogers talk therapy, EFT and focusing, plus relaxation methods such as Jin Shin Jyutsu and progressive muscle relaxation. A free trial session is possible. Call ahead to book.

listings.name: Wohlfühl-aktiv Rainer 'Lessmann
listings.description: Wohlfühl-aktiv in Wertheim am Main combines a health shop with a practice for light and bioresonance. The practice works with TimeWaver bioresonance, a Schumann 3D plate, TimeWaver Sport for fitness, muscle training and body-building programmes, business optimisation and a sound lounger. Call ahead to confirm opening times and session details.

listings.name: Bioresonanz Otto
listings.description: Bioresonanz Otto is an alternative practitioner in Heilbronn rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended and the entrance is wheelchair accessible. Call ahead to confirm which sessions and equipment are on offer.

listings.name: Bioresonanz Zentrum Wiesloch/ Naturheilpraxis Gigl
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Gigl in Wiesloch, south of Heidelberg in the Rhine-Neckar district of Baden-Württemberg, is listed as an alternative medicine practitioner. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call ahead for opening hours and to ask which services are offered.

listings.name: Allergie und Naturheilzentrum Bioresonanz
listings.description: Allergie und Naturheilzentrum Bioresonanz is based in Titisee-Neustadt, a lake and holiday town in the southern Black Forest, in the Breisgau-Hochschwarzwald district of Baden-Württemberg. Phone the business to ask about opening hours and the sessions it offers.

listings.name: Allergie und Naturheilzentrum Bioresonanz in Endingen
listings.description: This naturopathic centre in Endingen am Kaiserstuhl is categorised as an alternative practitioner and a biofeedback therapist. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are offered, which days it is open and how to book an appointment.

listings.name: Birgit Häge Heilbronn - Naturheilpraxis - Dorn Therapie - Bioresonanz
listings.description: Birgit Häge's Naturheilpraxis in Heilbronn is listed as an alternative practitioner, and the name pairs Dorn therapy with bioresonance. Appointments are recommended. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are on offer before you book.

listings.name: Gemeinschaftspraxis Zimmermann Bioresonanztherapie Chelat-Therapie
listings.description: Gemeinschaftspraxis Zimmermann is a group doctors' practice in Bietigheim-Bissingen. Google lists it under acupuncture clinic, acupuncturist and general practitioner, and its name includes bioresonance. Opening hours are posted and appointments are recommended. Call ahead to ask whether bioresonance sessions are available and how they work.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Makris Praxis für sanfte Medizin & Ästhetik Erika Makris
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Makris in Rödermark, in the Offenbach district of Hesse, led by Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Erika Makris, is a practice specialising in bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, using a Rayonex device. It also offers hypnosis, EMDR, acupuncture, homeopathy, coaching, nutrition advice and other naturopathic methods, alongside cosmetic services. The practice has wheelchair-accessible parking, a restroom and posted opening hours, and appointments are required. The Pferde in Balance programme brings bioresonance to horses. Rated 4.7 from 88 Google reviews, 81 of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraxis zur Quelle mit SuperVision Shanna Becker
listings.description: Heilpraxis zur Quelle in Rabenau, Hessen, is led by Shanna Becker, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her range includes bioresonance sessions, ear acupuncture, homeopuncture, Su Jok acupuncture, SCENAR, ear candle and moxa sessions, hypnosis and regression hypnosis, light and energy work, Bach flowers and mushroom therapy. Coaching, counselling and therapy conversations are available online, and seminars and training courses are offered. Rated 5.0 from 37 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Dr. med. Christina Herz-Hock, Urologe
listings.description: Dr. med. Christina Herz-Hock is a physician specialising in urology in Wiesbaden. Besides her urology practice she offers bioresonance sessions, homeopathy and naturopathic methods. Rated 4.7 from 24 Google reviews, 22 of them five stars and 2 one star. Call to ask how bioresonance sessions are booked.

listings.name: NaturaPathie
listings.description: In Kronberg im Taunus, Yasmin van der Heijden runs NaturaPathie as a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) for children, teenagers, adults and animals. Her tools include bioresonance with the Organo method, Organetik, kinesiology with tensor, homeopathy, Bach flowers, Schüssler salts, essential oils, ear acupuncture, hypnosis and EMDR. A long first conversation of 60 to 90 minutes opens the work, and a free introductory call of about 15 minutes is offered. Home visits are possible in the Hochtaunuskreis. Rated 5.0 from 16 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Katja Winter
listings.description: Katja Winter is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Vellmar near Kassel who works from two locations. The main practice at Kieler Straße 26 is where bioresonance with the BICOM device is done, and the practice at Rathausplatz 4 in the health centre is used for appointments by arrangement. Her work centres on gut and cell wellbeing, nutrition and vital substances, stress regulation, aromatherapy and Raindrop massage. TimeWaver is also part of her range. Rated 4.9 from 16 Google reviews, 15 of them five stars. Call ahead to book.

listings.name: Praxis Helianthus
listings.description: Praxis Helianthus in Neu-Eichenberg opened on 1 October 2000 and offers classical homeopathy, psychotherapy (TA), bioresonance therapy and a BBC scan with Ilka Neuendorf. Courses, talks, coaching and constellations are available through the Institut Koco. Rated 5.0 from 14 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required, and a free lot is on site. The practice marked its 25th anniversary in 2025.

listings.name: Die mit der Katze spricht Heilpraxis für Mensch und Tier Verena Riedl
listings.description: Die mit der Katze spricht is the practice of Verena Riedl, a Tierheilpraktikerin (animal naturopath) in Rüsselsheim and a member of the Verband Deutscher Tierheilpraktiker. She supports dogs, cats, horses and people with Bach flowers, homeopathy, bioresonance, aromatherapy, colour light and animal communication. Home visits cover the Rhein-Main area, and online consultation runs through a WhatsApp session. The practice also runs an online shop with natural products for people and animals. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde und Osteopathie
listings.description: Praxis für Naturheilkunde und Osteopathie in Gross-Umstadt is the naturopathy and osteopathy practice of Katharina Sperling. Pages cover bioresonance, osteopathy, the EMMETT technique, ear acupuncture and prevention. Bioresonance is described as a naturopathic method adapted to each client. The practice is owned by a woman, offers on-site services and has a lactation space. Free street and lot parking are available. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Ulrike Scheitler Heilpraktikerin Schmerztherapie
listings.description: Ulrike Scheitler is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Wetzlar. She offers bioresonance, TCM acupuncture, chiropractic, spinal work after Dorn, and foot reflexology massage. Rated 4.7 from 14 Google reviews, 13 of them five stars. A TCM back check is part of the offer, and she says she fulfilled a dream by opening her own practice. Wetzlar lies in the Lahn valley in central Hesse.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Martina Körner
listings.description: In Ahnatal, Martina Körner practises as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and offers sessions built around an Oberon bioresonance analysis, described as simple, quick and uncomplicated. The practice recommends booking an appointment and has wheelchair-accessible parking and entrance. Rated 4.9 from 12 Google reviews, 11 of them five stars. Call ahead to confirm opening times.

listings.name: Heilpraxis zur Quelle mit SuperVision Shanna Becker
listings.description: Heilpraxis zur Quelle in Hohenroda is led by Shanna Becker, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Bioresonance sessions come with ear acupuncture, Su Jok acupuncture, hypnosis, SCENAR therapy, moxa, ear candle therapy, light therapy, energy work and Bach flower therapy. Coaching and online counselling and therapy are also offered, and there are seminars and training courses. Appointments are required. Parking, including a free garage, is available and wheelchair accessible. Rated 4.9 from 12 Google reviews, 11 of them five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Osteopathie Ann-Kathrin Wex
listings.description: Ann-Kathrin Wex runs an osteopathy practice at Kurstrasse 16 in Bad Nauheim. She is a certified osteopath, a state-recognised physiotherapist and a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner), working with children and adults. Her offer also includes magnetic field therapy, manual lymph drainage, acupuncture and bioresonance. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Wurzelwerk
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Wurzelwerk in Reichelsheim, run by Anna Eßinger and formerly called Naturheilpraxis Anna Knapp, offers bioresonance sessions. Further offers are back reflexology, orthomolecular consulting, plant-based preparations and homeopathic complex preparations. Opening hours are posted, and the practice has wheelchair-accessible parking and entrance. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Marleen Sonnenschein
listings.description: Marleen Sonnenschein is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Vellmar who specialises in psychotherapy, with couples counselling alongside it. Her work also includes nutrition counselling and bioresonance therapy, described as a frequency-based addition to her nutrition work. Online appointment booking is available. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to confirm how a session is structured.

listings.name: Praxis für Prävention und Ganzheitsmedizin, Pia Schwarzbach, Ärztin
listings.description: Pia Schwarzbach is a physician who runs a practice for prevention and holistic care in Hessisch Lichtenau. Bioresonance sessions are offered with a bioresonance device, together with homeopathy, Bach flower therapy, kinesiology, vital field therapy and health courses including yoga. Appointments are required. The entrance, seating and restroom are wheelchair accessible, a hearing loop is available, and there is free parking. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all at five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerpraxis Pia Settembre
listings.description: Heilpraktikerpraxis Pia Settembre is a naturopathic practice in Frankfurt am Main. Bioresonance after Paul Schmidt is its main method, joined by gentle energy work aimed at bringing body, mind and soul into balance, with attention to the energy system and to stress. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended, so call ahead to book and to confirm what a first session involves.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Anja Igel
listings.description: Anja Igel is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) for people and animals with a naturopathic practice in Söhrewald, near Kassel. Her range includes homeopathy, bioresonance and BEMER sessions. Rated 4.9 from 8 Google reviews, 7 of them five stars and 1 four stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Bianca Wittlich
listings.description: Bianca Wittlich runs a naturopathy practice in Hünstetten as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Bioresonance sessions are offered together with fascia therapy and hypnosis, and the practice also offers courses, coaching and gift vouchers. Appointments are required, after a detailed first conversation. Parking is wheelchair accessible, and the practice also features a hypnosis-based gastric band offer exclusive to it. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all at five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Silke Zirnstein
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Silke Zirnstein is a naturopathic practice in Frankfurt am Main run by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with 15 years in practice. She also has a background as a specialist nurse in anaesthesia and intensive care since 1989. The methods named are acupuncture, bioresonance, Bowtech, homeopathy and Pneumatron massage. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required, so call ahead to book.

listings.name: Heilpraxis zur Quelle mit SuperVision Shanna Becker
listings.description: Heilpraxis zur Quelle in Bad Nauheim is the practice of Shanna Becker, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Methods include ear acupuncture, homeopuncture, bioresonance, SCENAR therapy, ear candle therapy, moxa, hypnosis, regression hypnosis, light therapy, energy work, Bach flowers, breath work and stress reduction. Online counselling and coaching are offered, and seminars and trainings run alongside. Appointments are required. Women-owned, with free parking. Rated 5.0 from six Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Tina Knabe - Praxis für alternative Therapien
listings.description: Tina Knabe runs an alternative therapy practice in Neuhof offering quantum biofeedback and bioresonance sessions with a SCIO device, which can also be done at a distance, along with scans of energy and information fields. An HRV scan covers stress level, and hypnosis is available in person or online by WhatsApp. Life counselling, card reading and pendulum work are also on offer. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Dr.med.dent. Lydia Martin
listings.description: Dr. med. dent. Lydia Martin is a dentist in Maintal who also offers bioresonance sessions with a Bicom device as a wellness add-on. Rated 3.9 from 11 Google reviews. Parking, entrance and restroom are wheelchair accessible. Call ahead to confirm the session options.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Heike Dombo
listings.description: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Heike Dombo is a naturopathic practice in Wiesbaden. Its methods are bioresonance and acupuncture, and its practitioner is also a grief counsellor and a specialist in animal-assisted therapy. Rated 4.4 from 8 Google reviews, 6 of them five stars. Call to confirm how to book.

listings.name: Praxis für ganzheitliche Gelenktherapie
listings.description: Praxis für ganzheitliche Gelenktherapie in Glauburg is led by a chiropractor with more than 20 years of experience. The main focus is chiropractic and a six-week concept that combines chiropractic, dry needling and ear acupuncture. Bioresonance is offered as an additional service, and physiotherapy is available as well. Appointments are by arrangement, with wheelchair accessible parking, entrance and restroom. Rated 4.0 from 10 Google reviews, 7 of them five stars.
