listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Susanne Klann - Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Susanne Klann practises naturopathy in Langen as a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner), working with biodynamic craniosacral therapy, acupuncture, nutrient support and Bicom bioresonance. Other pages cover visceral therapy, ear acupuncture, acupressure, cupping and Emotion Code. Consultation hours are organised around themes such as environment, jaw, vitality and stress. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended and the practice takes enquiries online.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Ute Ogroske
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Ute Ogroske in Dillenburg lists bioresonance among a broad range of natural methods. The practice also offers TCM acupuncture, classical homeopathy, energy and information work, Mitosan vital field frequency sessions, Schöndorfstrom, pneumatron suction massage and wellness with essential oils. Appointments are by arrangement. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all five stars. Wheelchair-accessible parking is available. Call to confirm which methods are currently offered.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Annette Ullrich
listings.description: Annette Ullrich is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Langen whose practice pages are organised around the MORA Nova device, with further pages for Hydrosun and Pneumatron. Bioresonance sessions are part of her work, and the practice is based on appointments only. Parking is wheelchair accessible and a restroom is available. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Sandra Ende
listings.description: Sandra Ende is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Wald-Michelbach in the Odenwald. Her focus is traditional Chinese medicine with classic acupuncture, bioresonance, body-oriented work and coaching. She adds suggestions on lifestyle, movement exercises and self-regulation, and supports people through difficult life phases, decisions and transitions. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Astrid Thielen
listings.description: Astrid Thielen runs a naturopathy practice as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with locations in Homberg (Efze) and Langen. Her wide range includes a Bioscan, TimeWaver sessions and building harmonisation, along with Dorn and Breuss spinal therapy, massage, hot stone massage, hypnosis for children and adults, ear acupuncture, kinesiology, movement coaching and nutrition advice. Pets are welcome too, with home visits arranged by appointment. Appointments are by arrangement only. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all at five stars.

listings.name: Institut Brand
listings.description: Institut Brand in Eschwege is a TimeWaver centre led by Christiane Brand, who has used the system for more than 17 years. The team reports about 35,000 TimeWaver sessions in ten years and has trained over 1,000 users. A free first session can be requested. The institute also advises on buying a TimeWaver, runs seminars, an online academy and individual training, and offers private and business coaching, with a training centre in Mallorca. Rated 4.8 from 4 Google reviews.

listings.name: Bioresonanztherapie Heilpraktikerin Franca Zachert
listings.description: Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Franca Zachert has a naturopathic practice in Frankfurt am Main with bioresonance at its centre. Her focus areas include high sensitivity, psychosomatic counselling and support for physical, emotional and spiritual development. Sessions are held in German, English or French, and appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Street parking nearby is free. Call ahead to book a time.

listings.name: Claus-Dieter Marowsky
listings.description: Claus-Dieter Marowsky practises in Königstein im Taunus. His listed offers include bioresonance, hypnosis, coaching, individual coaching, couples therapy and animal naturopathy. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are offered and how to book.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Sattler
listings.description: Heilpraxis Sattler in Seligenstadt is run by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who has worked in counselling since 1993 and added coaching for personal development, Heilpraktiker status for psychotherapy in 2006 and unrestricted Heilpraktiker status in 2016. Focus areas are psychosomatics, stress and nutrition. Methods include bioresonance, biocybernetics, frequency-based methods, herbs and teas, manual therapy, talk therapy, Pranic work, yoga and Qigong. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Andrea Hülpüsch
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Andrea Hülpüsch is a naturopathic practice in Wiesbaden offering bioresonance, kinesiology, homeopathy, Schüßler salts, Bach flowers, hypnosis and talk-based support. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Call to confirm how a session runs and when to book.

listings.name: Praxis für Schwingungsmedizin
listings.description: Praxis für Schwingungsmedizin in Knüllwald is led by Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Stefan Danz, with Heike Tiburczy named alongside him. The practice describes vibrational medicine as its focus. Listed methods include bioresonance with meridian measurement, radionics with TimeWaver technology, electroacupuncture after Dr. Voll and homeopathy, including miasmatic homeopathy. Its Maps categories add homeopath and naturopathic practitioner. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Appointments are recommended, and parking and entrance are wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Naturheilzentrum Blum
listings.description: Naturheilzentrum Blum in Wiesbaden is a team of Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioners) founded by Claudia Böhm-Blum, working in naturopathy for more than 30 years. Bioresonance sessions sit alongside electroacupuncture after Dr. Voll, iris analysis, homeopathy and acupuncture. The centre also works with several other Heilpraktiker methods. Rated 3.7 from 3 Google reviews, 2 of them five stars and one a single star. Call to confirm which methods are available.

listings.name: Privatpraxis Dr. Ulrike Schellhaas
listings.description: Dr. Ulrike Schellhaas is a physician specialising in dermatology who also practises homeopathy, at Rheinstraße 26 in Darmstadt. Her private practice lists bioresonance sessions among its additional offers. Rated 3.7 from 3 Google reviews, 2 of them five stars and 1 one star. Appointments are recommended. Online booking is not offered, so contact the practice directly to ask how bioresonance sessions are arranged. She is also listed as a homeopath and phlebologist (vein specialist), and the practice also lists homeopathy among its offers.

listings.name: Zeit & Raum - Praxis für Osteopathie & Bioresonanz
listings.description: Zeit & Raum is a practice for osteopathy and bioresonance in the Odenwald, in Oberzent, run by Samira Siefert, a physiotherapist, Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and osteopath. Alongside osteopathy she offers bioresonance therapy using the Rayocomb PS 10 device from Rayonex Biomedical GmbH. She qualified as a state-recognised physiotherapist in 2010, and a page explains the duration of a session. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Boos-Schuth
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Boos-Schuth in Schöneck is run by Heike Boos-Schuth under the name Naturheilpraxis Energie. Bioresonance is presented as a complementary, energy-based method in the naturopathic tradition, offered as accompaniment for body awareness and balance. The practice also works with a nutrition concept, ear acupuncture, cupping, stress management, Reiki and seminars. Rated 4.0 from one Google review. Call ahead to confirm session details.

listings.name: Bärbel Schulze, Heilpraktikerin, Praxis für ganzheitliche Gesundheit
listings.description: Bärbel Schulze, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner), runs a practice in Rodgau-Jügesheim serving the Frankfurt, Offenbach and Hanau area. Her focus areas are bioresonance sessions, acupuncture, classical homeopathy, laser therapy, MiltaPad light and magnetic field sessions, and manual methods. Children are welcome. Appointments are made by phone or online, Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 13:00 and 14:00 to 18:00. The practice has free parking and wheelchair access.

listings.name: Bioresonanz Fulda - Praxis für Naturmedizin
listings.description: Bioresonanz Fulda is a naturopathy practice in Burghaun serving the Fulda area. It offers bioresonance sessions with a BICOM device and a DeltaScan bioenergetic whole-body scan, together with acupuncture including Japanese skull acupuncture (YNSA). Sessions are given only after a phone appointment. The practice is reached by phone for appointments only and offers Japanese skull acupuncture alongside bioresonance, with a page of room impressions. Call ahead to confirm hours and what a first visit involves, since the practice works by appointment only; wheelchair-accessible parking is available.

listings.name: Birgit Jacobs Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Birgit Jacobs is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who also runs Yogaschule Jacobs in Löhnberg-Niedershausen. Her offers include yoga, Ayurveda, bioresonance therapy and homeopathy. The yoga school publishes a weekly class schedule for adults on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, online yoga lessons for 2026 and yoga for pregnant women.

listings.name: Britta Kresse
listings.description: Britta Kresse has worked as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) since 2002 and runs Naturheilpraxis Kresse in Immenhausen near Kassel. Bioresonance therapy is offered with homeopathy, ear acupuncture, Baunscheidt therapy, magnetic field therapy, plant-based therapy, flower therapy and moxa. Home visits are possible, and the practice sees babies, children and adults. Appointments are by arrangement.

listings.name: Christina Orth, Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Christina Orth is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in the group Naturheilpraxis Schöneck in Hessen, which she shares with Monika Gerhardus, Birgit Haake and Mirjam Dziedo. The practice lists bioresonance sessions among its offers, together with classical homeopathy, acupuncture and skull acupuncture after Yamamoto, Bach flowers, Schüssler biochemistry, Dorn therapy, cupping, hypnosis, phytotherapy and baby massage. Call ahead to book a time and confirm which practitioner offers what.

listings.name: Hiringa Naturheilpraxis- Heilpraktikerin Melanie Tonner
listings.description: Hiringa Naturheilpraxis in Amöneburg is the practice of Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Melanie Tonner. Listed focus areas are craniosacral therapy, homeopathy, bioresonance sessions, relaxation methods and Dorn therapy. Opening hours are posted, appointments are recommended, and parking is wheelchair accessible. Call to confirm what a first visit involves.

listings.name: Life Naturheilpraxis Petra Gregor Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Life Naturheilpraxis Petra Gregor in Friedewald is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice whose Maps entry lists bioresonance, magnetic field therapy, classical homeopathy and reincarnation therapy. It recommends booking an appointment and has wheelchair accessible parking. Opening hours are not posted, so call ahead to confirm services and times.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Hochtaunus
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Hochtaunus in Kronberg describes an energy-focused approach to wellbeing, looking at the body in terms of energy and the physical level together, with bioresonance therapy among its named methods. Hours are posted. Call ahead to confirm the sessions on offer before you book.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Kerstin Weis
listings.description: In Heppenheim on the Bergstraße, Kerstin Weis runs a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice centred on body, mind and soul. Her bioenergetic methods include bioresonance, electroacupuncture and shamanically inspired approaches, with the aim of more inner balance. A gentle, energy-based way of working is the stated approach, and she explains the bioresonance method in a knowledge section. The practice sees people on site by appointment and appointments are required.

listings.name: Praxis für Meridiandiagnostik & Bioresonanz
listings.description: This alternative practice in Vöhl, Hesse, offers bioresonance sessions and a body scan, as well as meridian work with frequencies and biophotons. Vöhl lies at the Edersee lake in the Waldeck-Frankenberg district of northern Hesse. Sessions are described as working with the body's own information.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde
listings.description: Praxis für Naturheilkunde in Willingen is the naturopathic practice of Birgit Conrads, on Briloner Straße, and it opened in April 2026. Her bioresonance sessions follow the method of Paul Schmidt. The practice also offers energy and anti-stress sessions, nutrition counselling and base fasting guidance, and the Maps profile adds cosmetic skin care. Gentle methods have been her focus since 2005. Appointments are recommended, and a contact form and mobile number are available for booking.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde, Inhaberin Christina Fux
listings.description: Christina Fux runs a naturopathic practice in Volkmarsen that combines osteopathy, bioresonance and psychokinesiology to support body, mind and soul. She takes time for each client and their story. Volkmarsen is a town in the Waldeck-Frankenberg district of northern Hesse.

listings.name: Praxis für NaturMedizin Birgit Bingel
listings.description: Praxis für NaturMedizin is the practice of Birgit Bingel in Grünberg, combining knowledge from conventional medicine with naturopathy. Sessions include biofeedback and bioresonance measurements with the Rayonex Rayocomp PS 1000 polar 4.0 and Rayoscan. She also offers positive psychology, nutrition, breathing and movement guidance, therapeutic energy work, Reiki near and far, and animal communication. Appointments are by WhatsApp or phone. The practice is owned by a woman, has wheelchair accessible parking and a restroom, and lists a get-to-know-you conversation. Opening hours are not posted, so call ahead.

listings.name: Ur-Heil-Kraft Tanja Widmann-Eckert - Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Ur-Heil-Kraft is the practice of Tanja Widmann-Eckert, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Ehringshausen. It offers craniosacral osteopathy, frequency sessions with bioresonance, shamanic energy work for people and places, tarot consultation and animal communication, including distance work. The practice welcomes people, animals and living spaces. Contact is by form, email or phone. It has wheelchair-accessible parking, entrance and seating, free parking on site, and accepts card and mobile payments.

listings.name: wave4you
listings.description: Wave4you is a coaching practice in Bensheim built around TimeWaver Pro information field analysis and harmonisation. The sessions work with the energy field of a person, a family, a company, a building or a place, and also with animals and plants. Topic areas on offer include wellbeing and sport, home and buildings, business and staff, and animal communication. The practice is run by Claudia, and appointments are required. Call ahead to ask how a session is arranged and how it is booked.

listings.name: Wellness Advocate Irina Merkel
listings.description: Wellness Advocate Irina Merkel in Solms is a spa-category business led by an Essential Emotions coach. It offers AromaTouch sessions, individual aromatherapy consultations and ZYTO and Visera scans, working with doTERRA oils to support wellbeing and balance.

listings.name: wert-voll.de Ernährungsberatung & ganzheitliches Gesundheitscoaching & Energiearbeit & Bioresonanz & THEKI
listings.description: Wert-voll.de offers nutrition counselling and holistic health coaching in Frankfurt am Main, with BioScan and bioresonance sessions as one of its services. The practice describes the scan as non-invasive and uses it alongside micronutrient and vitamin guidance. Other offers are gut health and microbiome coaching, prevention, energy work, THEKI sessions, Akasha Chronik readings, online courses and webinars. Consultations are held in person in Frankfurt or by Zoom video call, with an online booking option. Call or write to confirm what a first appointment includes.

listings.name: Praxis für klassische Homöopathie und Bioresonanz - Heilpraktikerin Petra Büttner
listings.description: Petra Büttner is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and homeopath in Darmstadt. Her practice focuses on gut wellbeing, skin and immune support, emotional wellbeing and women's health, with an individual and empathetic approach. Rated 4.6 from 11 Google reviews, 10 of them five stars. Appointments are required and cards are accepted. Call ahead to ask which sessions and devices are available.

listings.name: Bioresonanz-Hessen
listings.description: Bioresonanz-Hessen is based in Lorsch, Hesse, and carries the Maps category alternative medicine practitioner. The practice has a restroom on site. Contact the practice directly to ask which sessions and equipment it offers before you book an appointment.

listings.name: Olga Beckmann
listings.description: Olga Beckmann runs a private practice for integrative medicine in Braunschweig, led by a physician trained in general medicine and naturopathic methods. Bioresonance sessions are part of the range, next to acupuncture, homeopathy, cupping, laser and magnetic field applications, lymphatic drainage and nutrition counselling. Appointments are by arrangement only, Monday to Sunday from 9:00 to 15:00, and contact is by email, Telegram or WhatsApp. Rated 5.0 from 197 Google reviews, 196 of them five stars. The entrance and restroom are wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Praxis für Osteopathie und Naturheilverfahren - Markus Schürmann
listings.description: Markus Schürmann is an osteopath and Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Einbeck, and his practice adds BICOM bioresonance to its range. Other offers include acupuncture, orthomolecular guidance and microcurrent sessions, for both adults and children. A free introductory consultation can be booked online, and the practice is open Monday to Friday. Fees are explained on a separate page. Rated 5.0 from 66 Google reviews, all five stars. Entrance, seating and restroom are wheelchair accessible, there is a hearing loop, and on-site parking is available.

listings.name: Dr. vet. med. (hr) Stella Schulte
listings.description: Stella Schulte is a Tierheilpraktikerin (animal alternative practitioner) in Osnabrück offering natural care for animals. Her focus areas include classical homeopathy, Penzel acupressure for horses and dogs, Bach flower therapy, bioresonance therapy, herbal medicine and nutrition advice. Rated 5.0 from 35 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are by arrangement.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Sannapiu Kinderosteopathie/Osteopathie, klassische Homöopathie & Bioresonanztherapie in Burgwedel
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Sannapiu in Burgwedel has served families and individuals for more than 20 years. The practice is led by a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who is also a trained children's nurse. Offers include child osteopathy, osteopathy, classical homeopathy, bioresonance and integrative health support, with time set aside for a long first conversation. Rated 5.0 from 31 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Zentrum für Bioresonanz & Naturheilkunde I Heilpraktikerin Olivia Gonzales
listings.description: The Zentrum für Bioresonanz & Naturheilkunde in Melbeck near Lüneburg is led by Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Olivia Gonzales and her team. They have worked with bioenergetic concepts since 2003 and use bioresonance after Paul Schmidt. Pages cover bioresonance, services, the team and client reviews from Google, and appointments are requested through a form. Rated 5.0 from 25 Google reviews, every one a five-star rating. The practice offers on-site sessions and has free parking, with wheelchair-accessible parking, seating and restroom.

listings.name: Lebenswandel - Heilpraktiker Praxisgemeinschaft
listings.description: Lebenswandel is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice community in Laatzen. The team offers osteopathy, bioresonance therapy, kinesiology and women's health support, and also works with infants and children through growth stages. Its stated aim is that clients regain trust in their body and find balance. Rated 5.0 from 21 Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to confirm which sessions each practitioner offers.

listings.name: Miriam Kaufmann - Ganzheitliches Coaching
listings.description: Miriam Kaufmann offers holistic coaching in Delmenhorst, for children, teenagers, adults and parents. She combines classic coaching with kinesiology, Human Design and the TimeWaver system, with Bemer as a further tool for energetic and physical support. Individual and parent-child coaching are available on site, by phone or online, and a free first call of 20 to 30 minutes helps clarify what is needed. Topics include stress, conflicts, decisions and emotional strain. Online booking is available for the first call. Rated 5.0 from 21 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Silke Gehrke Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Silke Gehrke Heilpraktikerin runs her own naturopathy practice in the Elbtalaue area near Bleckede. As a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) she offers craniosacral, Dorn and Breuss approaches, energy work, Vitalpilze and Kohne therapy with homeopathic complex preparations, and works as a certified bioresonance therapist. Rated 5.0 from 18 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments by arrangement.

listings.name: Anja Zuzak Specialist f. General medicine
listings.description: Anja Zuzak runs a private practice in Wendeburg as a specialist physician in general medicine, with a focus on regulative medicine. Her complementary methods include microbiological therapy, bioresonance and micro-immunotherapy. Rated 4.4 from 25 Google reviews, 20 of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Rita Gallo
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Rita Gallo in Ostrhauderfehn offers bioresonance therapy among its natural methods, along with chiropractic and Alpha Cooling cold therapy. Appointments are required, and the practice has wheelchair-accessible parking and entrance. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Praxis Dr. Ströhlein. Arzt für Chinesische Medizin und westliche Naturheilverfahren. Natürlich heilen. Göttingen
listings.description: Praxis Dr. Ströhlein in Göttingen is a private and self-pay practice led by a physician specialising in Chinese medicine and Western naturopathic methods. Offers include acupuncture and moxibustion, Chinese herbal medicine, bioresonance, oxygen altitude sessions in an oxygen lounge, and stress and resilience support. Free phone advice from the team helps decide whether the practice fits. Rated 4.8 from 16 Google reviews, 15 of them five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Praxis Dr. Carstens
listings.description: Praxis Dr. Carstens in Rotenburg offers American-style chiropractic and bioresonance sessions for people and animals. Appointments are required and the practice has wheelchair-accessible parking. Rated 4.7 from 15 Google reviews, 14 of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Thekla & Michael Göbbels Psychotherapie Hypnose Homöopathie Bioresonanztherapie Kinesiologie
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Thekla and Michael Göbbels in Papenburg has served northern Emsland since 1997 and 2001. Bioresonance therapy is offered alongside psychotherapy, hypnosis, homeopathy, kinesiology, mindfulness and systemic therapy. Bioresonance is described as complementing electroacupuncture. Their approach joins tried natural methods, and the practice also lists mindfulness work and homeopathy. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Kathrin Sommer-Rah
listings.description: Kathrin Sommer-Rah is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Oldenburg. Her offer includes bioresonance therapy after Paul Schmidt, acupuncture and laser acupuncture, traditional Chinese medicine, nutrition counselling, spinal therapy, kinesiotaping and coaching, plus support for women who wish to conceive and for menopause. Appointments can be booked online, and the practice has a wheelchair-accessible restroom. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Jonczyk & Janßen
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Jonczyk & Janßen in Rastede is a two-person practice of Heilpraktikerinnen (state-licensed alternative practitioners). Brigitte Jonczyk works as a bioresonance therapist and brings more than thirty years of professional experience. Katharina Janßen holds an M.Sc. in osteopathy. The practice offers bioresonance sessions and osteopathy, has a free parking lot and wheelchair-accessible parking, and posts opening hours. Rated 4.3 from 13 Google reviews, 10 of them five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Vanessa Zeidler-Wilkening
listings.description: Vanessa Zeidler-Wilkening runs a naturopathic practice in Drakenburg built around BICOM bioresonance and the BICOM Body Check 2 Advanced. Further offers include balanced ear acupuncture after Seeber, HypnoBirthing courses for relaxed birth preparation, classical homeopathy, Bach flowers, aromatherapy, Schüssler salts, phytotherapy, nasal reflex zone work, nutrition counselling and soft laser sessions. The practice has a focus on naturopathic care for children and women. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all five stars. Women-owned, LGBTQ-welcoming, appointments required.

listings.name: CoNovaMed
listings.description: CoNovaMed in Bad Iburg is a urology practice that also works with complementary energy-based approaches. BICOM Body-Check and BICOM bioresonance sessions are named as working focus areas of Ms. Steinbach. Rated 3.2 from 22 Google reviews, 10 of them five stars and 9 a single star. Call ahead to confirm opening times and availability and which sessions are offered.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Jeannette Beyer, Bioresonanz und Kinesiologie
listings.description: Jeannette Beyer is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Vechta, working with bioresonance and kinesiology. Her sessions combine bioresonance, muscle testing and manual techniques, with Touch for Health and craniosacral work in the mix. A body scan lets clients follow their energy level live on screen. She also advises on vital nutrients. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Sonja Pruschik
listings.description: Sonja Pruschik has been a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Braunschweig since 2007 and is also a hormone coach, a menopause adviser and a Cellagon adviser. Her focus is wellbeing and vitality through the life phases of a woman. Bioresonance is among her main areas of work. Rated 4.2 from 5 Google reviews, 4 of them five stars. Call to book.

listings.name: Adelina Reer
listings.description: Adelina Reer in Hilgermissen offers bioresonance and vital nutrient scan sessions. The sessions use a modern analysis tool, need no sample taken, and explain micronutrients and vital nutrients in plain, practical language. Appointments are required and parking is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all at five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Stefanie Hillebrand
listings.description: Stefanie Hillebrand runs a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Adendorf. Her listed focus areas are craniosacral osteopathy, NLS bioresonance sessions, EmotionCode and energy work. Rated 5.0 from three Google reviews, all five stars. Call ahead to confirm opening times and what a first session involves.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Alexander Gosselk
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Alexander Gosselk is a practice for osteopathy and naturopathy in Vögelsen near Lüneburg. It offers osteopathy, fascia work, craniosacral therapy, acupuncture, homeopathy and herbal medicine. Bioresonance sessions are offered as bioenergetic regulation to support wellbeing and balance. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Vögelsen is a village in the Lüneburg district of Lower Saxony. A first appointment is arranged by phone or email.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilverfahren Elke Albers
listings.description: Elke Albers runs a naturopathic practice in Scheeßel and works as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her sessions use a BICOM 2000 bioresonance device from Regumed and NLS system sessions with the Meta Hunter, and she trained in bioresonance during her studies. She also reads the Akasha Chronicle for people and animals and gives seminars on pendulum work and the Akasha Chronicle, in the practice and over Zoom. Appointments are made by phone. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Herzenslichtquelle Frau Sabine Hartig
listings.description: Herzenslichtquelle in Hage is the practice of Sabine Hartig, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and artist who has run her naturopathy practice for 25 years. Bioresonance sessions are offered with the BICOM device, alongside acupuncture, coaching and talk-based sessions. The practice also has an art shop. Appointments are required, and the entrance, seating and restroom are wheelchair accessible. Rated 4.3 from 4 Google reviews, three at five stars and one at two stars.

listings.name: Flüsternde Hände
listings.description: Flüsternde Hände is a small naturopathic practice in Seevetal-Hittfeld run by Nadine, offering whole-person support for people and animals. The range covers animal naturopathy, bioresonance, animal communication, Reiki and energetic coaching, with courses on top. Clients are asked to take part too, since the owner involves the person alongside the animal in her work. Clients describe bioresonance sessions for their dog and horse together with animal communication. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Ganzheitsmedizinische Praxis Gudrun Albrecht
listings.description: Gudrun Albrecht runs a private practice in Ganderkesee, located in the Hotel Backenköhler building. She is a physician specialising in general medicine with a focus on naturopathy. Her bioresonance sessions follow Paul Schmidt and use the Rayonex Rayocomp PS1000 polar device, and she offers a larger check-up session built around bioresonance. Acupuncture, nutrient guidance, psychokinesiology and kinesiotaping are also listed. Appointments are by arrangement. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Judith Rehberg
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Judith Rehberg in Emmerthal offers bioresonance after Dieter Kramer (EnTeTe), a vibration-based method, together with kinesiology in the Touch for Health style. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Call ahead to confirm hours and how to book.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Tepe-Hesselbarth
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Tepe-Hesselbarth in Bad Laer is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice run by Wilhelm Tepe and Juliana Tepe-Hesselbarth, the second and third generation of the family, with more than 50 years of combined experience. Sessions include computer-controlled bioresonance with a BICOM 2000 Regumed device, oxygen and magnetic field sessions, iris analysis, acupuncture and foot reflexology. Appointments are required and booked by phone. Rated 5.0 from two Google reviews, both five stars. Opening hours are posted.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Peter Heinrichs
listings.description: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Peter Heinrichs in Bad Essen offers bioresonance sessions, applied kinesiology, manual therapy and massages. Appointments are made by arrangement, by phone or email, and opening hours are posted. The practice has free parking, with wheelchair-accessible seating and restroom. Rated 5.0 from two Google reviews, both five stars. Call or email to confirm which sessions are offered and to find a time that suits you.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Martina Hanig
listings.description: Heilpraxis Martina Hanig is a naturopathy practice in Barsinghausen run by Martina Hanig, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) for more than 15 years. The range includes bioresonance, classical and complex homeopathy, magnetic field therapy, craniosacral therapy and nutrition counselling. First visits are booked by phone or through the contact form, and the practice sits in the Egestorf district of Barsinghausen. Opening hours are posted and the service area covers 17 named towns and villages around Borken. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Kirsten Schulz-Oberjohann Bioresonanz
listings.description: Kirsten Schulz-Oberjohann offers bioresonance after Paul Schmidt in Warmsen, Lower Saxony, alongside Schüßler salts and Enderlein-Sanum therapy. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Warmsen lies in the Nienburg district of Lower Saxony, not far from the Weser river.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Hanstedt - Beate Eckardt
listings.description: Beate Eckardt runs her own Naturheilpraxis in Hanstedt and has worked there as a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) since 2004. A trained nurse, she specialises in acupuncture based on traditional Chinese medicine and in bioresonance after Paul Schmidt. Appointments are arranged by phone or email. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Inga Jasper
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Inga Jasper sits in the very centre of Osnabrück, where Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Inga Jasper works with Bicom bioresonance. Sessions are offered for adults and for children, and the practice pages also cover a gut microbiome analysis service. Rated 5.0 from one Google review, and hours are posted. Appointments are recommended, and there is a restroom and wheelchair accessible parking.

listings.name: Dr. Frank-Nienhaus - Praxis für Integrative- und Regulationsmedizin
listings.description: Dr. Frank-Nienhaus leads a practice for integrative and regulation medicine in Lilienthal. Bioresonance is the central method, described as working mainly on an information level and based on quantum and biophysical ideas. Alongside it the practice offers vital nutrient balancing and natural methods such as plant-based methods, aroma and enzyme therapy, along with nutrition medicine and acupuncture.

listings.name: Gesundheitsberatung und Energetik - Anke Schmalstieg
listings.description: Anke Schmalstieg runs a health counselling and energy practice in Algermissen. Her main offer is bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, presented as a way to support balance of body, mind and spirit and wellbeing, and she works with a Rayonex Duplex IV professional device. Human Design coaching and energy-based personal development sessions round out the range. Opening hours are posted and parking is wheelchair accessible. The practice pages describe a personal journey toward balance, vitality and joy in life, and the contact page lists an email address for first enquiries. Call or write to ask about booking a first appointment.

listings.name: HTA TimeWaver Bioresonanztherapie
listings.description: HTA TimeWaver Bioresonanztherapie in Gandesbergen offers TimeWaver bioresonance sessions for horses and dogs together with their owners. Quantum bioresonance, information-field sessions with a resulting plan, and coaching are part of the offer, covering physical, mental and emotional topics. Hours are not posted, so call ahead to arrange a visit.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis De Grandi Bispingen
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis De Grandi Bispingen is a private practice and aesthetics institute in the Heidekreis, led by Dorota Joanna De Grandi, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her work centres on skin, digestion and vegan nutrition counselling for women, men and children, starting with a long conversation and a look at existing records. Bioresonance screening evaluates more than 300 parameters and is used as a complementary orientation method. Private podiatry, cosmetology, manicure, nail reconstruction and micropigmentation are also offered. Appointments by arrangement.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Neubeginn
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Neubeginn in Wolfsburg is the practice of Carina Elena Wodara, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and certified hypnosis therapist. She works as a bioresonance practitioner after Paul Schmidt and also offers sound bowl and tuning fork sessions, hypnosis and regression hypnosis, nutrition and microbiome counselling and happiness coaching. Consultations and coaching are also available by video call, while hands-on sessions take place in person in Wolfsburg. The practice presents itself as a calm place that sets aside time for each client. Appointments can be booked by phone, WhatsApp or e-mail.

listings.name: Naturheilzeit Heide Binia, An den Schanzen 2, 49584 Fürstenau
listings.description: Naturheilzeit is the naturopathic practice of Heide Binia at An den Schanzen 2 in Fürstenau. It offers bioresonance sessions and the Metavital Scan, aimed at more energy and general wellbeing. Neurokinetik and a focus on women's health and gut health round out the range. Online appointment booking is available, and the practice has wheelchair accessible parking and a restroom. Appointments are recommended, so book ahead.

listings.name: Praxis für Frauengesundheit
listings.description: Praxis für Frauengesundheit in Schöppenstedt is run by Dr. rer. nat. Petra Tielen, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). The range covers naturopathy for women, homeopathy, plant-based naturopathy, nutrition and micronutrient counselling, bioresonance, Reiki in the Usui system, acupuncture and psychological support. Seminars are also offered. The practice is in Schöppenstedt, a small town in the Wolfenbüttel district of Lower Saxony, and appointments are arranged by contacting Dr. Tielen directly.

listings.name: Praxis für Ursachenforschung - Wefer-Kempa
listings.description: Praxis für Ursachenforschung is a home-based practice in Beverstedt, serving Hagen im Bremischen, Bremerhaven and the surrounding area. Birthe Wefer-Kempa is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who offers BICOM bioresonance sessions with a Regumed device, geo-biological home consulting on electrosmog and radio exposure, Liebscher and Bracht methods, aura work and nutrition therapy. The practice also offers nutrition therapy and is reached by phone. It serves clients from Beverstedt and the surrounding area. Visits are by appointment, and the practice invites a phone call if you are unsure whether your request fits.

listings.name: Schmoller Therapie
listings.description: Schmoller Therapie in Hanstedt is listed as a biofeedback therapist offering health coaching for people and animals. Its session range names Bicom bioresonance, BEMER sessions for people and horses, a WellAnalyse and HRV stress readings, plus horse therapy. Call ahead to confirm the current session options.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Thomas Oppel
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Thomas Oppel in Emlichheim has been running since 1990 and celebrated its 30th anniversary, with information in both German and Dutch. It is a member of the Lower Saxony Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) association. Rated 4.8 from 20 Google reviews, 19 of them five stars. listings.name: Herbal Detox and Bio Resonance Treatments Ngwenya
listings.description: Herbal Detox and Bio Resonance Treatments Ngwenya is a holistic practice in Krugersdorp whose name points to herbal and bio resonance sessions. It has a five star Google rating from one review and posted hours. Call to ask which services are on offer, what a first session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Body Sonic Biofeedback Scan
listings.description: Body Sonic Biofeedback Scan is a wellness program in Pretoria, and its name points to biofeedback scanning and sound. Call to ask which device is used, what a first scan involves, how long it lasts and how appointments are booked.

listings.name: Herbal Detox And Bio Resonance Treatments
listings.description: Herbal Detox And Bio Resonance Treatments is a Randburg business whose name points to herbal detox support and bioresonance sessions. Call to ask which device is used, what a first session involves, what hours it keeps and how appointments are booked before you plan a visit. It is a local option for anyone in Randburg.

listings.name: Quantum Scio Whole Health SA
listings.description: Quantum Scio Whole Health SA operates in Pretoria, and its name points to Scio and quantum biofeedback. The entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible. Call to ask which biofeedback system is used, what a first session involves, how long it lasts and how appointments are booked.

listings.name: Scio Quantum Health
listings.description: Scio Quantum Health is a Pretoria business whose name points to quantum biofeedback and Scio sessions. Call to ask which device is used, what a first session involves, what hours it keeps and how appointments are booked before you plan a visit. It is a local option for anyone in the city curious about a biofeedback session.

listings.name: Osteopathie Gesa-Fee Velten - Säuglinge-Kinder-Erwachsene
listings.description: Osteopathie Gesa-Fee Velten in Montabaur is a team of 7 state-recognised osteopaths, Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioners) and physiotherapists. The main focus is osteopathy for infants, children and adults, with psychodynamic osteopathy as a specialty. Bioresonance therapy and gut counselling are offered in addition, and a free advice call is available. Appointments are made by phone only. Rated 4.8 from 45 Google reviews, 43 of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Alexandra Krohn
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Alexandra Krohn is a naturopathic practice in Ludwigshafen working under the idea of body, mind and soul in balance. The practice offers bioresonance therapy and gut flora rebuilding, and it runs a children's practice with homeopathy for young clients. The menu points to separate pages for the naturopathic practice, bioresonance, gut rebuilding and a short biography. Rated 5.0 from 21 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Reach the practice by phone, and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Sonja Streit - Heilpraktiker -
listings.description: Praxis für Naturheilkunde in Badem is led by Sonja Streit, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with more than 11 years in practice. Offers include bioresonance and EAV sessions, oxygen sessions, heart rate variability measurement with Nilas, and body composition measurement with a Tanita bioimpedance scale. Appointments are recommended and opening hours are posted. Parking, entrance and restroom are wheelchair accessible. Rated 4.7 from 23 Google reviews, 21 of them five stars and two a single star. Phone 06563 8000.

listings.name: Praxis Dr. med. Sybille Freund
listings.description: Praxis Dr. med. Sybille Freund in Nierstein is run by a physician and follows a resource-oriented, whole-person approach. Bio-resonance appears among its offers, next to nutrition counselling, homeopathy, interval hypoxia-hyperoxia training and BEMER. Rated 4.8 from 21 Google reviews, 20 of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Fehmel
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Fehmel in Boppard is the practice of Gudrun Fehmel, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) working in her own practice since 2012. It offers a whole-body scan based on the NLS system, and Gudrun Fehmel completed training in NLS MetaVital Human analysis in October 2020. Other offers include micro-energy therapy, acid and base balance programmes and revitalising courses. Rated 5.0 from 18 Google reviews, all five stars. Online appointment booking is available.

listings.name: Sanadios Ganzheitliche Naturheilpraxis GbR
listings.description: Sanadios Naturheilpraxis in Mainz is a group practice led by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). It offers bioresonance alongside osteopathy, chiropractic, neural therapy, Gestalt therapy, EMDR, Rogers talk therapy and hypnosis. Rated 4.8 from 19 Google reviews, 18 of them five stars. Free parking is available and appointments are required.

listings.name: Janardhan - Praxis für alternative Heilmethoden & Yogastudio
listings.description: Janardhan is an alternative practice and yoga studio in Bitburg. It offers bioresonance, hypnosis, Reiki, Ayurveda and yoga, plus bioresonance Feng Shui for living spaces, for people and their animals. A personal conversation comes first to choose the right approach. Rated 4.9 from 16 Google reviews, 15 of them five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Tina Flohr, Psychologin, M.Sc. & Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Tina Flohr is a psychologist (M.Sc.) and Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a naturopathic practice in Trier. She offers acupuncture, bioresonance therapy, advice on micronutrient supply and gut wellbeing, and psychological counselling. Bioresonance is described as a naturopathic method that uses a bioresonance device, and her practice is set up as a Praxis für Naturheilkunde. Call ahead to confirm how sessions are booked. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Herr Michael Kiy, Heil- und Chiropraktiker
listings.description: Michael Kiy is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and chiropractor in Idar-Oberstein. Besides American chiropractic and osteopathy, the practice offers bioresonance sessions with the BICOM device, homeopathy, applied kinesiology and acupuncture. Each visit starts with an initial assessment, and the practice explains bioresonance on a page of its own. The entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible, and appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all at five stars.

listings.name: Iris Sedlar Amitayus-Zentrum für fernöstliche Medizin
listings.description: The Amitayus centre in Bitburg is a practice for Far Eastern approaches led by Iris Sedlar. Offers include acupuncture, traditional Chinese medicine, Ayurveda, Tibetan methods, Tuina and Dorn back work, bioresonance, nutrition counselling, Reiki, facial acupressure, hypnosis, Feng Shui consultations and massage. Appointments are by phone. Rated 4.2 from 13 Google reviews, 10 of them five stars, 2 one star and one two stars.

listings.name: Waldemar Kunz Heilpraktiker / Chiropraktiker
listings.description: Waldemar Kunz is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and chiropractor in Simmern. His practice offers chiropractic, fascia therapy, Bowen therapy, Dorn-Breuss, Liebscher & Bracht work, homeopathy and bioresonance. NLS system sessions are done with a Metatron or an Oberon. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all five stars. The practice is in Simmern in the Hunsrück region of Rhineland-Palatinate, close to Bad Kreuznach and Koblenz.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Enns
listings.description: Heilpraxis Enns in Plaidt is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice offering bioresonance sessions alongside orthomolecular nutrient advice, individual vitamin and nutrient consultations and a PDRN beauty application. A free first conversation of 15 minutes lets new clients meet the practitioner before booking. The first appointment includes a detailed intake conversation. Appointments are recommended, and opening hours are posted. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Tanja Schmitz
listings.description: Tanja Schmitz in Speicher is a health consultant, vital-substance expert and Reiki master. Her range covers health counselling, vital-substance counselling, bioresonance and harmonisation with a Rayonex system, gemstone and energy work, relaxation massage, ear candle sessions and Yamamoto scalp acupuncture. The focus is on keeping a healthy lifestyle and supporting people on the way to a healthier daily routine. Speicher is a village in the Eifel region of Rhineland-Palatinate. Rated 4.4 from 7 Google reviews, 6 of them five stars and 1 one star.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Grünfelder
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Grünfelder in Riedelberg is run by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) offering structural osteopathy, gentle chiropractic, acupuncture, bioresonance and classical massage. Each appointment is planned for the individual client, and a first conversation sets the direction. Fees follow the Heilpraktiker fee schedule, and appointments need 24 hours notice to cancel. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Steffi Engel
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Steffi Engel in Wonsheim combines several natural methods in one practice. Bioresonance sits next to acupuncture and herbal medicine from traditional Chinese medicine, back work after Dorn, vital wave therapy, pulsation therapy, colour therapy, radionics, sound massage and counselling after Rogers. Steffi Engel asks for appointments by phone to keep waiting times short, with opening hours from Monday to Friday. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Éva Csizmadia
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Éva Csizmadia in Bitburg focuses on traditional Chinese medicine with acupuncture, and on bioresonance. TCM brings nutrition guidance, acupuncture and herbal therapy. Éva Csizmadia has trained with the German TCM society (DGTCM) in Heidelberg and with Regumed, the bioresonance device maker, and takes enquiries through a contact form. The practice works to bring body, mind and soul into harmony, with acupuncture as a particular emphasis. Rated 4.8 from 5 Google reviews, 4 of them five stars. Call to book an appointment.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Iskandarani
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Iskandarani in Bollendorf offers bioresonance sessions with a BICOM Optima device alongside chiropractic, pneumatic pulsation therapy, shiatsu, wellness and therapeutic massage, mobile massage and radial shockwave therapy. Rated 4.8 from 5 Google reviews, 4 of them five stars. Further offers include orthomolecular vitamin and nutrient guidance, cupping and acupuncture. Appointments are by arrangement, the practice is run by a woman owner, and it has wheelchair-accessible parking.

listings.name: Bioresonanz & Ernährungsberatung Kirf
listings.description: Bioresonanz & Ernährungsberatung Kirf combines bioresonance analysis with individual nutrition counselling in Kirf, serving the Trier, Saarburg and Merzig area and nearby Luxembourg. Appointments take place on site, and online consultations are also possible. The practice also works with children and teenagers. A visit follows four steps: an introductory conversation, the analysis, a personal plan and follow-up. A first or main session runs 60 to 90 minutes. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Divine Magic Whisper
listings.description: Divine Magic Whisper is a Reiki practice in Worms that combines Reiki, card reading and bioresonance with a coaching offer. The coaching topics include making confident decisions, taking personal responsibility, finding digital balance and focus, and fulfilment at work. The stated aim is more calm, balance and energy. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Anita Gomille
listings.description: Heilpraktikerin Anita Gomille in Lemberg lists bioresonance with holistic energetic assessment and harmonisation, along with ear acupuncture, cupping massage, cosmetic facial acupuncture and mycotherapy. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are offered and how to book.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Lebensenergie Bettina Anstett
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Lebensenergie in Pirmasens is run by Bettina Anstett, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who works with women. Her focus areas include Therapeutic Women's Massage TFM, hypnosis designed for women, EMDR, bioresonance, CQM (Chinese Quantum Method), phytotherapy, homeopathy, ear acupuncture, Physiokey regulation, spagyrics, gemmotherapy, relaxation and massage. Appointments are by arrangement only, and the practice has wheelchair-accessible parking and a free parking lot. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Heilpraxis/ Praxis für ganzheitliche Methodik
listings.description: Heilpraxis in Mainz, led by Christiane Arnold, combines osteopathy and Bowtech, physiotherapy, traditional Chinese medicine, acupuncture and bioresonance. Talk sessions, meditation and breathwork are part of the range, and online courses for self-help are offered. Rated 3.0 from 2 Google reviews. Appointments are required and the entrance is wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Ernährungsberatung Online Shop Nahrungsergänzungsmittel
listings.description: This nutritionist in the village of Fell lists nutrition counselling, bioresonance sessions and massage. The name also points to an online shop for food supplements. Call ahead to confirm opening times, what is offered and how to book.

listings.name: Frau Yvonne Weingarten Heilpraktikerin und Heilpraktikerin (Psychotherapie)
listings.description: Yvonne Weingarten is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with an additional Heilpraktiker qualification for psychotherapy, working in Höhn. Her practice combines naturopathy, epigenetics and longevity topics, and sessions are available in person and online. Bioresonance, energy work and ear acupuncture are among the sessions, with homeopathy, nutrition advice, plant-based therapy, wellness massage, relaxation, coaching, talks and training courses alongside. She sees adults, teenagers and children. Parking is wheelchair accessible and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Holistic Coaching Team
listings.description: Holistic Coaching Team Sandra Becker in Schoden supports pilots and shift workers who want more mental strength, recovery and balance. Sandra Becker is a stress and NLP coach with more than 27 years of aviation experience as a loadmaster. Her focus areas are recovery, healthy sleep, stress reduction and energy. An information-field analysis with the TimeWaver system can complement the coaching when it makes the process more precise. A free 30-minute first call is offered online or by phone, and the packages are named Take-off, Mid-Haul and Long-Haul.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Inge Wingenter
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Inge Wingenter in Stromberg offers bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, which uses frequencies to support the body's own regulation. The range also covers psychokinesiology, classical homeopathy, children's homeopathy, trauma work and constellation work in the morphic field. Harmonisation of geopathic influences such as electrosmog is done on site, and courses in kinesiology and homeopathy teach self-help skills. The practice is in Stromberg, a town in the Hunsrück region of Rhineland-Palatinate, and the owner is a trained naturopath who also runs courses in kinesiology and homeopathy.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Pracht-Schmitt
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Pracht-Schmitt is a bioresonance practice at Schubertstraße 3 in Bad Kreuznach, run by Uta Pracht-Schmitt, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and member of the Freier Verband Deutscher Heilpraktiker. Sessions use the Bicom Optima from Regumed, the Global scanner from Vitatec for full-body scans and the Rayonex PS 10, with a long first conversation before any session. The aim is balance and wellbeing. Appointments are required and booked by phone at 0671 79019539. The practice is wheelchair accessible and opening hours are posted.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilverfahren wie Reiki, Ayurveda, Chakren, Hypnose und Bioresonanz in Niederweiler/Südeifel.
listings.description: Naturpraxis Seelentraum is a natural therapy practice in Niederweiler in the Südeifel region, offering Ayurveda, hypnosis, yoga, Reiki and bioresonance as meditative, energetic work for body and mind. A spiritual centre in Bitburg is linked to the practice and runs courses and seminars. Appointments are available Monday to Saturday by arrangement, booked by phone, email or an online request form. Support for pregnancy and motherhood and regular courses complete the offer, and the work is described as mindful and loving.

listings.name: Ruth Dixius
listings.description: Ruth Dixius runs a Naturheilpraxis in Mehring offering bioresonance therapy, a body check, flower essence therapy and acupuncture. Appointments are required. The practice has wheelchair-accessible parking, a restroom on site and welcomes LGBTQ clients. Contact the practice directly to ask how a session is structured.

listings.name: Bioresonanz Silberberg
listings.description: Bioresonanz Silberberg is a health practice in Mainz with posted opening hours and wheelchair-accessible parking. Call ahead to confirm which sessions and devices are on offer, and whether an appointment is needed, before you plan a visit.

listings.name: Timewaver Trier
listings.description: Timewaver Trier is listed in Trier under the alternative medicine practitioner category. Call ahead to confirm which sessions and devices are offered, the opening times, the exact address and how to book before you visit.

listings.name: Health Basket Willowbridge
listings.description: Inside Willowbridge Mall in Bellville, Health Basket has served the northern suburbs of Cape Town for over 16 years as a natural health store. Alongside herbal supplements, tinctures and vitamins, qualified practitioners now run bioresonance full body scans and detox protocols in store, and the team gives supplement consultations. Nationwide courier delivery is available. Rated 4.7 from 63 Google reviews, 50 of them five stars.

listings.name: Fenix Vida - Holistic Wellness Niched on Physical and Mental Weight Loss
listings.description: Fenix Vida is a women-owned Cape Town wellness business focused on physical and mental weight management. Its services bring together bioresonance, non-invasive body contouring, intuitive energy work and lifestyle coaching, delivered by a team of practitioners. It is temporarily closed until further notice, so confirm by email before planning a visit. Rated 5.0 from 44 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Wholelistix
listings.description: Wholelistix in Knysna offers NES scans with Infoceuticals alongside craniosacral therapy, somatoemotional release and lymphatic drainage. The practice is owned by women and has free parking close by and a wheelchair accessible entrance. Rated 5.0 from 29 Google reviews, 28 of them five stars. Call to confirm hours and how to book.

listings.name: SoundWaves Health Clinic
listings.description: In Gordon's Bay, SoundWaves Health Clinic runs bioresonance frequency sessions using NLS Bio plasma systems. Clients wear headphones in a comfortable therapy chair while full-body scans run, following a process of scan, analysis and session, with progress monitoring after a series. In-house sessions are available, along with remote sessions for clients elsewhere in South Africa and abroad, and fees are set out for each. Learning resources, videos, press coverage and pages on each body system explain frequency and the approach. Phone +27 83 267 9745. Rated 4.9 from 30 Google reviews, 29 of them five stars and one at one star. Opening hours are posted, a news sign-up keeps clients informed, and the clinic is on Facebook and YouTube, with a contact page for enquiries.

listings.name: Gillian O'Shea - Therapeutic Massage & Kinesiology
listings.description: Gillian O'Shea is an energy wellness practitioner in Knysna on South Africa's Garden Route. She offers therapeutic massage, including lymph drainage, aromatherapy, deep tissue fascia release and stress release massage, along with kinesiology, Reiki, Rife therapy, red light therapy and bioresonance health scans, plus self worth, wellness and weight programs. She also runs retreats and workshops. Many clients visit for a few days and continue their sessions remotely, and she has a global client base. Rated 4.9 from 28 Google reviews, 25 of them five stars.

listings.name: ResetMe Wellness South Africa
listings.description: ResetMe Wellness is a natural health practice in Somerset West, founded by Heleen Page, who has more than two decades in the field. Consultations use the NLS (Non-Linear Scanning) Bio-Resonance system, and in-person appointments take place at Sitari Country Estate, 4 Wasur Street. Clients who cannot visit can post a DNA sample for a remote scan, followed by a 60 to 80 minute Zoom or Teams consultation and an emailed report, with results processed within seven working days. Heleen also blends custom single-formula supplements. Rated 4.8 from 20 Google reviews, 19 of them five stars and 1 at one star. Digest Reset and Gut Reset blends are sold through an online shop, and a blog covers wellness topics. Wheelchair accessible parking is available.

listings.name: Scio Healthy Living
listings.description: Scio full body scan and balance sessions are offered at this Cape Town practice, which has a team page and a dedicated equestrian section for horse owners. Sessions are available for horses as well as people, and owners are invited to ask how the Scio can support their animals. The machine works with the body's own frequencies, and the practice explains the approach on its services page. Appointments are required are accepted, with accessible parking on site. Clients can book online or write to the practice by email. Rated 4.9 from 15 Google reviews, 14 of them five stars. An about page, a services page and a people page introduce the practice and its team.

listings.name: Well, Naturally, Mossel Bay
listings.description: Well, Naturally in Mossel Bay is a women-owned natural health consultancy offering SCIO biofeedback sessions, in person or from anywhere in the world through remote subspace sessions with a full report. Its plant-based reset programmes run for 3, 7 and 21 days, supported by AIM nutrition products. Consultations are by request only, by WhatsApp or email. Rated 4.7 from 15 Google reviews, 13 of them five stars and two at three stars. The consultancy publishes newsletters on topics such as sleep, and it offers recipes and a blog. Reviews and terms and conditions are published. Message the consultancy on WhatsApp to arrange a first conversation. The consultancy's retreat programmes are plant-based resets, and the AIM supplements form part of the 21-day plan.

listings.name: The Truwellness Centre
listings.description: In Somerset West, near Cape Town, The Truwellness Centre brings a range of wellness practitioners together under one roof. The team includes psychologists, physiotherapists, a biokineticist, personal trainers, a health coach and a chiropractor, along with an iridologist, a Reiki therapist and a bio-resonance health worker who offers bio-resonance sessions. Body alignment sessions are on the service list as well, and clients can view the practitioners and collaborators and book an appointment online. Rated 4.4 from 15 Google reviews, 11 of them five stars. The centre is described as being in Somerset West rather than Cape Town itself, so confirm the address and service area by phone before visiting.

listings.name: Quantum Health and Wellness Centre Bioresonance Scans, Rife & Spooky Therapy
listings.description: Bioresonance scans and Rife frequency sessions are the two offerings named by this women-owned Cape Town wellness centre, which also lists homeopath and naturopathic practitioner among its categories. Free on-site parking and a wheelchair accessible entrance are provided. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Oluchi
listings.description: Bioresonance scanning is one of several services at Oluchi, a wellness centre in Cape Town that books half hour sessions. The list also includes ozone with oxygen, hydrogen sessions, photobiomodulation, EMSculpt and an infrared mat with crystals, and a price list is available to review before booking. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Each service has its own page, and the centre invites clients to get in touch to make a booking.

listings.name: Awake Your Body
listings.description: Awake Your Body in St Helena Bay, Western Cape, offers SCIO biofeedback sessions as part of a retreat setting that includes barefoot walks on the beach. The Chaim retreat pages cover cellular wellness and water, and an online shop sells herbal and premium supplements and essential oils. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Phone +27 82 445 85 65 to book or to ask what a session involves. Wheelchair accessible parking and a restroom are on site.

listings.name: Laura Primic Healthcare Practitioner
listings.description: Laura Primic runs a wellness practice in Somerset West that focuses on bio resonance, iridology and quantum sessions, backed by more than 25 years of experience. Quantum sessions use a quantum resonance magnetic analyser that the client holds in the hand. I-Tera sessions and an academy for training are also available. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews. Call to confirm which sessions are currently offered.

listings.name: Life Slices Health and Wellness
listings.description: Life Slices Health and Wellness is a naturopathic practice in Swellendam built around the SCIO biofeedback system. A SCIO biofeedback consultation can be booked in person or as a virtual session by video call, and a quantum wellness scan is part of the lifestyle and wellness conversation. A Cellquicken consultation and nutritional consultations, in person or online, are also offered. An online shop carries herbal capsules, tinctures, liquid supplements, powders, health packages and topical supplements, with delivery across the country. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Appointments are made online. AIM products and a health quiz are also published. Enquiries go to info@lifeslices.co.za or WhatsApp. Opening hours are posted, card and phone payments are accepted, and the parking is wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Nutricoach
listings.description: Nutricoach in Melkbosstrand is a women-owned wellness centre founded in 2017. It offers plant-based nutritional consultations, massage, light therapy, Pilates and personal training, fitness classes and bio resonance scans, along with a vegan blog and kids and hiking activities. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: pure bloomology
listings.description: Pure Bloomology in Oudtshoorn, Western Cape, offers bio resonance scanning alongside reflexology, aromatherapy, remedial yoga and lifestyle counselling. A blog and shop are also on offer. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Pure Bloomology is categorised as a health and beauty shop, and a Wisdom Wellbeing page sits alongside the services. Quick visits are welcome. A Wisdom Wellbeing page adds background. Visit the shop page for products. The services are therapeutic reflexology, therapeutic aromatherapy and remedial yoga alongside lifestyle guidance.

listings.name: SuperNature Bioresonance Therapies
listings.description: SuperNature Bioresonance Therapies in Plettenberg Bay offers gentle, non-invasive bioresonance sessions in person or remotely from home. The practice focuses on personalized care and holistic wellbeing. Appointments are recommended, and the entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call +27 64515 9894 to book.

listings.name: Dr Zandré Botha George
listings.description: Dr Zandré Botha runs an integrative practice in George with a multidimensional approach to health. Services include SCIO and Meta Hunter bioscans, ozone, Rife, molecular hydrogen and coMra laser sessions. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both at five stars. Call to ask which sessions suit a first visit.

listings.name: Nourished Well-Being
listings.description: Dr Mel leads Nourished Well-Being, a women-owned practice in Cape Town and Yzerfontein built around nutrition and guided natural cleanses. ZYTO sessions include a non-invasive body coherence scan and an epigenetic scan, and consultations are held in person or online for clients across South Africa and abroad. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both at five stars.

listings.name: Bereket Health
listings.description: Bereket Health at 57A Langstreet in Moorreesburg offers bio resonance (quantum) scans, near infrared light therapy, ozone therapies and dedicated health coaching. Rated 4.5 from 2 Google reviews, one at five stars and one at four stars. Call ahead to ask what a scan session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Quantum Wellness and Nutrition
listings.description: Quantum Wellness and Nutrition in Wilderness offers health coaching with SCIO quantum biofeedback and natural, whole-food nutrition built for everyday eating rather than quick fixes. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review. The parking is wheelchair accessible. Call to ask what a first session involves and how long it takes.

listings.name: Body Serenity
listings.description: Cape Town practice Body Serenity offers bioresonance scans as a gentle, non-invasive way to look at a person's unique energy signature. The practitioner works with programmes personalised to each client. Appointments are required are accepted. Call ahead to ask which device is used and what a first scan involves.

listings.name: Holistic Relief
listings.description: Aricia van der Merwe has worked as a biofeedback practitioner and life coach since 2005, and Holistic Relief is her practice in Strand, Cape Town. SCIO biofeedback sessions sit beside NLP and timeline work, life coaching and facilitation, and she lists her qualifications and certifications for clients to read. She also runs the WCED changEd Mindset programme. The business is women-owned. Appointments are required, and there is accessible parking. Call to ask what a first SCIO session involves and how long it lasts.

listings.name: Ki-Solutions SCIO Biofeedback & Bio-Energetic Restoration
listings.description: Strictly by appointment, Ki-Solutions in Cape Town offers SCIO biofeedback sessions and describes its focus as bio-energetic restoration. The practice also lists Rife resonance sessions, LifeWave products and biochemical tissue salts. Parking is free on the street and on site, and the entrance is wheelchair accessible. Call to confirm hours and book an appointment.

listings.name: Mannatech Supplements Health & Wellness
listings.description: Supplements delivered to your door and bioresonance sessions come together at this Cape Town wellness centre, which sells Mannatech products. The practitioner uses a machine to read the frequencies of the body during bioresonance sessions, described as energy work. Call to ask what a first session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Quantum Health and Wellness
listings.description: Quantum Health and Wellness runs SCIO biofeedback sessions from Pearl Valley Golf Estate and Spa, with a personalised lifestyle plan built around them and regular biofeedback to follow progress. Virtual SCIO sessions are offered nationally, and nutritional DNA kits can be couriered anywhere in the country. Call 0834140861 to book or to ask how a session works.

listings.name: Scio Cape Town
listings.description: SCIO biofeedback sessions are the specialty of this Cape Town practice, led by a specialist in the field. Sessions are non-invasive and personalised, with a focus on stress, energy balance and overall wellbeing. Call to ask what a first session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Scio Flo for stress and pain management
listings.description: Heather offers SCIO biofeedback sessions from Cape Town, with the practice name pointing to stress as its focus. The SCIO is a computerised biofeedback system: non-invasive electrodes sit around the head, wrists and ankles, and the device reads the body's electrical signals through galvanic skin response. It is described as processing over 60 million bits of data. listings.name: Praxis für Körpertherapie / POHLTHERAPIE - Dorothee Gluderer
listings.description: Dorothee Gluderer runs a practice for body therapy in Reinbek, near Hamburg, built around Pohltherapie, a sensorimotor body therapy after Dr. Pohl. As a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) she offers bioresonance after Paul Schmidt with Rayonex equipment for people and animals. Clients can borrow a Rayonex PS10 device and a bioresonance blanket for use at home after an introduction. The practice also offers low-level laser sessions, colour light, Cantienica pelvic floor training, trauma processing, systemic work, inner child work and support in crises. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Bioenergetisches Therapiezentrum Nord GmbH
listings.description: This centre in Nübbel offers Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) services built around bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, classical homeopathy, Cell-Re-Active training and building biology for healthier living spaces. A first appointment is an extended session with a detailed conversation and a basic session on the bioresonance device. Appointments can be booked online. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Ingo Nauendorf
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Ingo Nauendorf in Quickborn is run by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who trained in hospital care and then worked for several years in intensive care before moving into complementary methods. The practice offers bioresonance sessions and chiropractic. Rated 4.6 from 12 Google reviews, 10 of them five stars.

listings.name: Israel Kaatsch Organetik
listings.description: Israel Kaatsch is an Organetik practitioner in Büchen. Organetik is a bioresonance method, and his sessions aim to bring body, mind and energy into harmony. He also works with Organo Feng Shui for homes and workplaces, runs Organetik for companies and for animals, and gives seminars for people and for animal practitioners. The ORGANO range of jewellery, creams and structured water is part of the offer. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Kinesiologin Susann Boening
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Boening is the practice of Susann Boening, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and kinesiologist serving Dithmarschen and Steinburg in Schleswig-Holstein. It focuses on stress reduction and bioresonance, together with kinesiology, information-based approaches, acupuncture, micronutrient guidance and metabolic nutrition plans. Appointments are by phone or by message, and the practice has free wheelchair-accessible parking. Kinesiology, acupuncture and bioresonance sit alongside nutrition work. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars. The venue describes a wellness programme for work and life balance, and the venue has free parking and welcomes LGBTQ clients.

listings.name: Mandy Grigoleit
listings.description: Mandy Grigoleit works from Ziethen near Ratzeburg, with practice appointments in Ratzeburg, and brings more than 22 years of experience in energy work and coaching. Her offer combines bioresonance, frequency sessions under the name Bioenergetic Balance, hands-on energy work and life, career and couples coaching. She also gives vital substance advice and runs seminars, with an online academy for working from home. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Petra Hehl, Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Petra Hehl is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Kiel. Her offers include classical homeopathy, acupuncture and cosmetic acupuncture, bioresonance, craniosacral work, nutrition counselling, complex homeopathy and Dorn method sessions. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Opening hours are posted and an appointment is recommended. Call to confirm which of these offers are available at the Kiel practice and how a first appointment is arranged.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Gabriele Gobelius - Bioresonanz und Radionik
listings.description: Gabriele Gobelius is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who has run her Naturheilpraxis in Kiel-Wellsee since 2004, with bioresonance and radionics at the centre of her work. She uses a Bicom 2000 with the Multisoft software and describes a calm, attentive, individual approach. Further offers include doTERRA aromatherapy, ear acupuncture, foot reflexology, gut health guidance and advice on earth radiation and electrosmog. Appointments are by arrangement. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The practice is women-owned, has free street parking and is wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Katja Drescher
listings.description: Katja Drescher is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Grömitz on the Baltic coast, specialising in bioresonance with the MORA device. She also works with homeopathy and MORA Psychobiophonie, adds movement and nutrition suggestions, and is a fitness and prevention sports teacher. The first appointment includes a thorough intake conversation and a session with the MORA device. Phone consultations are offered. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Stefanie Vehlken
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Stefanie Vehlken in Eutin focuses on electroacupuncture after Dr. Voll, bioresonance and kinesiology. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars. Call ahead to confirm hours, the methods currently offered and how to book.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Gundula Schatton in Malente Nüchel
listings.description: Gundula Schatton has worked as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) since 2017, after a career in vocational counselling. Her practice in Nüchel near Malente, in Ostholstein, puts bioresonance therapy first, followed by ear acupuncture and cupping therapy. She also arranges laboratory services in cooperation with partner labs. The approach is described as individual and holistic, with a focus on wellbeing. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.
