listings.name: Praxis f. Naturheilverfahren, Schmerz- u. Psychotherapie Christine Keuchel, Heilpraktikerin u. Dipl.-Ing.chem.
listings.description: Christine Keuchel is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and graduate chemical engineer with a naturopathic practice in Lübeck. Bioresonance therapy after Paul Schmidt is a main offer, delivered on a RAYONEX Polar 4.0 with an ECG-based scan, and on the smaller mobile RAYONEX PS10, which also serves home visits. Frequency medicine sits alongside it, together with Liebscher & Bracht methods, electro-acupuncture after Dr. Voll, mycotherapy with vital mushrooms, orthomolecular medicine, nutrition counselling and autogenic training. Appointments are by arrangement, with an online reservation calendar. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Kiel Nord
listings.description: Heilpraxis Kiel Nord is an alternative practice in Kiel offering body-oriented work and psychotherapy, homeopathy, bioresonance and talk-based sessions. There are no Google reviews yet, so call to confirm availability and what a first session involves before you book a visit.

listings.name: Marcella Fazio
listings.description: Marcella Fazio offers naturopathy in Wentorf bei Hamburg, with Reiki, nutrition therapy, cupping, cell regulation and bioresonance sessions in her range. Wentorf bei Hamburg is in the Herzogtum Lauenburg district of Schleswig-Holstein, on the southeastern edge of Hamburg. Call to arrange an appointment.

listings.name: Naturheilkundliche Privatpraxis, Christina Al-Haschimi, Ärztin
listings.description: Christina Al-Haschimi, a physician, runs a naturopathic private practice in Trittau in the Stormarn district. Her approach is to choose methods together with each client, for example acupuncture or bioresonance. Bioresonance sessions are done with a BICOM device, and the practice also offers kinesiology taping. Sessions are available by phone appointment only. The practice is wheelchair accessible and welcomes LGBTQ clients. Bioresonance is described as gentle and suitable for children. Trittau lies in Schleswig-Holstein, east of Hamburg, and the practice can be reached by phone or email.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Anja Krambeck Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Anja Krambeck is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice near Elmshorn, in Klein Offenseth-Sparrieshoop. Anja Krambeck has been a certified bioresonance therapist trained in the method after Paul Schmidt since May 2022, and offers it alongside osteopathy, several acupuncture techniques and classical naturopathy. Dark-field microscopy is also part of the practice. Appointments are made by phone. The practice has wheelchair-accessible parking.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Belinda Jahn
listings.description: Belinda Jahn's naturopathic practice in Dörpling offers bioresonance sessions after Paul Schmidt, which it presents as a gentle approach suited to children too. Other offers are massage, hypnosis, sessions with the Physiokey, the Liebscher & Bracht method, HNC (human-neuro-cybrainetics) and the Restart nutrition concept. The practice also keeps a blog and a page on massage techniques. Wheelchair-accessible parking is available and appointments are recommended. Phone ahead with any questions about the first visit.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Kurzenmoor, Monika Holst, Hp
listings.description: Monika Holst runs Naturheilpraxis Kurzenmoor in Seester as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her naturopathic methods include bioresonance, gentle chiropractic after Marienhoff, foot reflexology massage, manual lymph drainage after Dr. Vodder, Liebscher & Bracht work and Bach flower therapy. She trained in each of these methods and also has training in Bach flower therapy and foot reflexology. Appointments are made by phone or the contact page, and the practice is in Seester in Schleswig-Holstein.

listings.name: Japanese Acupuncture - Bioresonance & Supportive Therapies
listings.description: Michail runs this London practice, which pairs Japanese acupuncture and Chinese medicine with device-based bioresonance. An initial assessment looks at pulse, tongue, abdomen and meridians. Bioresonance sessions use Asyra Pro, NLS Hunter and Deta Elis Professional for a detailed look at organs and systems. Remote sessions are possible with a DNA sample, a voice recording and a recent photograph. Other options include Tuina massage, SCENAR, low level laser, molecular hydrogen, ozone, a Spooky2 Rife machine and a Bio-Mat, plus healthy living guidance and retreats. A free 15 minute consultation is offered. Appointments are required. Rated 4.9 from 44 Google reviews, 43 of them five stars. Client testimonials are shared, and a page on other services covers detoxification protocols and healthy living guidance for everyday routines.

listings.name: Bioresonance Therapy London / Biofeedback / Holistic Healing
listings.description: Based in W5 Ealing, this practice combines bioresonance, biofeedback and natural approaches with elements of life coaching. Sessions are tailored to the whole person, covering body, mind and energy, with a focus on stress reduction and energy balance. The list includes bioresonance scans, zapping, meta sessions and frequency work. A follow-up session runs one hour, a full body scan two hours and a first session with the full range three hours. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 30 Google reviews, 29 of them five stars.

listings.name: Bioresonance4you - London
listings.description: Claire Granahan founded Bioresonance4you after a career of about 40 years in the corporate world, having begun with Reiki more than two decades ago. A first consultation includes a Bicom body scan, after which the client is connected to a Bicom Optima for further sessions. Frequencies from a session can be stored on a Bicom chip to take away. The practice works with Regumed technology and favours a preventive approach to wellbeing. New clients receive pre-session preparation guidance and can book online, and a book on bioresonance is available. The practice offers on-site services. Rated 5.0 from 17 Google reviews, all of them five stars. A short video explains bioresonance, and headings cover the holistic approach, non-invasive sessions and detox support.

listings.name: Bicom London
listings.description: Working on the latest generation of Bicom Optima device, Bicom London has offered Bicom bioresonance in the city for over 25 years. Body scan check sessions are on the menu, and the practice also covers stress among its areas of interest. New clients can read an overview of bioresonance before booking. Appointments are recommended are accepted. Rated 4.5 from 23 Google reviews, 20 of them five stars and 3 one star. Call ahead to ask how a first session works and how long it lasts.

listings.name: Bicom Allergy and Intolerance Testing Instant Results - Longevity - Detox - Lyme
listings.description: Bioresonance sessions on a Bicom device are offered at this London practice, which gives its experience as more than 40 years. The Bicom company was founded in Germany 35 years ago. Sessions come with elimination diet advice and an introduction to herbal supplements. New clients can book a complimentary call with the nutrition team to talk through which option suits their situation, or request a call back or an appointment online. Booking runs through the practice's own online shop, and a testimonials section shares client experiences. Appointments are required are accepted. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Clinics are in London, and a Bicom step by step page walks clients through what happens during a session.

listings.name: Healing Worldwide
listings.description: Body scan sessions with bioresonance and radionics are offered from Avenue Mansions in London NW3, alongside a six week health optimisation programme, books and recommended products. A free 15 minute phone consultation is available to anyone who wants to talk through what to expect before booking. Reviews describe a first body scan as professional, with suggestions given afterwards. Appointments are required. Rated 4.6 from 9 Google reviews, 8 of them five stars and one at one star. Phone 07780 880676.

listings.name: The Holistic Hub London
listings.description: Founded by Sharmila Hume, The Holistic Hub takes a bioregulatory approach to wellbeing from its London base, with bioresonance sessions, nutritional supplements, BRMT and Weleda products. Programmes include BioPerformance and Brain Health, with a recovery room on site, and lifestyle support runs alongside. Clients complete a history form, then talk through their background before sessions begin. Both in-person and online sessions are available, and people travel from across the UK and abroad. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Prime Integrative Health
listings.description: Prime Integrative Health in Romford, London combines bioresonance with naturopathic principles, with every plan personal to the client. Three paths are available: a Bioresonance Wellness Screening, a Naturopathic Consultation, and an Integrative Health Assessment that joins both in one extended session. Longer sessions begin with a conversation about the client's history, lifestyle and goals. Advanced laboratory tests are also offered. Practitioner Nicolae leads the practice. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Appointments are booked online.

listings.name: Bioresonance and Detoxification
listings.description: Metatron sessions sit at the centre of this London practice, which works with a non-linear bioresonance system. Bioinductors are placed on the head and the full scan runs for about 30 minutes, with results shown in real time on 3D software. A health questionnaire and optional iris analysis come before it, and the scan can be paired with detox support. Online private consultations on nutrition and herbal protocols are available, and remote scanning is offered too. The practitioner lists skills and qualifications for clients to read, and further pages cover VR Metatron, pyramid devices and client feedback. Everything is written in English and Bulgarian. Rated 3.5 from 2 Google reviews. A disclaimer and privacy policy are published, the contact page includes a form, and one page covers the quantum entanglement idea behind remote scanning.

listings.name: Anican UK
listings.description: Face-to-face bioresonance sessions are the focus at Anican UK, a London wellness centre. Each session is personalised, and a curated range of wellbeing products and services is also available online. Call to ask which device is used, what a first session involves and how to book before you travel.

listings.name: biohealth
listings.description: Asyra Pro bio-resonance scan sessions are the work of this Newington Green practice in London N1, with Canonbury overground the nearest station. The practitioner has been certified in Asyra since 2012 and first worked from a pharmacy in the Barbican before relocating. A five minute scan with the Asyra Pro forms the starting point for a longer consultation, and new clients can book a consultation to begin.

listings.name: Helixa Therapies
listings.description: Women-owned Helixa Therapies in London brings bioresonance together with homeopathy, Bach flowers, EFT and breathing techniques. Health and nutrition coaching is part of the mix, so a visit can combine a bioresonance session with lifestyle guidance. Call to ask which therapies suit your goals and how long a first appointment takes. Opening hours are posted, an about page introduces the practitioner, and each therapy has its own page explaining what a session involves.

listings.name: Lloyd Gee - Naturopath & Herbalist
listings.description: Lloyd Gee offers naturopathy and herbalism consultations in London, with Asyra bioenergetic sessions as part of the mix. His work combines detailed lifestyle guidance with tailored herbal formulations drawn from Western and Chinese traditions, aimed at vitality and resilience. Consultations take place in person or online.

listings.name: Natural Approaches
listings.description: Natural Approaches is a naturopathic clinic in Swanley that blends Western functional approaches with Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ayurveda, constitutional analysis, bioresonance and biomagnetism. Its NLS device, the Hunter Meta 4025, uses a headset to listen to the body's subtle electromagnetic activity, and Biomagnetic Pair Therapy and Remote Bioenergetics Therapy are also offered. Most services can be delivered remotely, although pulse reading is available only in person, and consultations are offered in person and virtually to clients in the UK and internationally. Care plans come as a Wellness Foundation or a Premium Health Optimisation path, and the team adds habit formation coaching, lifestyle optimisation and concierge-level management. A discovery call is the place to start, a team page introduces the practitioners.

listings.name: Newlands Park Natural Healthcare Centre
listings.description: Several therapists share Newlands Park Natural Healthcare Centre in London, among them a bioresonance practitioner, a homeopath, a kinesiologist and a counsellor, with sports and remedial massage also on offer. Kinesiology and counselling are available in the same building. Call to ask which practitioner suits you and how bioresonance sessions are booked.

listings.name: Pure Homeopathy
listings.description: Pure Homeopathy in Swanley, Kent, is a homeopathy practice that also offers bioresonance health screening. It is a local option for anyone in Swanley interested in a bioresonance session. Call to ask what a first appointment involves, which device is used, where appointments take place and how to book.

listings.name: Roblaw Natural Health
listings.description: For physical, mental, emotional and spiritual wellbeing, Roblaw Natural Health in London offers bio resonance scanning with detox support, massage therapy, and nutrition and exercise plans. A selection of natural products is also sold. Call to ask how a first visit works and what a session involves.

listings.name: Lilias Ahmeira
listings.description: After thirty years in practice, Lilias Ahmeira is a London holistic practitioner who lists bioresonance, EFT, A.R.T. and electronic gem therapy among the fields she introduced to the UK. She was also an accredited magnet therapist. Rated 5.0 from 93 Google reviews, 92 of them five stars. Call to ask which sessions are currently offered and how to book.

listings.name: Acupuncture and Bioresonance Centre
listings.description: Acupuncture and Bioresonance Centre is an acupuncture clinic in Croydon that puts bioresonance in its name. The clinic welcomes LGBTQ clients and is a transgender-safe space, and appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all at five stars. Call or email ahead to ask which devices are used and how to book.

listings.name: Dr Stephen Simpson MB ChB MFOM MBA
listings.description: Dr Stephen Simpson works from London as a mind coach and hypnotherapist and describes bioresonance among his skills. He is also a presenter, TEDx speaker and author, with books, audiobooks and podcasts alongside his performance coaching for high-profile clients. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call to ask whether bioresonance sessions are part of what he currently offers.

listings.name: Bioresonance Plus
listings.description: Bioresonance Plus is a nutritionist practice in London where qualified nutritional therapists work closely with each client on a personalised plan. Alternative therapy services are offered, with availability around the clock and opening hours posted. Call to ask whether bioresonance sessions are part of what is on offer and how to book.

listings.name: Quantum Biofeedback by Augusta
listings.description: Augusta works as a biofeedback practitioner in London, and her practice name points to quantum biofeedback. It is a local option for anyone in the city who wants to try a biofeedback session. Call to ask which biofeedback system is used, what a first session involves and how appointments are booked.

listings.name: Pure Vibes by Christina
listings.description: Pure Vibes by Christina is a wellness practice in Beeton built around AO Scan bioresonance technology by Solex. Sessions combine biofeedback scans with AI wellness tools and personalised programmes, from a first frequency scan to the Longevity Blueprint Program and the Inner Frequency Method. The practice also covers energy and sleep routines, emotional balance, PEMF and light therapy, water ionisation and purification, supplements and home wellness tools. The business is owned by women. Rated 5.0 from 41 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Harmonic Egg Ottawa
listings.description: Harmonic Egg Ottawa is a women-owned wellness centre where sessions take place in a bio resonance chamber that combines sacred geometry, sound, colour and light. Clients can book an in-person session or a remote session from home, which follows the same steps by phone or Zoom, and remote sessions can be done for a pet or for a space. Land and space clearing is also offered, and the team publishes a podcast, a blog and testimonials. Pricing, packages and booking policies are posted. Rated 5.0 from 39 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Quantum & Holistic Wellness Clinic Reverse Aging Wellness Clinic
listings.description: Quantum & Holistic Wellness Clinic, also known as Reverse Aging Wellness Clinic, is a women owned clinic in Mississauga that pairs modern wellness technology with older traditions. Services include quantum biofeedback, an Electro Interstitial Scan, introspective hypnosis, QHHT, PEMF and scalar therapies, red light therapy and colon hydrotherapy. It also offers slimming wraps, Venus Freeze, holistic aesthetics, Raindrop Technique, Tibetan massage, reflexology and a Lectro Chi negative ion session. Appointments are required and free parking is on site. Rated 5.0 from 34 Google reviews, 33 of them five stars.

listings.name: Karen Jay-Moore Soul Path Psychotherapy & Holistic Services
listings.description: Karen Jay-Moore Soul Path Psychotherapy & Holistic Services in Orillia is led by Karen Jay-Moore, M.Ed., a Registered Psychotherapist who works with children, teens, adults, couples and families in person in Barrie and Orillia and online. Holistic services include AO Scan biofeedback, Reiki, evidential mediumship and psychic readings and spiritual guidance, and she teaches Reiki training, workshops and intuitive development. Karen is also an author whose book won the International Impact Book Award. A complimentary consultation can be booked, and appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 30 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Her pages also introduce Dianne, a second practitioner, and an articles and insights section, with resources for learning and growth. Sessions can be booked as a first appointment or as a follow-up,, and her books and resources are published for readers.

listings.name: Studio on 88/ QFHealing
listings.description: Known as the Hairapist for over 45 years, the owner of Studio on 88/ QFHealing in Bond Head combines hair cutting with energy work. The services list includes quantum biofeedback, a homeopathy practice, crystal work, therapeutic touch, Ancient Egyptian Reiki and spiritual advice. Hair cuts with energy work are chair service only, and a full session is booked as a separate appointment. Visits are by appointment, arranged by text. Rated 5.0 from 29 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Community Health & Prevention Care - Mental Health Counselling Scarborough
listings.description: Community Health & Prevention Care serves Scarborough in Toronto with quantum biofeedback, neurofeedback, PEMF, InLight, BrainTap and HeartMath Emwave Pro sessions. Counselling, chiropractic, physiotherapy, preventive care education, a weight management programme, a 30 day meal plan and an anti-inflammatory eating guide round out the offering. Virtual services are listed too. Phone (416) 439-2001. Rated 5.0 from 22 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Phone numbers include 1 (844) 947-0292 for international callers and (416) 729-1064, and Facebook and Instagram profiles are linked.

listings.name: Energy Over Matter - Bio Resonance Scan, Hypnotherapy, Sound Healing, NLP, PEMF
listings.description: Energy Over Matter in Newmarket offers bio scan sessions that use NES miHealth technology and Infoceuticals, in person or remotely, along with PEMF, hypnotherapy, NLP, bioenergetic wellness coaching, yoga sound baths, meditation and online courses. New clients can book a free discovery call, and a free community circle and free account give access to audio and video tools. The practice also hosts a podcast, publishes books and a blog and runs a shop with chakra pendants and audio experiences. Bookings are made online, and appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 19 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Its pages also cover a Bio Scan service page, yoga sound baths, meditation, books and a podcast, and the business has won a Centre of Excellence 2025 Inspiration Award.

listings.name: NIM Centre, Natural and Integrative Medicine
listings.description: Reni leads NIM Centre, Natural and Integrative Medicine, which uses quantum biofeedback with each client. Sessions are paired with health coaching and Dolphin Neurostim microcurrent point stimulation. New clients can book a free consultation or an appointment online. Reni also keeps a blog on natural integrative medicine, and client comments praise her knowledge of quantum biofeedback. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars. A page explains what quantum biofeedback is and how it is used, and visitors can read comments from clients, browse the blog and write to reneta.pereira@gmail.com. The centre works with clients of all ages and invites them to take the first step towards a new routine for stress and energy balance. Appointments are booked online.

listings.name: NUTRAPURE HEALTH MANAGEMENT CENTRE
listings.description: NutraPure Health Management Centre in Richmond Hill offers precision nutrition, personalized wellness programs and ZYTO Balance assessments. Its services include InBody 380 body composition analysis, nutrition consultations, sleep and stress support, women's wellness, longevity programs and a 100 Families Health Together Program. Online sessions are available and work much like in-person ones, with simple instructions to join. The team can be reached by phone, and sessions are booked online. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: The Holistic Haven Collective
listings.description: The Holistic Haven Collective in Sarnia, Ontario, is a women owned wellness space where several practitioners share one address. Services include ZYTO scans, massage therapy, art therapy, Reiki, 9D breathwork, breath and sound therapy, tarot and psychic readings, and an on-site apothecary shop with herbal products and natural goods. Events such as a Full Moon Tea Party are on the calendar, and practitioners can apply to join the collective. Appointments are recommended and the entrance is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Dr. Julie Chan - Markham Naturopathic Doctor and Acupuncturist at Liberty Wellness Clinic
listings.description: Dr. Julie Chan practises at Liberty Wellness Clinic in downtown Markham as a board certified naturopathic doctor, registered acupuncturist and NES practitioner, with almost 20 years of experience. She works with clients of all ages. Her services include acupuncture and cupping, plant-based nutrition, pediatric care, homeopathy, herbal medicine, lifestyle guidance and nutritional counseling, and she runs a naturopathic insomnia program and a program for ADHD care. Bioenergetic and biofeedback sessions use NES Health, Energy4Life and Genius Biofeedback, and the aim is to harmonize the energies of the body to support wellness. Virtual appointments are offered across Ontario, with in-person visits in the Greater Toronto Area. Appointments are required and free parking is on site. Rated 4.9 from 7 Google reviews, 6 of them five stars.

listings.name: Universal Touch Holistic Health
listings.description: Universal Touch Holistic Health in Sarnia offers ZYTO biocommunication scans, followed by suggestions that can include herbs, oils, supplements and vitamins. Crystal therapies, spiritual counseling and spiritual energy readings with tarot or oracle cards are on the list as well. The practice is owned by women and welcomes LGBTQ clients. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Ecohealth & Wellness
listings.description: Krop BioResonance Studio is a division of Ecohealth & Wellness in Mississauga, built on more than 40 years of experience in holistic health. The studio uses Bicom bioresonance exclusively for its sessions, a technology from Germany. A first visit can include a computerized organ scan, a Bicom bioresonance balancing session, a chakra screening on the Asyra and a discussion of the client's concerns and goals. The team is led by Jozef Krop (MD retired, CNP), and a video series, articles and events explain how bioresonance is used. Appointments are recommended, and the entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible. Cards are accepted. Subscribers receive articles and event news. Rated 4.8 from 6 Google reviews, 5 of them five stars.

listings.name: Bio-Care Bioresonance Therapy
listings.description: Bio-Care Bioresonance Therapy in Thornhill, Ontario is led by a certified biofeedback and bioresonance therapist who is also a holistic nutritionist. Sessions place electrodes on the skin and connect to a Bicom machine, and SCIO biofeedback and Oligoscan are also on the menu, along with a Bicom body check and aromatherapy. Remote sessions and a vet wellness service for animals are offered. A shop and a visit page are available. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call 1-416-316-1061 to ask about booking. A Bicom body check gives new clients a quick start. The therapist is certified in biofeedback and bioresonance and is also a holistic nutritionist, and bioresonancecanada@gmail.com handles enquiries.

listings.name: Bioresonance Therapy
listings.description: Bioresonance Therapy has served East Gwillimbury and nearby Sharon, Ontario, since 2013. The practitioner holds Regumed certification as a bioresonance therapist and is a registered holistic nutritionist trained at the Canadian School of Natural Nutrition. A first consultation uses an NLS non-linear scanning device, a biofeedback tool, and later sessions use BICOM bioresonance, which is tailored to each client. Follow-up sessions last 60 minutes and run in person or remotely, and a remote therapy option suits clients who live far away. Nutrition support is offered too, and each follow-up adjusts the programme to the client's response. Contact is by phone, text or email on 416-605-8523. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Bio Supreme Canada
listings.description: Bio Supreme Canada is a Richmond Hill health spa that works with the Regumed BICOM device, including the BICOM Optima, and has more than 10 years of experience. Bioresonance sessions are offered for people and for animals, and the practice also supplies BICOM devices, accessories and special equipment, with a library and a section on principles for anyone who wants to learn more. Appointments are recommended, and parking and the restroom are wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call or email for details. The BICOM Optima is billed as the bioresonance therapy of the future, and the practice's pages also cover the product range, CTT accessories and a library of reference material.

listings.name: Elevated Wellness
listings.description: Elevated Wellness at 1087 Vindin St in Midland, Ontario, offers AO bio-resonance scan sessions, including an Inner-Voice scan, and frequencies can be sent to pets as well. The range also includes focused shockwave therapy, Wolfe non-surgical deep tissue therapy, regenerative cellular therapy, Bioptron light therapy and personalised health coaching. A Perfect Day consultation and a shop are part of the offer. Appointments can be booked online. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review, at five stars. The practice also has an About page, a shop and an email contact. The Bioptron light sessions and regenerative cellular therapy each have their own page, and the Perfect Day consultation is a separate booking. Frequencies can be sent to one or more people or objects at a time.

listings.name: Wellbeing With Nadia
listings.description: Wellbeing With Nadia in Oshawa is a holistic nutrition practice led by Nadia, a Certified Genius Quantum Biofeedback Practitioner and Food Matters Nutritional Coach. She offers quantum biofeedback in person and online, holistic health coaching for women, a women's ion foot cleanse and custom essential oil rollerballs. Remote energy scans work from a short voice recording and a current photo, with a Zoom appointment for the Energetic Deep Dive, and a 30-Day Stress Kit and a self-guided option are available. A shop, a blog and a free quiz help visitors find a starting point. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review, at five stars. A page on energetic support explains how quantum biofeedback works and what clients may notice, and Nadia describes the technology as only one part of her approach.

listings.name: Quantum Biofeedback Hamilton
listings.description: Quantum Biofeedback Hamilton is the practice of Nadiya, a BANHS certified quantum biofeedback specialist working in Hamilton, Ontario, with an Ancaster address. The practice offers full-body stress reduction sessions with quantum biofeedback, described as non-invasive, and consultations can be booked by phone on 905-923-2099 or by email. Pages cover the benefits of biofeedback, frequently asked questions and client testimonials, and the business is owned by women. Parking is wheelchair accessible. It also sells a patch product and offers biofeedback software. Sessions are non-invasive and suitable for all ages, and Nadiya also teaches mindfulness practices. Hours are posted, and a consultation is the way to get started with a certified specialist. Rated 1.0 from 1 Google review, at one star.

listings.name: Crystal Clear Intentions Wellness & Yoga
listings.description: Crystal Clear Intentions Wellness & Yoga in New Tecumseth offers AO Scan sessions alongside Reiki, Access Bars and Access Energetic Facelift. Its energy sessions are aimed at relaxation and stress relief, and appointments are recommended. Call ahead to ask how long a scan session lasts, where appointments take place, whether yoga classes run on a regular schedule and how to book.

listings.name: Dr. Tatiana Smirnova, ND
listings.description: Vital Roots Clinic is a naturopathic and Chinese medicine practice in midtown Toronto, at Yonge and Davisville and a five minute walk from Davisville subway station. Dr. Tatiana Smirnova is a naturopathic doctor (ND), registered acupuncturist and registered practitioner of traditional Chinese medicine. Services include nutraceuticals and supplements, diet changes, herbal medicine, acupuncture, electro-acupuncture, moxibustion, cupping and cosmetic acupuncture. Therapeutic devices are part of the clinic, including low-intensity laser, PEMF, biofeedback and bioresonance sessions, and a bio-resonance assessment is offered. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Quantum Biofeedback
listings.description: Quantum Biofeedback in Markham is a local practice whose name points to quantum biofeedback sessions. It is an option for anyone nearby who is curious about the approach and wants to try a session. Call ahead to ask which system is used, what a first session involves, whether appointments are recommended and how to book.

listings.name: The Happy Gut Clinic
listings.description: The Happy Gut Clinic in Frome, Somerset, was founded by Kara Mia Vernon, who offered colon hydrotherapy in London for 15 years before opening here. Her approach covers mind, body and spirit, with nutrition consultations that include bio-resonance health screening on the Asyra, colon hydrotherapy, hypnotherapy by Skype or Zoom, naturopathy, homeopathy, EFT, Matrix re-imprinting and massage. She combines naturopathic, homeopathic and energetic training with the bio-resonance technology to cut down on trial and error. Her commitment is individual guidance to support each client's health and wellbeing. Articles, press coverage and a price list are published, the clinic welcomes enquiries by phone, and bookings can be made on 07957 341 741. Rated 5.0 from 31 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: MT.LOUNGE
listings.description: MT.LOUNGE in Swindon is a women-owned integrative wellness practice that works in English and Portuguese. Orthomolecular nutrition and bioresonance sit alongside aesthetics such as microneedling. Rated 5.0 from 23 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Appointments are required, and there is a free parking lot. Sessions are booked in advance, so ask about availability and what a first visit involves.

listings.name: Quantum Paws - Animal Bioresonance & Holistic Therapy
listings.description: Animals are the focus of Quantum Paws in Bristol, which offers gentle bioresonance and holistic sessions for dogs, cats and horses. Animal communication and emotional balance work are included. Sessions take place in person or online across the UK and Europe. Rated 5.0 from 18 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Adam Hardyman
listings.description: Adam Hardyman practises homeopathy and bioresonance from Willow Cottage Clinic, 67 Richmond Park Avenue in Bournemouth, a clinic established in the town for over 40 years. A qualified homeopath and bioresonance practitioner with more than 20 years in practice, he has also trained extensively in nutrition, SCENAR, SCIO and heart rate variability. His approach pairs traditional ideas with modern technology, and sessions can combine homeopathy, herbal medicine, BICOM bioresonance, SCIO and QXCI biofeedback, HRV and nutritional advice. BICOM, SCIO and HRV each have their own service description, so ask which suits a first visit. Heart rate variability sessions are also available. Rated 5.0 from 14 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Dorsetbiohealth
listings.description: Dorsetbiohealth in Ringwood offers bioresonance sessions, a non-invasive biohealth technology that can be used at home. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars. An appointment is recommended, so call to ask what a session involves and where it takes place.

listings.name: Hillside Massage / Bath
listings.description: Jan Erik Posth runs Hillside Massage in central Bath, pairing deep tissue Swedish massage and reflexology with BioSonics bioresonance. Since 2023 he has worked with electronic bioresonance instruments. Other options include Indian head massage, Reiki, naturopathy and corporate massage, and home visits are available on request. He is professionally insured. Rated 4.8 from 4 Google reviews, 3 of them five stars and one four stars. A newsletter and a Trustpilot page are also linked.

listings.name: Andromedan Frequency Therapies UK
listings.description: Andromedan Frequency Therapies UK is a frequency and bioresonance practice in Bridport. Sessions use the Metatron Hunter 4025 NLS bioresonance system, which scans first and then runs frequency programs, and the practice also offers Rife frequencies and sound therapy. Supplements are available too. The practice welcomes LGBTQ clients and is a transgender-safe space, with free street parking and onsite parking. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all at five stars.

listings.name: Living Better Health Clinic, Professional Qualified & Insured
listings.description: Women's natural health is the focus at Living Better Health Clinic, which serves Bath, Bristol, Bradford-on-Avon, Trowbridge and Frome. Bio resonance sessions sit beside nutrition, homeopathy, EFT, life coaching, Accunect and Tera Mai Reiki and Seichem. New clients can book a free 15 minute call to talk through options. The practice also runs a blog, an ask the expert page and a shop of superfood products. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Packages and prices are discussed on the call.

listings.name: Mind Body Being
listings.description: Mind Body Being in Tidworth is a complementary practice offering classical homeopathy and bio-resonance health screening, with Reiki sessions and Reiki training on request. Talking therapy is included in each session. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. An appointment is recommended and the parking is wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Winged Heart Healing Bioresonance - Totnes
listings.description: Nik Heartsong runs a quantum bioresonance practice that was based in Totnes, Devon, and now works fully remotely with clients worldwide over Zoom. Nik Sessions use technology that scans over 400 parameters through a voice recording and a photograph, with no physical contact needed, and the experience is the same remotely as in person. A free 30 minute call is offered before booking a session. The main sessions are a 90 minute Quantum Bioresonance Therapy session and a two month complete quantum program, and supplements are sold alongside. Former Totnes and South Devon clients are welcome online, so check the service area before booking. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Bio Health Tech
listings.description: Bio Health Tech in Poole works with frequency approaches, using a computer controlled bio resonance system that completes a fast automated full body scan within the same session. The business also supplies body scan systems along with product training, a Session Guide with a pictorial tutorial, and lifetime support, and the technology can be used without a health background. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review. Hours are posted, and the entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible, so call to confirm availability and how to book.

listings.name: Bio Health Scan
listings.description: Bio Health Scan in Poole offers bioresonance health scans built around an automated full body scan. Onboarding sessions last up to an hour and start with the scan, and scans can be done locally or at a distance through the Scancaster system from the client's own computer at home. The practice also runs a Subtle Energy Research Programme, a 21 Day Challenge, training, specialists and an after sales service, and sells products. It is a CMA approved supplier and has a hearing loop and accessible restroom. Call 07734 200 516 to book.

listings.name: Equilibrium Health
listings.description: Equilibrium Health in Cheltenham is a functional nutrition practice that adds bioresonance health screening, DNA-based nutrition information, SCENAR sessions and Rapid Transformational Therapy. Call to ask what a first appointment involves, which device is used and how to book before you plan a visit. It is a local option for anyone in Cheltenham curious about a session.

listings.name: Homeopathy for Pets
listings.description: Homeopathy for Pets in Glastonbury offers homeopathic medicines for animals and pets, including personalised frequencies made with ASYRA technology. Bespoke personalised homeopathic medicines are also available for adults, children and babies, and the approach works alongside other medications. Opening hours are not posted, so make contact to ask about services and how to book.

listings.name: Innate Healing Nailsworth
listings.description: Innate Healing Nailsworth offers Asyra bio-resonance scanning, together with Body Stress Release and a range of holistic extras: a Migun therapy bed, a hydrogen ion foot bath, hemp CBD products and the Viridian nutrition range. The practitioner works with his wife and describes the practice as being in Devon, although it is entered under Stroud, so confirm the address and service area by phone. Scanning is currently offered remotely, using a photograph or hair sample posted to the practice. The Asyra is presented as preparing a customised programme for each client. Call or email to ask how remote scanning works and how long it takes.

listings.name: Lloyd Gee - Natural Health Consultant
listings.description: Natural health consultations with Lloyd Gee in Cheltenham bring naturopathy, herbalism and Asyra bioenergetic sessions together. He pairs lifestyle guidance with personalised herbal formulations from Western and Chinese traditions, aiming at vitality and resilience. Consultations are available in person or online. Call to ask what a first Asyra session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Quantum & Scalar Biofeedback Clinic
listings.description: Frequency Medicine Group, a not-for-profit registered in England and Wales, operates the Quantum & Scalar Biofeedback Clinic from the Bristol area and works globally. A Comprehensive Quantum Health Scan can be ordered, and distance sessions run with the SCIO bio-resonance device through an automated service. Sound events are held, appointments and fees are listed, and the group publishes research articles, a code of conduct, an ethics statement and a vulnerable persons statement. Visitors can meet the team and try a software demo. Pages also cover data protection and the group's research. A research and articles section, third-party research and a software demo are available, and the group lists its articles of association and Companies House registration. The group works from the Bristol area and has a global reach.

listings.name: Resonance Wellness
listings.description: Resonance Wellness, trading as Resonate Well, is a women owned practice in Totnes led by Janie Matthews Read, a holistic wellbeing and energy medicine specialist. It offers bioresonance, a Bioscan, PEMF therapy and the SLIMYONIK AIR Bodystyler, with consultations bookable online. Bioscan is used alongside bioresonance, and a disclaimer page explains what the services are and are not. Consultations can be booked online. Appointments are required and recommended, and the practice welcomes LGBTQ clients. The seating and restroom are wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: The Cheltenham Migraine Clinic Equilibrium Health
listings.description: A programme of four appointments is the structure at The Cheltenham Migraine Clinic, which shares its home with Equilibrium Health. An initial consultation is followed by visits at months one, two and three, each using a functional approach with bioresonance health screening and SCENAR. Nutrition, homeopathy, mindfulness and lifestyle changes are part of the plan. Call to ask how to book.

listings.name: The Quantum Nutritionist
listings.description: The Quantum Nutritionist in Wells offers nutritional therapy and dietary advice, homeopathy and Asyra bioresonance functional health screening for individuals, families and pets. Call to confirm opening times and to ask what a first session involves.

listings.name: Enerwell Bioresonance
listings.description: Enerwell Bioresonance is a naturopath practice in Fordingbridge that puts bioresonance in its name. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both at five stars. Call to ask which device is used, what a first session involves, where it takes place and how to book.

listings.name: ASYRA Digital Homeopathy & Naturopathy
listings.description: ASYRA Digital Homeopathy & Naturopathy is a Bath homeopath practice, and its name points to Asyra sessions alongside homeopathy and naturopathy. Call to ask which device is used, what a first session involves, what hours it keeps and how appointments are booked before you plan a visit. It is a local option for anyone in Bath.

listings.name: Empowering Health - Kinesiology, Bioresonance, Energy Healing
listings.description: Empowering Health is the practice of Anne Barratt, a women owned kinesiology and bioresonance business in the Blue Mountains of New South Wales. Sessions use AO Scan bioresonance alongside kinesiology, hypnotherapy, counselling, life coaching, NLP, EFT tapping, Reiki and Human Design, and Anne also offers nervous system regulation work for adults and children. Online appointments are available across Australia and internationally, with in-person sessions in the Blue Mountains. An online shop sells eCourses, books, essences and equipment, including a subscription to AO Scan technology. Pages cover childlessness support, menopause, hypnotherapy and healthy nutrition, and Anne shares media and podcast interviews and client testimonials. Gift vouchers and a referrals program are available. Rated 5.0 from 61 Google reviews, 60 of them five stars.

listings.name: Optimum Health Essentials
listings.description: Optimum Health Essentials in Newport is a group of natural health professionals combining chiropractic and applied kinesiology, acupuncture, Chinese medicine, functional medicine health coaching and nutrition with energy medicine tools: low level laser, PEMF, far infrared sauna and bioresonance. Integrative coaching and retreats are also offered. Appointments are required. Phone 02 9999 1680. Rated 4.5 from 30 Google reviews, 25 of them five stars, 2 at four stars and 3 at one star. The clinic also publishes a blog and social channels, and new clients can book an Optimiser session online or by phone.

listings.name: Holistic Healing Choices
listings.description: Holistic Healing Choices in Orange, Central West NSW, offers MORA bioresonance sessions alongside remedial massage, Heartworks Lomi Lomi, 6Ka Huna, NLP, EFT, CTC (Combined Therapy Cocktail), Reiki and emotional trigger release massage. Training courses and events run through the year, and consultant Dr Julie Henry is on the team. Bookings are online with Rob, Jean or Julie, gift vouchers are available, and the studio is at 71 Kite Street. Phone 02 6361 0650. Rated 4.9 from 19 Google reviews, 18 of them five stars.

listings.name: Pure Nature Life - Naturopath & Natural Medicine Clinic
listings.description: Pure Nature Life is a naturopathy and natural medicine clinic in Rockdale, New South Wales. Naturopathy, nutritional and herbal medicine, homeopathy, biopuncture and bioresonance therapy are all part of the menu, and weight loss support and a quit smoking program are listed too. The practitioners include a naturopath, a nutritionist and a bioresonance therapist, and there is an online shop. Rated 5.0 from 17 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The clinic is women-owned and appointments are required. Phone 0479 079 633.

listings.name: The Health Concept by Marta
listings.description: The Health Concept by Marta is a naturopathic practice in Crows Nest, serving the Sydney area, founded by Marta Saracevic. Its wellness solutions cover naturopathy and bioresonance, with functional testing, comprehensive holistic support and personalised care tailored to each person, and a shop for products. Clients can read about Marta's own journey and approach, see testimonials and book an appointment online. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Coastal Natural Energy Therapies
listings.description: Coastal Natural Energy Therapies is a practice on the NSW Central Coast, in Chain Valley Bay, run by June Mulhall. She offers bio-resonance sessions, kinesiology and sessions on a QuantumBio Health infrared mat, working from the belief that frequencies, vibrations and resonance support balance and stress management. Bio-resonance is described as gentle and non-invasive, suitable for all ages, and it is also available as a remote session. Online booking is open. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Bio Healing
listings.description: Tania Novikova founded Bio Healing in 2006 in Bondi Junction, Sydney. She is a homoeopath and bioresonance practitioner who also offers Theta work, Universal Therapy and Matrix Energetics, and she holds a biology degree. An Oligiscan and group work are among the further services, and a consultation can be booked online. Phone +61 421 895 244. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. A common complaints page and a meet your practitioner page help new clients decide where to begin.

listings.name: Megan Clarke Natural Health
listings.description: Megan Clarke Natural Health in Woy Woy is led by Megan Clarke, an herbalist, nutritionist, iridologist and AO Bioresonance practitioner who began as a registered nurse. Consultations combine nutrition, herbal care, nervous system regulation and AO Bioresonance, and AO scans can also be done remotely from a photo, birth details and a voice sample, with personalised Vital Tones sent to the client afterwards. Metabolic health and functional testing pages are published, along with a blog. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Phone +61 402 330 022.

listings.name: Innovative Healing
listings.description: Innovative Healing in Paddington, Randwick, NSW, is a restorative health clinic offering remote and in-person appointments that use bio-resonance coherence sessions alongside photobiomodulation, Flowpresso, biomagnetism, traditional naturopathy and functional health coaching. Heather is a Certified Functional Medicine Health Coach. New clients can book a free 10-minute discovery call by phone. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Remote appointments follow the same approach as in-person visits, and a policies and terms page sets out booking conditions. Appointments take place in the Randwick area.

listings.name: Watch Me Thrive
listings.description: Watch Me Thrive in Dubbo is a wellness center offering breathwork, nutrition coaching, health and wellness coaching, inner child work, nervous system regulation, bioresonance scans and homeobotanical drops. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Opening hours are not posted, so call to ask about availability and how to book.

listings.name: Bio-Resonance Therapy and Homeopathy
listings.description: Bio-Resonance Therapy and Homeopathy is a Bondi Junction practice in Sydney offering bioresonance sessions tailored to each client. The approach combines traditional methods developed over centuries with newer ideas from quantum physics. Pages cover why bioresonance, the practitioner, fees, testimonials, Universal Therapy and frequently asked questions, and bookings are made through the contact page or by email at nat.biotherapy@gmail.com. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The advantages of the method and what a session is like are explained for new clients.

listings.name: 1health.au
listings.description: Bioresonance scanning is listed among the services at 1health.au in Bondi Junction, alongside holistic wellness coaching, nutrition consultation, Joy Therapy and energy work. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call to ask how a scan session works and how to book. Wellness advisor and life coach are among its listed categories.

listings.name: Lotus Centre
listings.description: Lotus Centre in Mullumbimby, New South Wales, is a natural health and wellbeing clinic where osteopathic consultations sit alongside colon hydrotherapy, far infrared sauna, EPRT and sessions with a Redragon Metatron device. Dr J Amelia Lemon is among the practitioners. Visits are by appointment only, and colon hydrotherapy times run every day of the week. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews.

listings.name: Resonance for Health
listings.description: Resonance for Health in Annandale is the practice of a traditional bioresonance practitioner serving Sydney and the Inner West. Side by side sessions are offered for family members, and there is a special interest in skin and in teaching simple biofeedback practices. A 30 minute chat can be booked online before starting. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both at five stars.

listings.name: Bioresonance Scan Byron Bay
listings.description: Bioresonance Scan Byron Bay offers full body scans on the Metatron NLS system with Red Dragon software, working from Bay Osteopathy and Wholistic Health at 71 Centennial Circuit. A scan follows the 14 Chinese meridians, and clients leave with a printout and a program to follow, including suggestions for foods, supplements and herbs. Appointments are required, and booking is online.

listings.name: Bioresonance Therapy Berry
listings.description: Bioresonance Therapy Berry is run by Megan and Lioni, holistic health practitioners trained in bioresonance therapy, with locations in Gerroa, Bowral and Berry in New South Wales. Sessions are for the whole family. The Gerroa address is 65 Stafford St and the Bowral address is Suite 3, 280 Bong Bong St. Parking is wheelchair accessible. The practice's line is Essential health for vitality and wellbeing, and the contact details are published for each location. Call 0450 214919 or 0408 509840, or email the practice, to ask about booking.

listings.name: Central Coast Natural Therapies Clinic
listings.description: Central Coast Natural Therapies Clinic in Wyoming is led by Julie McNab, a master practitioner with over 30 years of experience. Naturopathy, homoeopathy, Chinese and Western herbs, nutrition and health coaching are available, along with Bio Resonance testing. Fees, clinic hours and pre-appointment forms are published, along with a blog and testimonials.

listings.name: Quantum Psychology
listings.description: Quantum Psychology is a counselling and coaching practice serving Balmain, the Inner West, the Lower North Shore and the Eastern Suburbs of Sydney. Fiona works on emotional intelligence and perception, and sessions are supported by computerised bio-resonance software. Appointments are recommended. Call 0408 978 891 to start. Counselling, coaching and therapy are combined with the software to support wellness, and email goes to fionahird@quantumpsychology.com.au.

listings.name: Bio-Conmmunication Health
listings.description: Bio-Conmmunication Health is a Chinese medicine clinic and acupuncturist practice in Crows Nest. Its approach blends the philosophy of ancient medicine theory with bio-information technique, focusing on each person's uniqueness and on building the body's terrain and constitution. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review, at five stars. Call to ask which sessions are available.

listings.name: Bioresonance Health - Homeopathy, Natural Health and Allergist
listings.description: Bioresonance Health in Winmalee offers homeopathy and natural health consultations under a name that also points to bioresonance. Rated 3.0 from 2 Google reviews, one at five stars and one at one star. Parking is wheelchair accessible. Call to ask which services are offered, what a first appointment involves and how to book.

listings.name: Qest4
listings.description: Qest4 operates in Brookvale. Call to ask which sessions it offers, which devices it uses, what a first appointment involves, where appointments take place, how long a session lasts and how to book. It is a small local business, so confirm opening hours and availability by phone before you plan a visit.

listings.name: Dr. med. Christine Thomas
listings.description: This Dresden practice is run by a physician for internal and general medicine who lists bioresonance among a range of natural-medicine methods. The same list includes acupuncture, homeopathy, chiropractic, neural therapy and cupping. Rated 4.8 from 43 Google reviews, 39 of them five stars. The practice makes home visits and video consultations and serves as a teaching practice of TU Dresden. Opening hours are posted, online booking is available and the entrance is wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Claudia Prang
listings.description: Claudia Prang is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Dresden. Her bioresonance sessions follow the method of Paul Schmidt, and the practice also offers homeopathy, Bach flower therapy, Solunate, Dorn-Breuss method and chiropractic. Gift vouchers are available. Sessions take place by prior appointment only, booked by phone. The practice is easy to reach by car with parking close by, and it has a free parking lot and wheelchair-accessible seating. Rated 4.8 from 39 Google reviews, 37 of them five stars.

listings.name: Samsara - Leben in Balance
listings.description: Samsara in Leipzig is a skin care and wellbeing studio that pairs professional facial care with health consultations. Bioresonance is used alongside consultations on nutrition, micronutrients, hair analysis and epigenetics. A programme for workplace wellbeing, gift vouchers and an online shop are also offered. The studio is women-owned, welcomes LGBTQ and transgender guests, takes card and mobile payments and has a wheelchair-accessible entrance. Rated 5.0 from 29 Google reviews, 28 of them five stars. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Bożena Banczyk - Coach dich gesund
listings.description: Coach dich gesund is the practice of Bożena Bańczyk, a certified health counsellor and DNA nutrition specialist in Görlitz and Zgorzelec, working in German and Polish. She combines DNA-based nutrition, bioresonance analysis and micronutrient guidance, with sessions on site or online. Her site also has a recipe section, training courses and a book. Rated 5.0 from 19 Google reviews, all five stars. Confirm which side of the border the sessions take place.

listings.name: Osteopathie Kammlodt
listings.description: Osteopathie Kammlodt in Freiberg is the practice of Adrian Kammlodt, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and osteopath. Alongside osteopathy it offers BICOM bioresonance sessions, described as needle-free and suitable for children and adults. Osteopathy is listed first among its services, and the practice is on site in Freiberg. Appointments are recommended and can be booked online. Rated 5.0 from 19 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Physiotherapie Michael Demmrich
listings.description: Physiotherapie Michael Demmrich in Zwickau is a physiotherapy and osteopathy practice that also offers BICOM bioresonance sessions. McKenzie therapy is part of the range. Appointments are recommended, and the practice has wheelchair accessible parking, entrance and restroom. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Angela Langmann, Heilpraktikerin, Naturheilpraxis Wehlen
listings.description: Angela Langmann is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a naturopathic practice in Stadt Wehlen that serves the Dresden and Pirna area. Her focus is homeopathy, including for children and older people, and bioresonance sessions with a Bicom device. She also offers nutrition counselling, plant-based naturopathy and psychological counselling. Rated 4.6 from 9 Google reviews, 8 of them five stars and 1 one star.

listings.name: Therapie.Raum Mirabela Birth
listings.description: Mirabela Birth is a psychologist in Chemnitz, training as a psychotherapist, who works with children, teenagers, couples and families. Besides psychological counselling, her approaches include bioresonance with micro-frequency sessions, sound work and energy work. Appointments are required and can be arranged by email or phone during posted hours. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Körper & Form - Abnehmen im Liegen & Bodyforming, Bioresonanz Dresden, Ullersdorf, Radeberg, Pulsnitz, ...
listings.description: Körper & Form is a private studio at the Golfpark Ullersdorf, serving Dresden, Radeberg and Pulsnitz. It combines body-forming sessions using ultrasound and EMS with bioresonance, and also works on stress release in family systems and daily life. The calm setting, with free parking and a relaxed drive away from city traffic, is part of the appeal. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Rica May
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Rica May in Zwönitz has been run by Heilpraktikerin Rica May since 2006 (a Heilpraktiker is a state-licensed alternative practitioner). The range includes bioresonance sessions, kinesiology, homeopathy, Bach flowers, nutrition guidance and back work, for children and adults. Free parking is available. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: GrenzenlosFrei Praxis für Kinesiologie und Ganzheitliche Beratung Alice Schöne
listings.description: GrenzenlosFrei is a practice for kinesiology and holistic counselling in Laußnitz, run by Alice Schöne. It offers general kinesiology, psycho-kinesiology, systemic work and bioresonance therapy, and gives workshops such as stress management at work and in daily life. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review. Call ahead to confirm which sessions are offered and how to book.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Annette Költzsch
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Annette Költzsch in Taucha was founded in 1993 and offers many naturopathic methods, among them acupuncture, homeopathy, bioresonance, osteopathy, neural therapy and magnetic field therapy. Osteopathic techniques are offered on Mondays and TCM with acupuncture on Tuesdays. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Jochen Liesche
listings.description: Jochen Liesche is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and physiotherapist in Dresden. His practice offers bioresonance combined with colour puncture, as well as craniosacral osteopathy, phytotherapy, homeopathy, physiotherapy and classic massages including the Dorn-Breuss method. His stated aim is to improve quality of life. Appointments can be requested online, opening hours are posted and appointments are recommended. A restroom is on site, and the practice combines hands-on physiotherapy with its naturopathic offers.

listings.name: Praxis für Energie und Naturheilkunde Kristin Krohs
listings.description: Kristin Krohs runs a practice for energy and natural medicine in Neusalza-Spremberg that offers bioresonance alongside NLP coaching and spiritual life counselling. Her work with frequency and body methods also draws on sound, tuning forks and singing bowls, and she publishes books and offers seminars and trainings under the Elumantu name. Appointments are made by phone. Meditations, a podcast and trainings in systemic alchemy and Human Design are part of the wider offer.

listings.name: Praxis für Homöopathie und Bioresonanz
listings.description: Praxis für Homöopathie und Bioresonanz in Borna is the practice of Kathrin Hiller, a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Its two pages of approaches are homeopathy, based on Hahnemann's principles, and bioresonance, presented as a method rooted in whole-person bioenergetic thinking and in ideas from quantum physics. Appointments are made through the contact page. Call ahead to confirm opening times.

listings.name: Praxis für Homöopathie und Bioresonanz Claudia Herrmann
listings.description: Praxis für Homöopathie und Bioresonanz Claudia Herrmann in Leipzig offers bioresonance sessions with the BICOM system, applied through electrodes, alongside homeopathy, systemic counselling and Tai Chi. Bioresonance is described as a technically supported procedure, and an individual plan is drawn up with supportive measures discussed. Information on training and references is available, and non-binding enquiries are welcome. Appointments are required and recommended.

listings.name: Praxis für Osteopathie, Bioresonanz und Naturheilkunde
listings.description: Praxis für Osteopathie, Bioresonanz und Naturheilkunde is run by Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Franziska Kneissl, with rooms in Dittersdorf in Amtsberg and in Chemnitz. The practice combines osteopathy and bioresonance with homeopathy, Dorn and Breuss spine work, BEMER vascular sessions, sleep and nutrition guidance, and e-smog advice. Opening hours are posted, appointments are recommended, and parking is wheelchair accessible. Contact is through the practice pages.

listings.name: Reguvia
listings.description: Reguvia in Leipzig is the practice of a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) whose focus areas are bioresonance, homeopathy and nutrition counselling. Opening hours are posted, appointments are recommended and wheelchair-accessible seating is available. Call ahead to confirm session details.

listings.name: Selbstbestimmung50plus
listings.description: Selbstbestimmung50plus in Freiberg is the mentoring practice of Renate Fischer for people aged 50 and over, working mostly online and also on site. Offers include coaching, galvanic micro-current and bioresonance sessions, plus an education platform on blockchain technology and cryptocurrency. She also trains others in mental training. Call ahead to ask how a first session works.

listings.name: Praxis für Osteopathie, Bioresonanz und Naturheilkunde in Chemnitz
listings.description: An osteopathy practice in Chemnitz with opening hours posted. Rated 4.0 from 4 Google reviews, 3 of them five stars and 1 one star. Appointments are recommended. Call ahead to confirm which sessions and equipment the practice offers before booking.

listings.name: Lernberatung, Reflexintegration, Bioresonanz, Benaudira Hörtraining, Resilienz und Entspannung - K. Schöne
listings.description: The consultancy of K. Schöne in Panschwitz-Kuckau is listed under the consultant category and is owned by a woman. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call to confirm which sessions it offers before you plan around it.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Besler
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Besler is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice at Mariannenstraße 9-10 in Berlin-Kreuzberg, in operation for more than 11 years. Its range includes Bicom bioresonance, frequency sessions and a back concept. Appointments are required and can be booked online through Doctolib, by WhatsApp or by phone. Rated 4.9 from 59 Google reviews, 58 of them five stars and 1 one star.

listings.name: Angela M. Bernstein Praxis Raucherentwöhnung/Nichtraucherspritze/Akupunktur/Hypnose
listings.description: Angela M. Bernstein runs a naturopathic practice in Berlin that is built around BICOM bioresonance. Ear acupuncture and hypnosis are also part of the range, and gift vouchers are available. Appointments can be arranged by phone or WhatsApp. The practice has step-free seating, an accessible restroom and parking lots, both free and paid. Rated 4.6 from 43 Google reviews, 38 of them five stars and 4 one star.

listings.name: Frau Dr. med. Andrea Kerle
listings.description: Dr. med. Andrea Kerle is a gynaecologist with a private practice at Mexikoplatz in Berlin-Zehlendorf, offering a blend of conventional care and natural health methods. She brings more than 30 years of experience with natural health methods, bioresonance and acupuncture, and the practice website is available in German, English, Turkish, Arabic and Ukrainian. Rated 4.4 from 46 Google reviews, 38 of them five stars and 6 one star.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Conte
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Conte is a naturopathic practice in Berlin led by Birgit Conte, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). It offers bioresonance sessions after Paul Schmidt, plus compression massage and personal coaching. Each plan starts with a detailed first conversation and is adjusted to the individual, with appointments by arrangement. The practice is women-owned, welcomes LGBTQ clients, and has a step-free entrance, a unisex restroom and free parking. Rated 5.0 from 28 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: PRAXIS BELLADONNA / Heilpraktikerin Ulrike Pötzsch
listings.description: Praxis Belladonna is the practice of Ulrike Pötzsch, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner), in Berlin Westend and Charlottenburg. She uses Trikombin frequency sessions, a further development of bioresonance that she has worked with since September 2017, together with acupuncture and vitOrgan sessions. The practice publishes a price list and information on cost reimbursement. The entrance and restroom are wheelchair accessible, and cards and contactless payment are accepted. Rated 4.8 from 20 Google reviews, 19 of them five stars.

listings.name: Dirk Seiffert, Heilpraktiker - Naturheilpraxis am Roseneck (Chiropraktik, Schmerztherapie, Homöopathie u.v.m)
listings.description: Dirk Seiffert is a second-generation Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with more than 30 years of experience, working at Naturheilpraxis am Roseneck in Berlin-Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf. His methods include acupuncture, ear acupuncture, chiropractic, Dorn therapy, homeopathy, bioresonance, massage and therapeutic fasting. The practice leans on gentle approaches that support wellbeing and movement. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 14 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Praxis Berlin Daniela Kniese
listings.description: Daniela Kniese is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Berlin-Wannsee, running a family practice for children and adults. Her range includes bioresonance, the Vega test, electro-acupuncture, homeopathy, Schüßler salts, plant-based approaches and nutritional supplements. Each case starts with an in-depth initial interview, and a computer-assisted method helps select homeopathic preparations. A free introductory call by phone is offered before the first appointment. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Reinhardt
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Reinhardt is a naturopathic practice with rooms at Potsdamer Platz in Berlin and in Rangsdorf. Its offers include bioresonance, energetic sessions, acupuncture, cupping and classical massage, along with foot reflexology, lymphatic drainage, Breuss massage, Dorn spinal work, kinesiology and EssSense nutrition counselling. Coaching and conversation-based support are also available, and the practice runs seminars and workshops. The owner is a woman, and the entrance is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Katrin von Rabenau
listings.description: Katrin von Rabenau is a certified Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Berlin-Pankow who specialises in energy-based methods. She uses the TimeWaver information field technology, microcurrent sessions after McMakin, micronutrient guidance and REGENA homeopathy, together with Bach flowers, Schüßler salts, kinesiology, ear acupuncture after Nogier and iridology. Online consultations are held through an online surgery, home visits are possible, and she also works with animals. Her training includes TimeWaver Academy courses and classical acupuncture studies with a TCM association in Berlin. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Carolin Leidecker Heilpraktikerin für Bioresonanztherapie und Akupunktur
listings.description: Carolin Leidecker is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Berlin who combines natural health methods with acupuncture and bioresonance. Her practice offers a free 15-minute information call by phone, and appointments can be booked through Doctolib or arranged by phone, email or WhatsApp. A first acupuncture appointment runs 90 minutes and follow-ups 60 minutes. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: naturheilpraxis amg
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis AMG is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Berlin-Kreuzberg, at Dieffenbachstraße 36, that works mainly with bioresonance, foot reflexology and dry cupping, and also with Bach flowers. The practitioner also works at a second practice near Krumme Lanke in Berlin-Zehlendorf, where she offers bioresonance as well. Appointments are required, and the practice welcomes LGBTQ+ guests. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Manuela Grau
listings.description: Manuela Grau is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Berlin-Moabit who works with bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, plant-based approaches, nutrition counselling, Bach flowers, Schüßler salts and Breuss massage. The bioresonance she uses is explained with reference to Paul Schmidt's frequency research from 1976, which led to a frequency atlas. She is a member of the Verband unabhängiger Heilpraktiker e.V. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis für Bioresonanz, Craniosacrale Therapie und TCM - Melanie Timm
listings.description: Melanie Timm runs a naturopathic practice in Berlin as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). She offers bioresonance sessions after Paul Schmidt, craniosacral work, Traditional Chinese Medicine, shiatsu and Bach flower sessions, and she adapts her approach for children. Visitors are received in a calm, sheltered setting, and a first conversation can be arranged before starting. Appointments are required, hours are posted, and the entrance is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Katharina Gnidtke
listings.description: Katharina Gnidtke is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) working in Niederschönhausen, Berlin Pankow, since 2003. The practice offers bioresonance sessions and a body scan with a Bicom device, along with cupping, massage and hypnosis. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Akupunktur- und Naturheilpraxis Bannert Berlin Lichterfelde
listings.description: Jacqueline Bannert runs a women-owned Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice in Berlin-Lichterfelde, in the Steglitz-Zehlendorf district. She works with acupuncture, ear and skull acupuncture, Dorn spine and joint work and bioresonance, and her particular specialty is beauty acupuncture. Foot reflexology, red-light soft laser and Schüßler salts complete the range, and she is happy to advise by phone. Rated 4.3 from 4 Google reviews, 3 of them five stars and 1 two stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Jörg Geiger
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Jörg Geiger is a naturopathic practice in Berlin offering bioresonance alongside massage, laser EAP, acupuncture, and nutrition and training programmes. Hours are posted, appointments are required, the entrance is wheelchair accessible, and LGBTQ visitors are welcome. Rated 3.4 from 5 Google reviews, three of them five stars and two of them one star. Call to confirm which sessions are currently offered.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Christiane Brischke
listings.description: Heilpraxis Christiane Brischke in Berlin offers acupuncture, homeopathy, foot reflexology, Reiki, bioresonance and Quantec. Foot reflexology follows the method of Hanne Marquardt. Quantec works through information impulses in the awareness field and is described as gentle, contact-free and suitable for people, animals and plants. The practice also lists mitochondrial health guidance. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: TriYoga-Berlin
listings.description: TriYoga-Berlin is a yoga studio run by Claudia Heidmann-Peter, offering flow yoga with breathing work in small groups, workshops, private lessons, yoga for golfers and yoga trips. It also offers bioresonance coaching, which can be booked in Mallorca, Baden-Baden or Berlin, and she will come to the client for yoga or bioresonance. Live online yoga classes are available. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraxis Spandau Ursula Gerhard - Bioresonanz
listings.description: Heilpraxis Spandau Ursula Gerhard works under the Maps category of alternative medicine practitioners and carries Bioresonanz in its name. The practice is rated 4.9 from 14 Google reviews, 13 of them five stars and 1 four stars, and its opening hours are posted. Contact the practice by phone to find out which sessions are offered and how to book a first visit.

listings.name: Medinex Private Gesundheitspraxis Bioresonanz und psychologische Beratung
listings.description: Medinex Private Gesundheitspraxis in Berlin carries Bioresonanz and psychological counselling in its name, and is listed under the Maps category of health consultant. Its opening hours are posted. As there is little further information to go on, call ahead to confirm which sessions are offered, which devices are used and how to book a first appointment.

listings.name: JAD Wellness
listings.description: JAD Wellness is a massage and wellness centre in Bucharest. Its offers include relaxation massage with heated jade rollers and infrared, shiatsu, cervical massage, lymphatic drainage massage and bioresonance scan sessions, and it rents out massage beds. Complementary services include acupressure and emotional freedom techniques. The centre is women-owned, offers family discounts, and has a wheelchair accessible entrance. Rated 4.9 from 230 Google reviews, 218 of them five stars.

listings.name: Aromaterapie & Scanare ZYTO - Aromaterapeut si specialist zyto - Cristina Ciobanu
listings.description: Cristina Ciobanu is an aromatherapist and ZYTO specialist in Bucharest, sector 2, working with essential oils for adults and children. She combines ZYTO scans with aromatherapy to build personal recommendations, and ZYTO reports can also be interpreted online. Her range includes personal development counselling in a five-session format, feng shui, courses, a book and a blog. Rated 5.0 from 54 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Dermavital S.R.L.
listings.description: DermaVital is a German-style bioresonance centre in Bucharest, coordinated in Romania by the Regumed Institute in Munich. It offers bioresonance sessions with a Bicom Optima device and with NLS technology. The centre also offers Hara massage, honey massage, body contouring and laser hair removal, and also sells colloidal mineral products. Hours are posted, appointments are recommended, and cards and contactless payment are accepted. Rated 4.1 from 117 Google reviews, 76 of them five stars and 17 of them one star.

listings.name: CMI Dr. Seremet
listings.description: CMI Dr. Seremet is a physician's individual practice in Bucharest offering consultations and bioresonance sessions. Appointments are required, hours are posted, and cards and contactless payment are accepted. The entrance, seating and restroom are wheelchair accessible. Rated 4.8 from 30 Google reviews, 28 of them five stars.

listings.name: Cabinet Biorezonanta Magnetica Bucuresti Aurel Voica
listings.description: Cabinet Aurel Voica is a Bucharest practice for bioresonance and complementary care. It offers whole-body bioresonance scan sessions, behavioural evaluations and yearly wellness programmes, along with holistic procedures such as hydration and alkalising.
