The practice also keeps a health blog with articles on nutrition, food and natural balance, including a comparison of allopathic and holistic approaches and an overview of how bioresonance is practised in many countries. Card payment is accepted and hours are posted. Rated 4.8 from 21 Google reviews, 20 of them five stars.

listings.name: Aromatic Zen
listings.description: Aromatic Zen is a massage spa in Bucharest that offers aromatherapy massage with doTERRA essential oils, Symphony of the Cell protocols and ZYTO scans. Online scheduling, free parking and a membership option are available, children are welcome, and hours are posted. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Medicina Biorezonanta
listings.description: Medicina Biorezonanta is a cabinet in Bucharest Sector 4, operating since 2007 and led by Dr. Olga Alexandru, a physician with experience in bioresonance and biofeedback. It works with the BioResonance Feedback Technique (BRFT) and sees clients by appointment only. Rated 3.9 from 7 Google reviews, 5 of them five stars and 2 one star. Call ahead to confirm availability.

listings.name: Cabinet Lacrima Naturii
listings.description: Cabinet Lacrima Naturii is a Bucharest practice offering bioresonance scan sessions with a SCIO device, individual consultations, personal recommendations and lifestyle support. It also sells natural products and supplements and offers andullation and a detox spa. Hours are posted, appointments are recommended, and cards and contactless payment are accepted. The entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible. Rated 3.6 from 7 Google reviews: three five-star, two four-star and two one-star.

listings.name: Recovery Team
listings.description: Recovery Team is a Bucharest centre for physical recovery, offering movement sessions, therapeutic massage, electrotherapy, bioelectrostimulation, bioresonance and energy balancing. Light sessions, music sessions and guidance on daily lifestyle habits are also part of the range. Appointments are required, hours are posted, and cards and contactless payment are accepted. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Psiholog Terapeut in Biorezonanta Dorina Baciu
listings.description: Dorina Baciu works in Bucharest as a psychologist and bioresonance consultant, using a SCIO device since 2020. Her range covers psychological counselling, bioresonance sessions, cellular nutrition and spiritual guidance in a single holistic programme, with workshops, a bioresonance course and free online events. She describes the sessions as non-invasive and personalised, with no needles or medication involved. A client review describes a bioresonance session done online from another city. Hours are posted and appointments are recommended. Rated 4.5 from 2 Google reviews.

listings.name: Amalia Mihaela Toader Cabinet Psihologic
listings.description: Amalia Mihaela Toader runs a psychology practice in Bucharest offering individual and couples counselling, coaching and Bach flower sessions. ZYTO scans are also part of the range. Hours are posted and appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review.

listings.name: BIOMEDICAL REMED
listings.description: Biomedical Remed is a Bucharest cabinet for magnetic bioresonance, founded in 2006 by Liuba Radion. She is a specialist in magnetic bioresonance and an international lecturer at a school for magnetic bioresonance specialists, with experience in nutrition and naturopathy. Hours are posted. Call to confirm the device used and how to book.

listings.name: Centrul Holistic EMES Yoga Pilates Masaj Biorezonanta
listings.description: Centrul Holistic EMES is a Bucharest centre combining energy evaluation, emotional balancing and lifestyle support with yoga, pilates and massage. It works with specialists from several fields and takes a mind, body and spirit approach. Its name also refers to bioresonance, so call to confirm whether that is offered. Hours are posted, appointments are recommended, and cards and contactless payment are accepted. Rated 5.0 from 37 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Scanare ZYTO București
listings.description: Scanare ZYTO București is a Bucharest wellness centre whose name points to ZYTO scan sessions. Hours are posted. Rated 4.8 from 9 Google reviews, 8 of them five stars and one three stars. Call to confirm the device used and how to book.

listings.name: Auriculoterapie - Terapii Alternative - Biorezonanta
listings.description: Auriculoterapie - Terapii Alternative - Biorezonanta is a Bucharest practice built around auriculotherapy, a needle-free ear method it describes as quick and non-invasive. Hours are posted, appointments are required, and a consultation can be booked online or by phone. Its name also refers to bioresonance, so call to confirm whether that is offered. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both five stars.

listings.name: Biorezonanta
listings.description: Biorezonanta is a Bucharest practice whose name points to bioresonance and whose category is doctor. It has no posted hours and no further detail on what it offers. Call ahead to confirm the services, the device used and how to book before planning a visit.

listings.name: Cabinet SCIO Biorezonanta
listings.description: Cabinet SCIO Biorezonanta is a Bucharest health centre whose name refers to SCIO bioresonance. It has no posted hours and no further detail on its sessions. Card payment is accepted and appointments are recommended. Call to confirm which device is used and what a session involves.

listings.name: Medicina alternativa prin biorezonanta magnetica
listings.description: Medicina alternativa prin biorezonanta magnetica is a Bucharest practice whose name points to magnetic bioresonance. It has no posted hours and no further detail on what it offers. Appointments are recommended. Call to confirm the services and the device used before planning a visit.

listings.name: Quantum Biofeedback
listings.description: Quantum Biofeedback is a Bucharest practice whose name points to biofeedback sessions. It has no posted hours and no detail on what it offers. The entrance and restroom are wheelchair accessible. Call to confirm the services and the device used before planning a visit.

listings.name: SCIO Biorezonanță București
listings.description: SCIO Biorezonanță București is a Bucharest practice whose name refers to SCIO bioresonance. It has no posted hours and no detail on its sessions. Card payment is accepted and appointments are recommended. Call to confirm which device is used and what a session involves.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Cottbus - Tino Reinwart
listings.description: Tino Reinwart runs a Naturheilpraxis in Cottbus as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) serving Cottbus and Brandenburg. His offers combine traditional Chinese medicine approaches with oxygen and altitude-style interval training, nutrition counselling and a vital field measurement session on the Global system, alongside bioresonance. Hours are posted, and appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 18 Google reviews, all five stars. Parking is free.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Stefan Andreas Beer - Praxis Santulana
listings.description: Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Stefan Andreas Beer runs Praxis Santulana in Werder, offering Ayurvedic massage and bioresonance sessions by phone appointment. Rated 5.0 from 18 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Werder (Havel) lies near Potsdam in Brandenburg.

listings.name: TCM-Babelsberg Praxis für Chinesische Medizin & Funktionelle Medizin - Luisa Jarausch
listings.description: TCM-Babelsberg is a Potsdam practice led by Luisa Jarausch, covering traditional Chinese medicine, functional medicine and naturopathy. Its list includes acupuncture, magnetic field therapy, bioresonance, Tuina and infusion therapy. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 18 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Nina Wieczorek
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Nina is a naturopathic and alternative practice run by Nina Wieczorek, based in Diedersdorf, Vierlinden, near Seelow. It offers bioresonance sessions, acupuncture, homeopathy and massage, and the practice is in Diedersdorf. The practice describes bioresonance as based on the idea that every object gives off natural vibrations. Rated 4.7 from 15 Google reviews, 14 of them five stars and 1 one star.

listings.name: Kinderarztpraxis Valentina Manukow
listings.description: Kinderarztpraxis Valentina Manukow is a paediatric practice in the centre of Potsdam that also lists bioresonance and homeopathy among its offers. Bioresonance is counted among the practice's technical equipment, and the practice asks visitors to register by phone before coming. Rated 3.1 from 63 Google reviews, 30 of them five stars and 26 of them one star. Call ahead to confirm availability and which sessions are offered.

listings.name: Diabetes- und Hausarztzentrum Pritzwalk Dr. med. Sara Flassig
listings.description: Diabetes- und Hausarztzentrum Pritzwalk is the family practice of Dr. med. Sara Flassig, a physician practising general and internal medicine with a diabetes focus. Alongside its regular services it offers bioresonance sessions and acupuncture as complementary options. Appointments can be booked online, and the practice has wheelchair-accessible parking and entrance, a restroom and posted opening hours. Rated 4.3 from 19 Google reviews, 14 of them five stars.

listings.name: Private PHYSIOTHERAPIE und HEILPRAXIS
listings.description: Private Physiotherapie und Heilpraxis in Beeskow combines private physiotherapy with a naturopathy practice run by Caterina Köhn-Lekschas. Physiotherapy covers classic massage, manual therapy and manual lymph drainage, while the naturopathy side includes Dorn spinal therapy, Breuss massage, Reiki and bioresonance. Bioresonance sessions use a Regumed BICOM Optima device with electrodes placed on the body, and a single session usually runs 20 to 45 minutes. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Jaceline Böhm Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Jaceline Böhm runs a practice in Trebbin as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her range includes bioresonance, acupuncture, chiropractic, kinesiology, classic massage, nutrition counselling and general naturopathy. Appointments are recommended, and the practice has a wheelchair accessible parking space and a restroom. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Trebbin lies in the Teltow-Fläming district of Brandenburg, south of Berlin.

listings.name: Alternative Heilpraxis für Mensch und Tier
listings.description: Ulf Henschel runs the Alternative Heilpraxis für Mensch und Tier in Schwielowsee, with bioresonance as its main focus. It offers bioresonance sessions for people and for animals, naturopathic counselling, homeopathy and mycotherapy. There are two parts to the practice, an animal practice for small and large animals and a separate bioresonance practice, and the area served includes Potsdam. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Curatio - Praxis für Osteopathie & Naturheilkunde Physiotherapie & Ergotherapie
listings.description: Curatio in Cottbus brings together osteopathy, naturopathy, physiotherapy, occupational therapy and magnetic stimulation. Ines Hendel (Heilpraktikerin, a state-licensed alternative practitioner) and Andreas Vogt (Heilpraktiker and physiotherapist) lead the practice. Naturopathy includes classical homeopathy, ear acupuncture and bioresonance sessions, including a BICOM BodyCheck with Regumed equipment. Rated 4.7 from 10 Google reviews, 9 of them five stars. Appointments are made by arrangement.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Bioresonanz Blutegeltherapie Hypnose Vitamininfusionen Berlin Potsdam - Naturheilpraxis Potsdam
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Potsdam is run by a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) whose main areas are bioresonance and homeopathy, offered in Potsdam and Berlin. Further offers on the practice's menu include ear acupuncture, complex homeopathy and craniosacral work, plus a small range of health products. The practice is owned by a woman, has wheelchair-accessible seating and welcomes LGBTQ+ visitors. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktiker Martin Wohnlich - Ayurveda & Naturheilpraxis
listings.description: Heilpraktiker Martin Wohnlich (state-licensed alternative practitioner) runs a Naturheilpraxis in Potsdam covering osteopathy, bioresonance, Ayurveda therapy and other natural methods. Appointments are required, so call to confirm how to book and which sessions are offered. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Christiane E. Bergmann, Naturheilpraxis
listings.description: Christiane E. Bergmann runs a Naturheilpraxis in Potsdam built around her own method, abbreviated P.O.R.T.. Her work includes sessions with a Bio Scan and the Metatron HUNTER, radionics for mind and vitality, and cranio osteopathy. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Potsdam
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Potsdam puts Bicom bioresonance (Regumed) at the centre of its practice and invites visitors to get in touch to learn more about the principle behind the method. An appointment is recommended, and bioresonance is the stated focus of the practice. Rated 5.0 from one Google review.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Kirse
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Kirse in Lychen, in the Uckermark, is run by a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who combines systemic osteopathy, kinesiology, energy massage and bioresonance. Bioresonance sessions use the BICOM method. A first conversation comes before the first session; an energetic overview test or a BICOM Body-Check follows, and from it a session plan is drawn up. The practice also names immune system optimisation among its methods. Appointments are required, and wheelchair-accessible parking is available.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis, Yoga - Susann Gordziel & Mirka Hentschel
listings.description: The Naturheilpraxis in Michendorf is run by Susann Gordziel and Mirka Hentschel together with a yoga offer. The range includes acupuncture, bioresonance, breathing therapy, nutrition coaching, foot reflexology massage, hormone yoga, hypnosis, classic massages, meditation, physiotherapy and osteopathy.

listings.name: Praxis für Homöopathie und Bioresonanztherapie - Heilpraktikerin Simone Gericke
listings.description: Simone Gericke runs a practice for homeopathy and bioresonance therapy in Hohen Neuendorf (Bergfelde), working as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner). Her two main areas are process-oriented homeopathy and bioresonance sessions. The bioresonance sessions are carried out with a BICOM device from REGUMED. She looks at the whole person rather than a single complaint, and the practice has a fees page and a route planner for finding it. Wheelchair-accessible restroom on site. The practice has phone and mobile contact numbers and is open to appointment requests by phone. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Praxis für Regulationsmedizin
listings.description: Praxis für Regulationsmedizin in Petershagen-Eggersdorf works with the TimeWaver med system for whole-person sessions and uses natural medicine approaches. Its owner presents it as a practice for regulation medicine, and it is reachable through a contact page. Call to confirm which sessions are available before you plan around it.

listings.name: Kirsten Grenville - Heilpraktiker & Tierheilpraktiker (für Psychotherapie, Bioresonanz & Tierkommunikation)
listings.description: Kirsten Grenville is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and an animal Heilpraktiker in Hamburg, specialising in psychological counselling, bioresonance and animal communication. Her bioresonance work follows the BNR method, which she developed herself. The practice also offers coaching with solution-focused conversation, energetic balance and wingwave sessions, for people and for animals. Appointments are recommended and hours are posted. Rated 5.0 from 71 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: ViewMed Zentrum für umfassende Medizin Fachärztin Arezu Dezfuli
listings.description: ViewMed is a practice centre in Hamburg led by specialist physician Arezu Dezfuli, with internal medicine and naturopathic practice named as its focus. It has been in operation for more than a decade and combines conventional and natural methods in an individual plan for each client. Bioresonance sits alongside a longevity programme, oxygen-based sessions and burnout support. Rated 5.0 from 21 Google reviews, all five stars. Appointments are recommended and the entrance is step-free.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Marion Schlüter - be well Hamburg Naturheilpraxis - Terminpraxis
listings.description: Marion Schlüter is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with an appointment-only naturopathic practice in Hamburg Sülldorf. Her methods include bioresonance, nutrition coaching, micronutrient guidance and ear acupuncture. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 19 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Bioenergetische Praxis Hamburg
listings.description: Bioenergetische Praxis Hamburg is a bioresonance practice that works with modern frequency devices, aiming at energetic balance through empathy and individual support. Distance sessions are offered for clients who cannot attend in person. Appointments are recommended, and the entrance, seating and restroom are wheelchair accessible. Rated 4.8 from 21 Google reviews, 20 of them five stars.

listings.name: Judith Kliewe Naturheilpraxis Heilpraktiker
listings.description: Judith Kliewe is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who has worked independently since 2009 and has run a naturopathic practice in Rahlstedt, Hamburg, since 2011. Bioresonance is the centre of her work, and her motto is wellbeing. The practice is women-owned and welcomes LGBTQ clients. Appointments are required, hours are posted, and free street and lot parking is nearby. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis ZENBIOMED Hamburg - Diplom-Biologe Nils Drenkhahn
listings.description: Nils Drenkhahn runs Naturheilpraxis ZENBIOMED in Hamburg as a full-time Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and Diplom-Biologe, a practice he has kept for almost 30 years. Bioresonance is one of the methods he has continued to practise over that time. Appointments are recommended, and opening hours are posted. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Maren Jans in Hamburg Bergedorf
listings.description: Maren Jans is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) with a naturopathic practice in Hamburg Bergedorf, seeing children and adults. Bioresonance is one of her main focus areas, and each client begins with a detailed first conversation. Appointments are required and hours are posted, with free garage and lot parking on site. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Irina Solowjow
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Irina Solowjow is a naturopathic practice in Hamburg offering bioresonance, homeopathy and massage as its main sessions. Appointments are required and hours are posted. Call to confirm which bioresonance device is used. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: David Höh // Heilpraktiker & Coach
listings.description: David Höh is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) and coach in Hamburg who offers bioresonance sessions and sport and mental coaching. Appointments are required and hours are posted. The entrance is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Dr. med. Ivonne Ziegeler Privatpraxis für Ganzheitliche Medizin
listings.description: Dr. med. Ivonne Ziegeler is a physician running a private practice for holistic medicine in Blankenese, Hamburg. She combines classical homeopathy, naturopathic methods, acupuncture and Traditional Chinese Medicine, hypnosis and bioresonance. Hypnosis, homeopathy and naturopathic consultations are also offered by video. Hours are posted, and the practice has a hearing loop and wheelchair accessible seating and restroom. Rated 5.0 from 8 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Spiekermann
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Spiekermann is a naturopathic practice in Hamburg offering Traditional Chinese Medicine, acupuncture, chiropractic, bioresonance and kinesiology, plus eye acupuncture after Boel and the Liebscher and Bracht approach. Appointments are recommended. Rated 4.5 from 8 Google reviews, 7 of them five stars and one of them one star.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Stephan Weber
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Stephan Weber is a naturopathic practice in Hamburg offering acupuncture, bioresonance and chiropractic as its main sessions. Hours are posted and appointments are recommended. Call to confirm which bioresonance device is used. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraxis für Mensch & Tier
listings.description: Judith Rieker is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) for people and dogs in Hamburg, also certified as an animal Heilpraktiker for horses, dogs and cats. Her focus is bioresonance, and she is a certified device consultant for Rayonex Biomedical bioresonance. Clients can book a video consultation or a bioresonance session, with online advice for both people and dogs. A free first phone call of 15 minutes is available, and she has worked with people and their animals for more than 15 years. Appointments are required and hours are posted. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis im Garten - Heilpraktikerin Victoria Rhensius
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis im Garten is the practice of Victoria Rhensius, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Hamburg, set in a quiet garden. She offers bioresonance, herbal medicine, Traditional Chinese Medicine applications and nutrition counselling. Appointments are required and hours are posted. The practice has a hearing loop, step-free access and on-site parking, and accepts cards and contactless payment. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Praxis für Osteopathie Susanne Feder
listings.description: In Hamburg-Wellingsbüttel, Susanne Feder runs an osteopathy practice for babies, pregnant women, children and adults. An interdisciplinary team in the same building, working alongside a midwife practice, adds physiotherapy, sports therapy, bioresonance and nutrition counselling. Clients come from Wellingsbüttel, Sasel, Poppenbüttel and nearby districts. The practice has step-free seating and free street parking. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Herr Manfred Richelmann
listings.description: Manfred Richelmann runs a naturopathic practice in Hamburg offering ear acupuncture, homeopathy, herbal medicine, bioresonance, structural osteopathy, gentle chiropractic, laser and frequency methods, and diet counselling. Hours are posted. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review.

listings.name: Katja Werner Heilpraktikerin
listings.description: Katja Werner is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Hamburg offering bioresonance sessions after Paul Schmidt (Rayonex), osteopathy and craniosacral work. Her range also includes fascia work after Typaldos, Dorn spinal work, Breuss massage, low-level laser sessions, coaching, and family and systemic constellations. Hours are posted and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Petra Unbehaun
listings.description: Petra Unbehaun works as an alternative medicine practitioner in Hamburg and lists bioresonance sessions among her services. Her range also includes nutrition coaching, stress support and better-aging programmes. Appointments are recommended. Call ahead to confirm what a first visit involves.

listings.name: Ease and Balance Acupuncture
listings.description: Dr Amy Gordon, a licensed acupuncturist, runs Ease and Balance Acupuncture on 57th Street in the Park Towers South building in Manhattan. Acupuncture sits alongside Neuro Emotional Technique, Quantum Neurology, gua sha, cupping, moxibustion and biofeedback. Biofeedback is offered as nervous system training, in person and virtually. Manhattan office hours are on Wednesday and Sunday, and virtual appointments run on Tuesday and Wednesday. A community acupuncture option and a services and fees page are posted. Rated 5.0 from 81 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Quantum Healing & Wellness
listings.description: Quantum Healing & Wellness in Bedford Hills, New York, is a women owned wellness center with services that include the AO Scan, the EESystem, a salt room, infrared sauna with red light, BEMER, AVACEN, PEMF, BrainTap, Reiki, Access Bars, the Emotion Code, an energetic facelift and nutritional counseling, plus massage and memberships. AO Scan sessions can be done in person or over the phone, and pets can be scanned too. A 15 minute free consultation with Dr. Adams is offered, and the center welcomes families and children. Memberships and a Frequency Fair are part of the offer, and the EESystem is a 24-unit energy enhancement system. Call 914-218-3428. Rated 5.0 from 48 Google reviews, 47 of them five stars.

listings.name: Tree of Life Acupuncture Union Square, NYC Bioresonance, Frequency, PEMF, Ozone therapy Lyme Disease & Cancer Care
listings.description: Since 1993 Tree of Life Acupuncture has served Union Square in New York, where Mark Moshchinsky, L.Ac. blends Master Tung acupuncture with Chinese herbs, ozone, PEMF and microcurrent. An individual evaluation comes first. Bioresonance has its own section, with pages on Oberon NLS, Rayonex, quantum biofeedback and a TimeWaver quantum bioresonance machine. Further options include detox support, hyperthermia and an ozone sauna, and a distance session option is listed. The practice cites 33 years of experience and offers acupuncture for facial beauty as well. Policies cover privacy and appointment cancellation, a reviews page is posted, and professional grade vitamins and supplements can be ordered. Rated 4.9 from 52 Google reviews, 50 of them five stars. A blog covers acupuncture topics.

listings.name: IVdrips&more
listings.description: IVdrips&more in Newburgh is a women-owned practice led by a nurse practitioner, offering IV and IM nutrition, CBD IV infusions, regenerative sessions and Qest4 bioenergetic scans. Memberships, packages, gift certificates and daily deals are available, and all visits are by appointment only, booked online through Vagaro. A team page introduces the people behind the practice and a policies page sets out the booking terms. Rated 5.0 from 45 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: The Khader Center - Dina Khader MS, RD, CDN
listings.description: The Khader Center in Mount Kisco is the practice of Dina Khader (MS, RD, CDN), a nutritionist with more than 35 years of practice. Her work combines personalized nutrition tailored to each client's DNA, ZYTO bioenergetic scans, Quantum Reflex Analysis, supplement evaluation and therapeutic clay packing. The center also shares recipes, videos and a blog. It has a wheelchair accessible entrance, parking and restroom, and it welcomes LGBTQ clients. Appointments are required. Rated 4.8 from 44 Google reviews, 39 of them five stars.

listings.name: Vitalgate Health UES
listings.description: Vitalgate Health serves the Upper East Side of New York and Naples in Florida with acupuncture, Japanese acupuncture, bioresonance, ozone and peptide options. Its bioresonance work draws on a Qest4 bioenergetic assessment, the NES Health system, TimeWaver and Imedis systems, and bioresonance in the tradition of Paul Schmidt. Office appointments are available in both cities, remote sessions can be requested, and a free 10 minute phone consultation is offered. Pulsed PEMF therapy is also listed. Pages describe the client process, the services and testimonials, and a team page introduces the practitioners. Rated 5.0 from 30 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Booking links are available for each city, and the practice describes a step by step process from first contact to follow-up.

listings.name: Gala Glow Aesthetic Studio
listings.description: Gala Glow Aesthetic Studio in Mayfield is an aesthetic studio whose menu includes facials, HydraFacial, body scrubs, waxing, sugaring, laser hair reduction, brow styling, spray tans, a scalp spa and a wellness relaxing chamber with red light and magnesium spray. Alongside the beauty services it offers a 30-minute ZYTO Body Biofeedback Scan. Appointments are recommended and a price list is published. Rated 5.0 from 28 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Gala Glow is a facial spa by category.

listings.name: Holistic Health Solutions of Long Island
listings.description: Holistic Health Solutions of Long Island is a women-owned practice in Huntington, New York, offering quantum biofeedback sessions for stress balancing. The same practice runs a colon hydrotherapy service, acupuncture with a computerized digital meridian imaging system, massage therapy, an infrared sauna and nutrition counseling. Holistic counseling is part of the mix. Rated 4.8 from 30 Google reviews, 28 of them five stars. Call (631) 923-2610 for details.

listings.name: Northeast Spine & Wellness
listings.description: Northeast Spine & Wellness in Clifton Park is a full-service wellness facility led by Dr. Joseph Gulyas, a chiropractor with over 35 years in chiropractic and functional medicine. Visits combine one-on-one time with the doctor and technology such as a Heart Sound Recorder, ZYTO scan technology and computerized analysis. Nutritional support includes personalized nutrition plans and supplements, and massage, sports massage and weight loss services are available. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 18 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Yurkovsky Savely MD
listings.description: Yurkovsky Savely MD in Mount Kisco is an integrative practice that specializes in Field Control Therapy (FCT), bioresonance and homeopathy, and it also supplies bioresonance kits. The practice presents itself as integrative and energy medicine. Dr. Yurkovsky has developed FCT as a bio-energetic approach and shares it through articles, case discussions and video programs on DVD and USB. Appointments are recommended. The office has a wheelchair accessible entrance, parking and restroom. Rated 4.6 from 18 Google reviews, 16 of them five stars.

listings.name: Bio Resonance Diagnostics New York
listings.description: Bio Resonance Diagnostics New York is a nutrition practice in Brooklyn that offers short bioresonance sessions of about 10 minutes. After a session, clients receive an individual nutrition program, and a sample report can be viewed before booking. A frequently asked questions section explains how sessions work, and client feedback is published. Individual nutrition guidance follows each session, and a sample report shows what clients receive. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Natural Alternatives US Inc.
listings.description: Natural Alternatives US is the practice of Doreen Bell, ND (Doctor of Naturopathy) and CFMP (Certified Functional Medicine Practitioner), serving Rochester and the Pittsford area. Sessions use Asyra EAV and meridian stress assessment testing alongside lifestyle guidance and supplements. Homeopathic products and nutritional supplement lines are available, and telehealth consultations reach clients across the United States. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review. The business is women-owned and appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Straile Chiropractic
listings.description: Straile Chiropractic in Camillus describes a holistic and integrative wellness practice. Its services include chiropractic, nutrition and supplements, massage, quantum biofeedback, detox therapies, a foot bath and a UV sauna. Call to ask which biofeedback system is used and how sessions are booked. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review, at five stars.

listings.name: Mind Matters Regional Neurofeedback Centers
listings.description: Mind Matters Regional Neurofeedback Centers in Latham is a women-owned practice built around neurofeedback and biofeedback. Its QEEG brain mapping uses real-time displays of brain activity for neurofeedback training, and photobiomodulation, home training and biometric sessions are available too. A supplement store, provider referrals and several clinic locations round out the offer. Appointments are recommended. Rated 4.0 from 1 Google review. Phone (607) 437-3305 to ask which sessions suit you and which location to visit.

listings.name: Biofeedback Long Island
listings.description: Biofeedback Long Island, a homeopath practice based in Long Beach, offers bioenergetic screenings and Advanced Bioresonance Health Screening sessions. Appointments can be booked at one of two locations in Nassau County, or a session can be arranged at the client's home. Call to ask which device is used, what a first session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Life-haus Therapeutic Solutions
listings.description: Life-haus Therapeutic Solutions in New York combines psychotherapy with advanced bioresonance biofeedback, mixing mind, body and spirit approaches with quantum energetic work. Naturopathic practitioner and biofeedback therapist are among its listed categories. Call to ask what a first bioresonance session involves and how to book. It is a local option for anyone in the city curious about a session.

listings.name: RESONANT FREQUENCY / RF LAB by OHM Center
listings.description: A partnership between Resonant Frequency Magazine and OHM Center, RF LAB in New York gives the public access to energy instruments the magazine writes about. Acupuncturists work with electricity, magnets, structured water, Rife, PEMF, Scenar, bioresonance, infrared and millimeter waves. Call to ask which instruments are in use and how to book.

listings.name: STUDIO at Mind Body Soul Health & Fitness
listings.description: STUDIO at Mind Body Soul Health & Fitness in Albany is a Black owned and women owned wellness space led by certified wellness coaches. They give plant-based guidance for health and wellness using bioresonance technology, and movement classes are held daily at The STUDIO. The team welcomes LGBTQ clients. Call to ask about hours and how to book.

listings.name: Dipl.-Med. Karina Raabgrund
listings.description: The therapy centre of Dipl.-Med. Karina Raabgrund in Erfurt is led by a physician specialising in paediatrics and presents a whole-person approach for children and adults. Alongside conventional check-ups, the complementary range includes acupuncture, bioresonance, osteopathy, homeopathy and BEMER sessions. Rated 4.2 from 57 Google reviews, 43 of them five stars and 11 one star. Opening hours are posted, and parking, entrance and restroom are step-free.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerpraxis Sandy Immer
listings.description: Heilpraktikerpraxis Sandy Immer in Krölpa, Thüringen, is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) practice called an institute for holistic health. Sandy Immer lists acupuncture, acupuncture massage (APM) and bioresonance therapy, and uses a form of frequency medicine and bioresonance to bring a person's energetic field back into balance. Appointments can be booked online, and online sessions are available from home. She also visits animals on site or at the stable. A relaxation stay in the Thüringen countryside is offered as well. Rated 5.0 from 28 Google reviews, 27 of them five stars.

listings.name: Dr.med. Carmen Stuckart
listings.description: Dr. med. Carmen Stuckart leads a physician practice in Erfurt with locations at Löberwallgraben and Am Angerbrunnen. It is a general practice that is known for travel medicine, and it adds acupuncture and bioresonance to its range. Home visits and weekday evening hours for working people are listed. Rated 3.8 from 74 Google reviews, 44 of them five stars and 15 one star. The entrance is step-free.

listings.name: Orthopädische Privatpraxis Dr.Ulf Langguth
listings.description: Dr. med. Ulf Langguth, a physician specialising in orthopaedics, runs a private practice in Erfurt that combines conventional and natural methods. The complementary range includes bioresonance, osteopathy, acupuncture, aromatherapy, high-altitude training sessions and nutrition counselling. Annette Kolbe, bioresonance practitioner and aroma expert, is part of the team. Appointments are made by phone. Rated 5.0 from 25 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Raum für Resonanz
listings.description: Raum für Resonanz in Gera is the practice of Anke Petzold, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) for psychotherapy. Sessions focus on bioresonance and conversation, with Reiki for deep relaxation also on offer. The practice is based at In der Laune 19 and sets time aside for physical and emotional wellbeing. A free get-to-know meeting is available before booking. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all five stars. Opening hours are posted.

listings.name: TIERreich - Physiotherapie, Osteopathie & Alternativmedizin
listings.description: TIERreich in Erfurt is run by Claudia Abicht and works with animals only: acupuncture, physiotherapy and bioresonance for horses, dogs and cats. She visits horses at their stable, while dogs and cats are seen in her practice on Rembrandtstraße. The area covered is greater Erfurt and its surroundings. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all five stars. The entrance is step-free.

listings.name: Naturheilpraxis Jana Plewka
listings.description: Jana Plewka is a Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Erfurt who took her exam at the Erfurt health office and trained as a bioresonance therapist. Her practice offers bioresonance sessions, ear acupuncture, micro-immunotherapy, vital-nutrient sessions, gut programmes and Schüßler biochemistry. A free first conversation by phone is available. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all five stars. Parking is free and appointments are required.

listings.name: Praxis für Naturheilkunde Susanne Henkel
listings.description: Susanne Henkel practises as a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Bad Blankenburg, with services that include bioresonance sessions, homeopathy, foot reflexology and Dorn-Breuss manual therapy. Opening hours are posted, appointments are recommended, and parking is wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from nine Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Heilpraktikerin Nicole Lehmann-Schuchert
listings.description: Nicole Lehmann-Schuchert is a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) in Dermbach, also trained as a rescue paramedic and healthcare assistant, with 16 years in the health sector. She offers bioresonance sessions at the practice for adults and children and has a section on child wellbeing. Intake conversations and advice appointments can also be held online by Zoom, and online booking is available. She adds online offers, a podcast and a chakra meditation download. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all five stars.

listings.name: Ergo & Handtherapie Sandra Schlag
listings.description: Ergo & Handtherapie in Gera is an occupational and hand therapy practice with more than 15 years of experience. Alongside therapy for children and adults, it offers brain performance training, relaxation sessions and bioresonance as a self-pay service. The premises include a sensory room and a relaxation room. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all five stars. The team works from a reception area, a sports room, a hand therapy room and a workshop. Appointments are required.

listings.name: Institut für Naturheilkunde
listings.description: The Institut für Naturheilkunde is a third-generation naturopathic practice in the centre of Erfurt, in operation for about 30 years. Three practitioners work together, including Heilpraktikerin (state-licensed alternative practitioner) Maren Schmidt. Bioresonance is offered after Paul Schmidt using Rayonex equipment, with a personal plan agreed for each client. The range also includes acupuncture methods such as Korean hand and ear acupuncture, Ayurveda, an infrared cabin, nutrition counselling and conversation sessions. The institute also offers training courses and wellness programmes. Rated 4.0 from 4 Google reviews, 3 of them five stars. Opening hours are posted.

listings.name: Heilzentrum Lichtblick
listings.description: Heilzentrum Lichtblick in Zella-Mehlis offers sessions with TimeWaver systems (Med, Pro and Frequency) alongside energetic spine alignment, frequency and micro-current applications and work in the information field. Hypnosis and inner journeys round out the sessions, and personality and business coaching are available for private and professional development. Appointments are by arrangement.

listings.name: Herr Kay Erhard
listings.description: Kay Erhard runs a practice in Erfurt for osteopathy, bioresonance and natural health methods. It works by appointment and has step-free seating and restroom. Call ahead to ask what a bioresonance session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Körperwerk360 Physiotherapie & Health Coaching
listings.description: Körperwerk360 in Gera is a physiotherapy and health coaching practice offering nutrition counselling, sports therapy, workplace health management and bioresonance. Opening hours are posted, appointments are required and paid parking is nearby. The entrance is wheelchair accessible. Call ahead to confirm which sessions suit you.

listings.name: Naturheilkunde Isabelle Grüner
listings.description: Naturheilkunde Grüner in Bad Lobenstein is the practice of Isabelle Grüner, a Heilpraktiker (state-licensed alternative practitioner) who works with bioresonance, homeopathy, plant-based naturopathy, kinesiology, nutrition advice, fascia work, sports osteopathy and kinesiology taping, together with Christian Grüner. Appointments are recommended, opening hours are posted, and there is free parking on site. Contact is through the practice pages.

listings.name: NATURHEILPRAXIS Bernhard Weber
listings.description: Naturheilpraxis Bernhard Weber in Erfurt lists biofield test sessions, electroacupuncture and bioresonance methods, along with magnetic field and ultrasound. A first conversation of 15 minutes is free. Home visits are offered, including work on the living and sleeping space. Opening hours are posted.

listings.name: TimeWaver-Coaching
listings.description: TimeWaver-Coaching and SHT® are offered by Kitty Fee Liebig in Rothenstein, who works with the TimeWaver system to connect clients with their information field. Interested clients get in touch by phone, email or contact form, and everything else is discussed in a personal conversation. SHT® sessions are offered alongside the TimeWaver coaching, and current offers are listed on the practice's pages.

listings.name: Gesundheit durch Bioresonanz
listings.description: Gesundheit durch Bioresonanz is a health counselling practice in Blankenhain that describes its focus as holistic wellbeing for people and animals. Opening hours are posted and the service area covers 17 named towns and villages around Borken. Call ahead to ask which sessions are offered and how they are arranged.

listings.name: Recovery Studio Spa
listings.description: Recovery Studio Spa in Fort Collins pairs bioresonance frequency sessions with infrared sauna sessions, mechanical lymphatic therapy and massage in a spa setting. Appointments are required. The spa is owned by veterans and women, and it is rated 5.0 from 56 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Soulshines Yoga Studio & Healing Arts
listings.description: Soulshines Yoga Studio & Healing Arts sits in Cascade, Colorado, at the base of Pikes Peak, ten minutes from Manitou Springs and Woodland Park. Classes and sessions include yoga, Pilates, meditation, Thai massage, Reiki, sound workshops, women's circles and nutritional consultations with ZYTO scans, in groups or privately. Visitors can ask for a custom group experience. Rated 5.0 from 47 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Acacia Whole Health
listings.description: Acacia Whole Health in Parker is a naturopathic clinic offering frequency therapy, Rife sessions, ZYTO biocommunication and nutritional consulting. Consultations are now provided remotely through ZYTO hand cradles, and clients can ask the office about buying a cradle of their own. Rennetta Nikolic, TNP, DN, has worked with animals since 1996, and an animal health page covers pet sessions. A new clients page, a blog and reviews are published. Hours are Tuesday and Thursday during the day. Phone 303-504-0772. Rated 5.0 from 24 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. The practice describes the work as biocommunication, an approach to gathering information through the ZYTO hand cradle. Ask the office for details about hand cradle purchase and referral. Call the office on the number above with any question.

listings.name: Onyx Healing Collective
listings.description: Onyx Healing Collective is a wellness center in Boulder built around light and sound. Its 24-unit EESystem room anchors the offering, with Bio-Well energy scans and AO Scan sessions, including the Inner Voice scan, as additional services. A vibration plate is available as well. The Inner Voice scan looks at emotional patterns, and virtual assessments are available from home. Other sessions include Raindrop therapy, Bach flower assessments, ion foot baths, ear candling, sound therapy, foot zone therapy and emotional release sessions. A complimentary consultation call and a discovery call can be scheduled, and foot zone therapy, a shop and the Empowered Health Series are available, and her stated goal is to teach clients how to discover what their body needs. Scheduling options are listed online.

listings.name: Debbi's Herb Shop
listings.description: Debbi's Herb Shop in Webb City is a small business established in 2012 and run by a certified natural health professional. It sells CBD oils, vitamins and minerals, with health consultations and quantum biofeedback on offer. A spa room adds therapeutic massage, an infrared sauna, foot sessions and a whole-body vibration studio. Rated 5.0 from 23 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Delivery is available, there is a free parking lot, and the shop is LGBTQ welcoming.

listings.name: Natural Health Hub LLC
listings.description: Natural Health Hub LLC in Kansas City is a women-owned practice led by Crystal Parsons, formerly Crystal Dominguez. Services include BioResonance and IMF frequency sessions, breathwork with meditation, Reiki, yoga and stretching, herbal supplements and vitamins, and holistic wellness and gut health coaching. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 21 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Ozark Mountain Natural Health, LLC
listings.description: Ozark Mountain Natural Health, LLC in Springfield focuses on traditional naturopathic work with an emphasis on emotional and energetic wellness. Services include naturopathic consultations, comprehensive iridology assessments, emotional release sessions and NES bioenergetix scanning with consultations. Appointments can be scheduled online. Rated 4.8 from 17 Google reviews, 16 of them five stars.

listings.name: AURA
listings.description: AURA is a women-owned wellness studio in Jefferson City, founded by a Certified Reflexologist and Reiki Master. Sessions include bioresonance scanning, Reiki, reflexology, sound relaxation, restorative yoga, vibroacoustic sessions, chakra alignment, binaural beats, BrainTap and BioMat. It also runs workshops. Appointments are recommended. Rated 4.7 from 15 Google reviews, 14 of them five stars.

listings.name: Flex Health with Maura
listings.description: Flex Health with Maura in Clayton is a private service led by Maura Eliza, a traditional naturopath. Members can book bio-resonance feedback sessions, which can also be done remotely, assisted lymphatic therapy sessions, which are not a lymphatic massage, and essential oil education on using oils safely at home. A health class is coming soon. Maura also shares free guides and a blog, including guides on moving on from a relationship and on dating. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Ebb & Flow Holistic Health
listings.description: Ebb & Flow Holistic Health offers Solex AO Scan sessions in person and online. The Solex system draws on a database of over 120,000 Blueprint Frequencies, with information collected through a transducer headset positioned in front of each ear, among other methods. The scan menu includes the Inner-Voice, Body System, Vitals and Comprehensive scans as well as SEFI, and a pet scan is available for horses, dogs and cats. Other services include iTeraCare, sunlight and sauna sessions, intuitive energy work, Terahertz sessions, infrared, red light, PEMF and microvibration, and foot sessions. Supplements are sold in person and through an online dispensary that delivers. Classes are offered on the schedule, so reach out to book. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both at five stars.

listings.name: Zen Life Solutions, LLC
listings.description: Zen Life Solutions in Springfield, led by Gary with Shaye Stahler, offers comprehensive bioenergetic scans on the Qest4 quantum bioenergetic scanner. Shaye serves as office manager and Qest4 scan technician. The scan can be done remotely or in person, and clients receive an emailed copy of the scan report and recommendations. The center also offers Platinum LED BioMax red light therapy, quantum scalar wave lasers, Rife and scalar technologies, foot baths, supplements and dietary recommendations. Programs are customized to each person's goals, and a 30 minute discussion by Zoom or phone is available for new clients. The entrance, parking, restroom and seating are wheelchair accessible, cards and mobile payments are accepted, and a shop and online scheduling are available. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both at five stars.

listings.name: Gather & Grow
listings.description: Gather & Grow Wellness is a community space in Eldon, Missouri, owned by women and welcoming LGBTQ clients. It offers yoga classes, meditation, energy work, AO Scan services, sound sessions, workshops and events. A shop sells crystals, essential oils, incense and gifts. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review, at five stars.

listings.name: Grounded For Life
listings.description: Downtown Chillicothe is home to Grounded For Life, a natural health store focused on mind, body and spirit. It sells herbs, supplements, essential oils, natural personal care products and gifts, and it is a global brand partner with Lifewave Technologies. Services include ionic footbaths and ZYTO scans.

listings.name: Yoga For You Warrenton
listings.description: Yoga For You Warrenton is a community studio on East Main Street, next to Main Street Computers, with chair yoga and gentle floor yoga for all levels plus private sessions. Beyond classes it offers AO Scan sessions, which use bio-resonance technology, together with red light, breathwork, Emotional Freedom Technique tapping and LifePro vibration plate sessions. Class passes and workshops are listed, and a blog covers the services. Call (323) 708-4120.

listings.name: Holistic Doctor
listings.description: Dr Modestas Jarutis leads Holistic Doctor in Belfast, combining fasting, traditional approaches and modern technology. Bioresonance is done as a full or partial body scan with sensors in modified headphones while sitting at a computer, and the practice uses a Metatron Hunter 4027 non-linear system. Dietary advice and personalised plans are available, and the practice shares reviews, articles, videos, podcasts and events, with a shop and an FAQ page. Rated 5.0 from 79 Google reviews, 78 of them five stars.

listings.name: Health Direct NI
listings.description: Suzanne Chakley leads Health Direct NI, a holistic health practice in Markethill, Armagh, with many years of experience in bioresonance. Bioresonance body scans sit at the top of the service list, and distance scanning using DNA samples is available for clients who cannot attend in person. Alongside the scans she offers energy therapy sessions, health coaching and counselling, and weight management programmes. The practice also runs a shop selling wellness products and Kangen water ionising systems. Appointments are required and there is on-site parking. Rated 5.0 from 26 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Food Intolerance Testing NI - Helen McGinn
listings.description: Helen McGinn has practised since 2003 and sees clients one to one at four locations in Northern Ireland: Belfast, Newry, Newcastle and Lurgan. Bioresonance appointments use skin contact points, with no needles involved, and in-person appointments are required. YorkTest home kits are also available through the practice, with an online consultation to follow. New clients can compare options on the booking page, and each visit includes a conversation about next steps. Rated 5.0 from 20 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Naturobalance
listings.description: Naturobalance in Craigavon is a woman-owned practice led by Melissa Johnson, with over 27 years of experience. It offers therapeutic and maternity massage, general and pregnancy reflexology, Myokinesthetic therapy, body sugaring for hair removal and bioresonance scanning. Rated 5.0 from 20 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call 07598 681844 to book.

listings.name: Deep Connections
listings.description: Aoibhinn Murray runs Deep Connections in Belfast, mixing massage, energy work and bioresonance scanning under one roof. Havening and energy psychology sessions sit beside professional massage, workplace massage for companies, and Reiki, Vortex work and shamanic practices. Clients can read reviews, check the price list and cancellation policy, and book online, by email at aoibhinn@deep-connections.co.uk or by phone on +447591541862. Privacy, cookie and accessibility statements are published. Rated 5.0 from 19 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Solora Holistic Medicine
listings.description: Naturopathic nutritional therapists at Solora Holistic Medicine in Belfast work with clients on nutrition and lifestyle, taking a functional approach and getting to know each person's history. Bioresonance technology is also offered. Rated 5.0 from 16 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Call to ask how a first appointment works.

listings.name: Your Health Now by Gillian Orr... incorporating Kinesiology & Bio Resonance Body Scanning and much more
listings.description: Your Health Now by Gillian Orr works from Comber near Newtownards and online, and blends Oberon bioresonance with kinesiology, NLP coaching for wellness, EFT tapping and Bach flower essences. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Testimonials, FAQs and a blog are published, and visitors can ask a question before booking. Choose the first session or a remote session at booking. A blog and a contact form are available for questions.

listings.name: KINESIOLOGY NI
listings.description: Caoibhe Bailie runs Kinesiology NI from East Belfast, welcoming clients from across Northern Ireland. Many people visit for support with energy levels, stress and digestion. Other services include personalised nutritional guidance, nutrigenomics, emotional wellbeing support and NADA ear acupuncture, with a price list and testimonials for new clients to read. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: The Natural Health Clinic NI
listings.description: The Natural Health Clinic NI is owned by Jacqui O'Kane and sits a few miles outside Broughshane village, near Ballymena. Call to confirm hours and how to book.

listings.name: Tranquil Health
listings.description: Naturopathic nutrition, Reiki and bioresonance therapy come together at Tranquil Health in Belfast. A team of certified practitioners tailors sessions to each person's goals, covering the physical, emotional and energetic sides of wellbeing. Women's health and nutrition are among its listed specialities. Call to ask which practitioner offers bioresonance, what a first session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Gemeinschaftspraxis Morozova Morozov

Call to ask what a first session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Bioresonance Adelaide

listings.name: Ray Chiropractic Center, PLLC

Rated 4.6 from 14 Google reviews, 12 of them five stars.

listings.name: Blessed Balance and Love

listings.name: Mountain Air Chiropractic

Call to ask which sessions are currently offered.

listings.name: Healing Moon

The business is owned by women. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Modern Wellness
listings.description: Modern Wellness is a holistic practice in Fountain Hills offering biofeedback sessions, bioenergetic sessions and bioresonance sessions as custom wellness screenings. listings.name: Angel of Hearts Wellness
listings.description: Angel of Hearts Wellness in Scottsdale offers ZYTO Evox biofeedback sessions, which focus on the mind-body connection, perception reframing and balance. It is a local option for anyone curious about ZYTO Evox biofeedback. The entrance, parking and restroom are wheelchair accessible. Call to confirm hours and how to book.

listings.name: The Wellness Initiative
listings.description: The Wellness Initiative in Flagstaff is a woman-owned practice led by a Doctor of Natural Medicine and holistic strategist who combines mind-body therapies, bioenergetics and movement. listings.name: BioEnergetix - Chantelle French

listings.name: SoulfulSync - Holistic Studio

The studio also runs a podcast and a blog. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. A longer Deep Reset suits those who want more time, and every session ends with a reset stage. Meet Eva on the About page. A podcast and blog add background for first-time visitors.

listings.name: Inbalance Naturopathy & Body Therapy
listings.description: Grey Lynn in Auckland is home to Inbalance Naturopathy, where naturopathic consultation sits alongside bioresonance, Alpha-Stim, iridology and Reiki. AO Scan technology brings an Inner Voice scan that creates personalised harmonic audio files, and remote bioresonance scans are offered for clients elsewhere. Pets are welcome too, with remote sessions for dogs, cats and horses arranged from basic information about the animal. Alpha-Stim microcurrent and cranial electrotherapy is explained on its own page, as are iridology and Reiki energy sessions. In-clinic and online consultations are both available, and clients can view availability online before booking. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars. An approach page explains how tools are chosen and combined for each client.

listings.name: Native Herbs LTD
listings.description: Herbal and homeopathic products made in New Zealand are the base of Native Herbs, an Auckland homeopath practice with a shop and a services menu. Bio-resonance analysis and therapy sits alongside a comprehensive check-up and homeopathic consultations, and detox sessions are offered too. Herbal liquids, lotions, homeopathy tablets and herbal supplements are stocked in the shop, and testimonials are shared. Visitors can order products online or book an appointment. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Kat's Natural Solutions
listings.description: Kat's Natural Solutions is a naturopathy practice based in Pukekohe and Bombay, with support offered online as well. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both of them five stars.
