listings.name: Integr8 Health Clinic
listings.description: Integr8 Health Clinic is a pharmacist-led private health and wellness clinic in Walsall, West Midlands, that includes bioresonance therapy among its services. It also offers ear wax removal, IV nutrition and vitamin injections, joint care, microneedling, skin boosters and other aesthetic services, and its team combines conventional healthcare with selected complementary therapies. Appointments can be booked online or by phone on 01922 219011, and a FAQ answers common questions. Rated 5.0 from 17 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Peter's Health Products
listings.description: Peter's Health Products in Solihull is a health food store with a nutritional therapy clinic and bioresonance therapy on the service list. Peter spent much of his time in Germany and was struck by the work of German naturopaths with bioresonance, which led him to buy a machine of his own. Home delivery and in-store shopping are both available. Rated 5.0 from 12 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call to ask how a bioresonance session works and how to book.

listings.name: Unique Therapies Ltd
listings.description: Unique Therapies is a women-owned bioresonance practice based in Warwick, UK, serving clients worldwide through remote sessions as well as in person. Working with a three-step process, it starts with a free 30-minute call, moves to an initial bioresonance session in person or remotely with results discussed a day or two later, and then offers a choice of program. Client experiences, a story page and a bioresonance blog are published, and booking runs through an online call scheduler. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The parking is wheelchair accessible. The practice describes its programs as combining bioresonance technology with traditional therapeutic techniques when required, and a client login area is available.

listings.name: Cannock Clinical Acupuncture & Bio Resonance
listings.description: Cannock Clinical Acupuncture & Bio Resonance combines acupuncture, massage, nutrition counselling and bio-resonance in one clinic, with practitioner Josè. The bio-resonance body scan comes in three versions, and its scanner scans the entire body in a non-intrusive way; the clinic describes it as one of only a handful in the UK. The clinic also works with a Quantum Meta Black Box, a radionics device suited to both people and animals. Remote sessions run by Zoom, Skype, phone or webcam and last 30 to 60 minutes. A free consultation can be booked, and appointments are required. The clinic trades as Integrative Medicine & Cannock Acupuncture, welcomes LGBTQ clients and posts its opening hours. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Healthy Approach Nutritional Therapy
listings.description: Healthy Approach Nutritional Therapy in Leamington Spa is the practice of Vicki Gotham, a nutritional therapist, kinesiology practitioner and weight management coach. She is a certified bioresonance practitioner qualified in bioresonance after Paul Schmidt, and she combines it with nutritional therapy and kinesiology. Metabolic Balance weight management, Reiki with far infrared and the Low Tox Living UK online course are also offered. The practice is women-owned, and appointments are required. Phone 01926 885263. Rated 5.0 from 7 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: UpperStorey
listings.description: UpperStorey in Worcester offers hypnotherapy, EFT and bioresonance. Call to ask which device is used for bioresonance and how a first session works. Hypnotherapy is the practice's main category. Anyone in the Worcester area can contact it directly to ask about availability, session length and booking.

listings.name: Cannock Clinical Acupuncture & Bio Resonance
listings.description: Cannock Clinical Acupuncture & Bio Resonance is a Walsall practice whose name points to acupuncture and bio resonance sessions. It is a local option for anyone interested in either approach. Call to ask which services are offered, which device is used, what a first appointment involves, where it takes place and how to book.

listings.name: Clear Pathways to Natural Health
listings.description: Clear Pathways to Natural Health in Martinsville is led by Dr. Malisha Craney, N.D., a naturopathic practitioner who blends botanical medicine, nutritional counseling and lifestyle advice with auriculotherapy and quantum bioresonance sessions. Infrared light therapy is offered too. New clients can start with a complimentary 15-minute consultation to talk through goals before booking anything further. The practice introduces its staff, explains integrative health and invites clients to share Google reviews. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. A Google review link lets clients leave feedback, and the Squarespace site carries client testimonials from named clients. Staff profiles describe Dr. Craney's work and her interests outside the clinic, including gardening and time with her grandchildren.

listings.name: Soar Boutique - Natural Wellness Center & Detox Spa
listings.description: Soar Boutique is a wellness spa in Crown Point, in Northwest Indiana, working in biofeedback and weight management. Sessions include bioresonance full-body energy scans and cell frequency work, alongside homeopathic pellets, an infrared and red light therapy bed and a hyperthermia wellness pod. Rated 5.0 from 13 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Life's Little Treasures
listings.description: Life's Little Treasures in Auburn is a women owned wellness practice offering bio-resonance scanning and Mora sessions, with Spectronosodes, BRT and Green Angel EMF protection devices among its tools. It also provides nutritional education and guidance, practitioner grade supplements, herbs, botanicals, essential oils and simple lifestyle habits such as oil pulling and earthing, plus recipes and articles. The restroom, parking and seating are wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: 12-Unit EESystem Lapel, IN
listings.description: 12-Unit EESystem Lapel, IN is a naturopathic practice in Lapel, Indiana, built around sessions in the 12-Unit Energy Enhancement System, a room set up with scalar wave fields. Doctor of Naturopathy consultations, Emotion Code and Body Code sessions and AO Scan analysis with balancing harmonics are also offered. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both at five stars.

listings.name: Healthy Frequencies - Bioresonance Scanning
listings.description: Healthy Frequencies - Bioresonance Scanning in Frankfort works with a bio-resonance system and equipment that magnifies natural frequencies. Scan results are read alongside a client's habits and routines to find ways to make healthier choices, in a holistic approach built on taking initiative for your own wellbeing. Clients are encouraged to educate themselves and use every opportunity to pursue wellness. Appointments are made by call or text, and appointment hours are given for booking. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review, at five stars.

listings.name: Mom Era Care
listings.description: Mom Era Care in Jeffersonville is a women-owned coaching practice for women preparing for pregnancy and for new mothers. Coaching focuses on diet, exercise habits, mindset and lifestyle, with meal plans, online courses, a blog and a virtual gym and wellness centre. Postpartum support is part of the range, and a waitlist and one-to-one coaching can be arranged online. Bioresonance scans are offered to anyone who is interested. Sessions are by appointment only, and a consultation can be booked to talk through options.

listings.name: Christine Palmer FNP Restore Health & Wellness
listings.description: Christine Palmer, a family nurse practitioner (FNP), has served Denham Springs for over a decade through Restore Health & Wellness. The practice offers vitamin infusion therapy, Apollo cold laser therapy, supplements and ZYTO scanning. Rated 5.0 from 39 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Essential Wellness Energy Studio, LLC
listings.description: Essential Wellness Energy Studio, LLC in Folsom offers holistic facials, Raindrop Technique, vibrational Raindrop, ZYTO scans, salt therapy and BioMat sessions, with education for clients who want to build energetic, active lives. It serves St. Tammany. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Unwind with Esther LLC.
listings.description: Unwind with Esther LLC. in Covington pairs massage therapy with a custom set of frequencies designed by the AO Scan, with sessions aimed at relaxation, stress relief and nervous system balance. Esther also teaches Hanna Somatic movement, a way to retrain how the body holds tension. Massage, somatics training or both can be booked. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Step N2 Health
listings.description: Step N2 Health in Lafayette draws on 30 years in natural health. A ZYTO biofeedback session starts each client's nutritional support plan with nutritionally dense supplements, backed by reflexology and aromatherapy with essential oil blends made up as roll-ons, sprays and lotions. Appointments are required. Rated 4.0 from 1 Google review.

listings.name: Health and Healing with Daile
listings.description: Health and Healing with Daile is a New Orleans massage practice that blends bodywork with Bio-Resonance AO scans, essential oils, hot stones, infrared light and tuning forks. Services include Ahiatsu barefoot massage and the Young Living Raindrop Technique, alongside coaching, meditation and breathwork. Daile is also a Master Spiritual Life, Health and Mindset Coach.

listings.name: Ivy Vitality Wellness Center
listings.description: Ivy Vitality Wellness Center in Mandeville is a holistic wellness practice offering ZYTO scan sessions, wellness coaching, PEMF therapy, infrared sauna, the Raindrop technique, Emotion Code and EVOX perception reframing. Juice programs, a nutritional weight programme, personal training and Pilates are also on offer, and the center sells its own herbal tinctures and skin care. Appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Hoboken Acupuncture
listings.description: Hoboken Acupuncture serves Hoboken, Jersey City and the wider New York area with acupuncture, cupping, gua sha, tui na massage and bio-resonance sessions that use Rife technology. Practitioners also travel with a house call service across the area, and telehealth consultations are available for clients who prefer to stay home. Supplements and coaching are on offer too. Appointments are required, and bookings are made by phone or text on (917) 300-9817. Rated 5.0 from 22 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: New Jersey Natural Medicine
listings.description: New Jersey Natural Medicine has served the Bedminster community since 2004 with integrative care based on naturopathic, Chinese and biological approaches. It is owned by Dr. Jason Frigerio, ND, L.Ac., and offers acupuncture, massage, micro-needling, infrared sauna, bio-resonance therapy, therapeutic bodywork and nutritional counseling, with a medicinals line and a journal of articles. Phone (973) 267-2650. Appointments are recommended, parking and the restroom are wheelchair accessible. Rated 5.0 from 20 Google reviews, 19 of them five stars.

listings.name: Timbrel Natural Health, LLC
listings.description: Timbrel Natural Health in Piscataway is the practice of Ella Mendalski, who describes her work as biblically focused and holistic. Sessions use ZYTO biofeedback wellness scans together with personalised nutrition plans, and her focus areas include stress and emotional wellbeing. New clients can book a free 15-minute call before committing. Rated 5.0 from 11 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The business is women-owned and an appointment is recommended.

listings.name: Sutton BioEnergetix
listings.description: Sutton BioEnergetix is Randy Sutton's practice in Jackson Township, New Jersey, with 35 years behind functional biofeedback. Sessions centre on ZYTO scanning, with EVOX perception reframing added for some clients. Digital homeopathy and custom herbal formulas round out the offer. Sessions run remotely for clients worldwide as well as in person at the Toms River Road address in Jackson. The practice describes its approach as energizing the human experience, with a clear view of priorities at the start of each programme, and it also works with custom phytotherapy. Appointments are recommended, opening hours are posted and new clients can reach the practice through its contact form. Rated 4.8 from 12 Google reviews, 11 of them five stars and one at three stars.

listings.name: Infinite Healing and Wellness
listings.description: Infinite Healing and Wellness in Middletown Township is a holistic boutique with gifts, a Himalayan Salt Cave, an infrared sauna and a Quantum Resonance Crystal Bed. SCIO biofeedback sessions are offered for balance, and trained life coaches work with clients too. The owner is Certified Life Coach Colleen Brindley, who holds an MSEd in Counseling and an MA in Secondary Education from Hofstra University and has over 25 years of experience with children and families. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: THE HOLISTIC CENTER LLC. in POINT PLEASANT BEACH with Dr. Trish healey Montenegro ND
listings.description: The Holistic Center is the Point Pleasant Beach practice of Dr. Trish Healey Montenegro, ND, a naturopathic doctor who is also a woman-owned business owner. Zone technique is the focus of the program, and the service list adds ZYTO kinesiology muscle testing, a PEMF mat, quantum nutrition testing, hair tissue mineral analysis and DNA wellness kits. Appointments are recommended and there is free parking.

listings.name: ZEN Teraphy
listings.description: ZEN Teraphy is a physiotherapy and movement clinic in Ploiești for children and adults, in a modern central location. Its range covers kinetotherapy, physiotherapy with TECAR, laser and ultrasound devices, therapeutic and reflexology massage, jade roller bed massage, passive recovery on a Kinetec machine, lymphatic drainage and bioresonance. Individual and group sessions run in spacious rooms. Rated 5.0 from 24 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Opening hours are posted and the entrance is wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Lefter Andreea - Terapeut Holistic Aromaterapie si Evaluare Personalizata Scanare Zyto
listings.description: Andreea Lefter is a personal development counselor, aromatherapist and holistic practitioner in Ploiești. She works mainly with women facing stress and overload, using aromatherapy, personalised ZYTO scanning, the AromaTouch technique and coaching with the Neurographic method, and also works with doTERRA essential oils. Each session is adapted to the person and aims at clarity, balance and a sense of safety in a calm, warm space. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The practice is women-owned, sessions are on site and an appointment is recommended.

listings.name: Cabinet Medicina Alternativa Cristian Rosca
listings.description: Cabinet Medicina Alternativa Cristian Rosca in Ploiești offers sessions with a Metatron Ipp Hunter bioresonance device, together with nutrition, bioenergy, NLP counseling, lifestyle change, herbs, supplements and vitamins. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Opening hours are posted.

listings.name: Unda Vieții - Acupunctură , Biorezonantă, Masaj Ploiesti
listings.description: Unda Vieții in Ploiești is a practice led by a physician specialised in family medicine, who offers acupuncture, homeopathy and bioresonance, together with massage. The setting is built around relaxation, with calming music, essential oils and soft lighting. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews. Opening hours are posted and an appointment is recommended.

listings.name: Nutritie, Aromaterapie, Psihoterapie, Scanare Zyto, Diete slabire, Nutritionist, Psihoterapeut, NutriZen Ploiesti, Prahova
listings.description: NutriZen in Ploiești brings nutrition, aromatherapy, psychotherapy and ZYTO scanning under one roof, with a nutritionist, an aromatherapist and a psychotherapist named on the team. The centre says its purpose is to make people happy, using modern and traditional methods and personalised nutrition programs, including weight-loss diets. The ZYTO scan is described as simple and painless, and the device is also used to look at a person's emotional side. NutriZen also runs an online shop for doTERRA essential oils and holds events and seminars. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. An appointment is recommended, cards are accepted and opening hours are posted.

listings.name: ANIMA Center - psihoterapie/aromaterapie/scanare Zyto
listings.description: ANIMA Center in Ploiești is the practice of Mara Mitu, a psychologist, psychotherapist and aromatherapist with more than 20 years of experience. She combines psychotherapy, aromatherapy and ZYTO scanning, which she describes as modern evaluation technology, in an integrative approach aimed at inner balance and personal development. An appointment is recommended and opening hours are posted. There are no Google reviews yet.

listings.name: Amparo ૐ massage & soins énergétiques
listings.description: Amparo is a massage and somatic therapist, vocal artist and educator in Montreal, originally from Buenos Aires. Her training includes Swedish and Thai massage, Quantum Scio biofeedback and bio-resonance therapy in 2019, infant massage instruction, trauma tapping, Reiki I and II and yoga. Appointments are required. The practice is owned by women and welcomes LGBTQ clients. Rated 5.0 from 55 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Jodie Duplisea Massothérapie
listings.description: Jodie Duplisea Massothérapie in Val-David offers Tui Na, Thai, Californian and Swedish massage, osteodynamics, Aqua-Vie hot water massage, yoga, meditation, coaching and bioresonance. Retreats, sound baths and wellness days are on the calendar. Rated 5.0 from 29 Google reviews, 28 of them five stars. The entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible.

listings.name: Douce-Nature
listings.description: Douce-Nature is a naturopath's office in Montreal run by Hanane Mrabet Temsamani, a graduate naturopath who uses a ZYTO bioscanner as part of her sessions. Her approach is educational and preventive, with stress management, personalized meal planning and weight management also on offer. The practice is owned by women and welcomes LGBTQ clients, with appointments required and a wheelchair accessible entrance. Rated 5.0 from 27 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: illu Space
listings.description: Pilates and yoga are paired with frequency work at illu Space, a holistic wellness studio in Candiac. TimeWaver technology, Aromatouch, fascia release and personalised wellness coaching round out the services, aimed at the body, mind and energy. Rated 5.0 from 5 Google reviews, all of them five stars. It is a local option in Candiac.

listings.name: Aroma Power Plants Healing Center
listings.description: Pilates and yoga classes, offered with Lixin Pilates, share space at Aroma Power Plants Healing Center in Candiac with aromatherapy and emotional work, Reiki and TimeWaver frequency sessions. Rated 5.0 from one Google review. Call to ask what a TimeWaver session involves. It is a local option for anyone in Candiac curious about a frequency session.

listings.name: Heal With Josée - Body Mind Spirit Healing
listings.description: Josée Roussy offers energy and frequency sessions for people and animals from Boisbriand, all of them delivered at a distance in English and French. She is a certified Emotion Code, Body Code and Belief Code practitioner, a Certified Group Energy Facilitator and a Solex Quantum Living Advocate, and her work includes bioresonance with the AO Scan, an introductory scan and demo scans. Other offerings include Heart-Wall work, Resonating Relationships and Abundance Breakthrough. The AO Scan Mobile is a biofeedback scanner and frequency generator, and frequencies can be broadcast to a person, a group, a pet or a place. Session reports are detailed, a free evaluation is available before booking and the pages are also available in French.

listings.name: Be Balanced Spa
listings.description: Be Balanced Spa in Foley is a women owned spa that offers an AO Scan along with massage, Reiki, sound baths, brain tapping, Bemer sessions and ionic foot baths. A doctor of acupuncture and a holistic life coach are part of the team. Craniosacral therapy and yoga are also on the list of what the spa covers. Appointments are required. Rated 4.8 from 65 Google reviews, 62 of them five stars.

listings.name: Doc Bodie Cares
listings.description: Doc Bodie Cares is a naturopathic wellness practice led by Dr. Stefanie Bodie, ND, serving Vestavia Hills and Birmingham and working virtually across the United States and internationally. Services include Nutrition Response Testing, Emotion Code, personalised wellness programs, supplement recommendations and AO Scan sessions with Inner Voice scans. A supplement dispensary, intake forms and a blog are available. Rated 5.0 from 40 Google reviews, all of them five stars. An appointment is recommended. A locations and times page and a lab testing page are available are accepted.

listings.name: Gloria's Good Health
listings.description: Gloria's Good Health has been a locally owned vitamin, supplement and health food store in Decatur since 1989. Alongside supplements, natural foods, beauty products and CBD products, it offers vibration platform sessions, an infrared sauna, a ZYTO scanner, weight loss consultations and nutritional consultations, and its homemade smoothies are a feature. Curbside pickup and delivery are available. Rated 4.6 from 36 Google reviews, 30 of them five stars.

listings.name: Shoals Healing Frequencies
listings.description: Shoals Healing Frequencies in Killen, Alabama, is a metaphysical and holistic shop and sanctuary built around sound, light and frequency. April offers biofeedback scans and AO Scan sessions alongside massage therapy, Reiki, tarot and intuitive readings, for people and for pets. Sessions run 60 minutes, either in person or remotely over Zoom, and booking goes through Vagaro. The shop sells frequency-imprinted jewelry, harmonic teas, bath soaks and holographic stickers, with a link to the Solex store, and publishes The Frequency Hour videos. Its mission is a place where sound, light and land come together, with stewardship taught for future generations. Appointments are required, and an Alabama phone line is listed for bookings and questions. Rated 5.0 from 21 Google reviews, every one of them five stars. Phone 256-702-1756.

listings.name: Quantum Energy Healing LLC
listings.description: Quantum Energy Healing LLC in Foley is run by Chelsea Burns and offers scan sessions with the AO Scan, plus the Equiscope for animals. The AO Scan is an educational wellness tool that gives frequency-based feedback, and it is used for people, dogs and horses alike. Chelsea pairs the scan with microcurrent therapy and a whole-body, systems-thinking approach to wellness. For her, the most valuable part of a scan is seeing how the information connects with what someone has already been experiencing. The business describes its work as supporting humans and animals, and it asks clients to begin with a scan booking by email or phone. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both at five stars.

listings.name: Infinity Health & Wellness
listings.description: In Spreydon, Christchurch, Infinity Health & Wellness combines chiropractic and kinesiology with Bicom bioresonance. The team takes an integrative approach built on client education and lifestyle changes, aiming to help each person reach their best level of wellbeing. Rated 5.0 from 14 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call to ask what a first appointment involves.

listings.name: Naturopathy Inbalance
listings.description: Based in Kaiapoi and serving North Canterbury and Christchurch, this naturopathic practitioner and herbalist offers consultations and personalised herbal formulations. BICOM bioresonance sessions are part of the mix, with each consultation tailored to the client. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call to ask how a first appointment works.

listings.name: Energy Health
listings.description: Gabriela runs Energy Health in St Albans, Christchurch, offering quantum biofeedback along with Qigong and monthly Cha Dao tea sessions. The biofeedback system she uses scans for more than 10,000 frequencies. She trained with its inventor Professor Bill Nelson in Budapest and attended the QX World Conference. Sessions are non-invasive and sensor-based, aimed at relaxation and stress reduction, and some clients continue remotely after a first session. Her approach is warm, personal and holistic, and shiatsu elements are included where suitable. Pages explain what a session looks like and how remote sessions work, and the menu covers biofeedback, tea and Qigong. Rated 5.0 from 2 Google reviews, both at five stars. Contact details include a phone number, +64 27 611 3353, and an email address.

listings.name: William Bisset Functional Medicine Pracitioner
listings.description: William Bisset works from the Brilin Centre with clients in Christchurch and Timaru, offering bio resonance evaluations for adults and children. Virtual consultations are available over Zoom for people elsewhere. He also speaks at corporate and wellness events, runs workshops and shares testimonials and videos. Call to ask how an appointment works and what a first visit involves.

listings.name: Bioresonance Therapy
listings.description: Bioresonance Therapy is a Christchurch business whose name points to bioresonance sessions. It is a local option for anyone in the city curious about a session. Call to ask which device is used, what a first session involves, what hours it keeps and how appointments are booked before you plan a visit.

listings.name: Step Stone
listings.description: Step Stone Wellness Center is housed in one of the historic buildings in downtown Hamilton and is owned by women. Its practitioners offer Reiki, intuitive energy work, Body Talk sessions, CranioSacral massage, bio-resonance, oxygen sessions, sound sessions, crystal therapy, life coaching and spiritual coaching. Appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 23 Google reviews, 22 of them five stars.

listings.name: Steady Journey Energy Work
listings.description: Steady Journey Energy Work LLC is based in Bozeman, Montana, and run by Ian, who offers Emotion Code, Body Code, Belief Code, Solid State Technology and quantum biofeedback sessions. The work is for individuals and their pets, and horses, dogs and cats each have their own page. Belief Code is one of its core services, a blog covers Body Code and Belief Code, appointments can be booked online and are recommended, and the entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible. Cards are accepted. The team can also be contacted directly through the booking options. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Confirm the location with the practice, because the Maps address is in Belgrade, near Bozeman.

listings.name: Stress Therapy Studio LLC
listings.description: Stress Therapy Studio LLC in Billings offers therapeutic massage backed by more than 40 years of international practice. Biofeedback sessions use SCENAR, BRT and MORA, and spiritual work is also offered. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review. Parking is wheelchair accessible. Call to confirm hours and how to book.

listings.name: Quantum Wellness Biofeedback
listings.description: Quantum Wellness Biofeedback in Missoula is the practice of Sharon Gehl, RN, who offers quantum biofeedback sessions of one to two hours aimed at stress reduction and balance in mind, body and spirit. She is also a doTERRA consultant, and a free download is available through her pages. Visitors can chat online and book a session. Appointments are recommended. Sessions are booked online through the Book Now button, and the practice also invites visitors to chat with the team. Sessions are booked online and each session takes one to two hours.

listings.name: Rachel Webster
listings.description: Rachel Webster is a craniosacral therapist in Whitefish who sees clients by appointment in the office of Tree of Life Quantum Biofeedback. Call to ask whether quantum biofeedback sessions are offered there and how to book. Craniosacral therapy is the practice's listed specialty, and visits are by arrangement.

listings.name: Echoing Bioresonance Therapy
listings.description: Echoing Bioresonance Therapy in Billingham is run by Nicole and uses a Bicom Optima machine, with a Bicom body check report available. A first appointment is a consultation of about 90 minutes, in person or remotely, and an online form is filled in beforehand. Therapy is offered in person or remotely, and for remote clients the therapy is stored on a chip and posted out. Sessions for animals and a mental health therapy session are also listed, Nicole shares her own story with bioresonance, and every first appointment starts with an initial consultation. The wheelchair accessible entrance, parking and restroom are in place. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Harmonic Resonance
listings.description: Harmonic Resonance is a bioresonance clinic in Bellerby, close to Leyburn in North Yorkshire. It uses Rayonex bioresonance devices, with both the PS 10 and the PS 1000 polar models, in its sessions, and a Vitality Health Screening is also offered. Gift vouchers are available, and discovery calls and appointments can be booked online with an account. A pricing page, FAQs and client experiences give more detail. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Soul Triage Bioresonance & Holistic Therapies
listings.description: Soul Triage is a home-based practice in Redcar run by Kerry Bavin. Bioresonance is offered remotely from a small hair or nail sample, and biofeedback sessions are on the menu alongside Rife frequency sessions. The range goes on to Reiki, Seichem, Emotion Code and remote distance sessions, plus massage in several styles, reflexology, wood therapy and cavitation. Rated 5.0 from 9 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The practice is women-owned and appointments are required. Business and land readings are also offered.

listings.name: Harmonic Resonance
listings.description: Harmonic Resonance in Richmond is a biofeedback practice offering bioresonance sessions and lifestyle and fitness assessments. It is a local option for anyone interested in a bioresonance session, and it is categorised as a biofeedback therapist. Call to ask which device is used, what a first session involves, where appointments take place and how to book.

listings.name: Nickey Smith Bioresonance
listings.description: Nickey Smith Bioresonance in Richmond is a health consultant whose name points to bioresonance sessions. It is a local option for anyone curious about a bioresonance session. Call to ask which services are offered, what a first session involves and how to book.

listings.name: Simply Health Collective
listings.description: Simply Health Collective in Jackson is a wellness centre founded by a naturopath. Its BioResonance Health Evaluation uses an Asyra/Qest4 device for a bio-field scan session. The therapy rooms also hold an IASIS BioCharger, a Migun bed, an ionic foot bath, the FLOWpresso system, a HOCATT unit, a salt and sound booth, Rife sessions and PEMF therapy. Thermography is available too, and a supplement shop sits on the same premises. Video sessions are available for clients who cannot visit, and the practice also sees cats, dogs and horses. New clients complete an intake form and arrive 15 minutes early. The team publishes a blog and a gallery, and schedules are booked online. Rated 5.0 from 22 Google reviews, every one of them five stars.

listings.name: Harvest Health-Naturopath in Energy Medicine-Alternative Health Care
listings.description: Harvest Health in Gillette is a woman-owned, faith-based alternative health practice led by a certified naturopath in energy medicine. Services include needle-free auriculotherapy, Rife frequency work, phototherapy, frequency resonance energy work and bio-field scanning with devices such as Healy and ZYTO. Organic products, medicinal teas and homeopathy are on offer. Appointments are recommended. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Advanced Skin Care
listings.description: Advanced Skin Care in Casper, Wyoming, is a boutique with more than 30 years of experience in skin care and holistic wellness. Alongside laser sessions, crystal-free microdermabrasion, microcurrent facials and a body wrap, it offers a 30-minute ZYTO Handscan Balance to help clients choose a personal blend of dōTERRA essential oils. A certified holistic coach is on the team, and the shop carries Colorescience, Sanitas and Clarisonic products. Booking is online. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Hope Healing Haven
listings.description: Hope Healing Haven is a biofeedback practice in Powell, a sanctuary for overall wellbeing. The service list includes AO Scan sessions, neurofeedback, mindset coaching, a Soqi bed with a Chi machine, an ionic foot bath and Raindrop sessions. Rated 5.0 from 6 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Call for current opening times.

listings.name: Black Hills Wellness, LLC

listings.name: ReikiWorx
listings.description: ReikiWorx Pilates & Rehab Centre offers Pilates classes, both monthly group classes and individual, Reiki sessions, pelvic chair therapy and Scio biofeedback therapy. Scio sessions run between an hour and a half and two hours, and the centre also offers a Reiki ceremony for couples. The parking, seating and restroom are wheelchair accessible, cards are accepted and appointments are recommended. Call 082 326 4720 to confirm the location and how to book.

listings.name: All About Stress Release & More
listings.description: All About Stress Release & More is a fitness and wellness practice in Regina. The practitioner is a certified Tension and Trauma Release (TRE) provider, a certified quantum biofeedback specialist, a certified iridologist and a certified NLP practitioner, with training in applied kinesiology and nutritional counselling. TRE, nutritional counselling, applied kinesiology and quantum biofeedback are all available in person or online. Rated 4.8 from 10 Google reviews, 8 of them five stars. The business is women-owned and has free parking.

listings.name: Angel Spiritual Connections Wellness Center
listings.description: Angel Spiritual Connections Wellness Center in Fort Qu'Appelle is owned by Maureen Bandas and offers gentle, non-invasive services for emotional, mental, physical and spiritual wellbeing. Her offerings include Reiki, chakra balancing, Access Bars, Shiva Murti Balinese energy work and hypnotherapy for stress and confidence. AO Scan frequency-based services include Inner-Voice and Whole-Body scans using voice-based frequency analysis, and signature remote wellness programs. Remote space and land clearings and Reiki certified training classes are offered as well. The center is a safe and loving space that uses frequency and energy modalities, and a free guided meditation and Maureen's story are offered. A free parking lot is on site. Rated 5.0 from 3 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Dream Wellness
listings.description: Dream Wellness in Lloydminster is a wellness centre offering SCIO biofeedback sessions. The shop side stocks handmade malas, bracelets, crystal car charms and macrame creations. Call ahead to ask how a SCIO session works, how long it lasts, where appointments take place and how to book. Ask whether remote sessions are possible too.

listings.name: Centrul Naturist GreenVita - Magazin Naturist Medias/Farmacie Naturista Medias
listings.description: GreenVita in Mediaș is a natural products shop and pharmacy offering healthy foods, food supplements, vegetable cold cuts, kitchen equipment for healthy cooking and books. Staff give nutrition and natural therapy guidance, and bioresonance consultations are available in the shop. Rated 4.8 from 12 Google reviews, 11 of them five stars.

listings.name: NUTRISIB - Health&Lifestyle
listings.description: NutriSib in Sibiu offers nutrition and lifestyle coaching built on the C.E.L.O.S. method of Dr. ing. Radu Pascu, which combines bioimpedance and bioresonance assessments. It also has personal training and a large range of food supplements. Full sessions are available in person in Sibiu or fully online by Zoom. Rated 3.7 from 6 Google reviews, 4 of them five stars and 2 one star.

listings.name: SC LOTUS MED SRL-Medias
listings.description: SC LOTUS MED SRL in Mediaș is a homeopathy practice trading as Doctor Natura. Its range covers homeopathy consultations, bioresonance, Bowen therapy and vibrational medicine, and it names the SCIO QXCI system as a bioresonance and biofeedback device. A spinal scan with a Mouse Spinal is also listed, and consultations are offered for spine and metabolic questions. Rated 2.5 from two Google reviews. Appointments are required, and parking and a restroom are accessible.

listings.name: Cultivate Wellness
listings.description: Cultivate Wellness in Taylors is an appointment-only wellness center that pairs massage therapy and manual lymphatic drainage with quantum biofeedback and PEMF sessions. Biofeedback wellness coaching and functional nutrition are on the service list, and wellness gift cards are sold. Rated 5.0 from 15 Google reviews, all of them five stars. Booking is online, by phone on (864) 924-9477 or by WhatsApp, and the entrance and parking are wheelchair accessible. A restroom is on site are accepted.

listings.name: Harmony and Fusion LLC
listings.description: Harmony and Fusion LLC is a wellness center in Greenville offering BrainTap brain entrainment sessions, bioresonance biological information sessions, PEMF, Qigong and energy work. Computer SEG (electro-segment-electrography) is also on the list, along with supplement assessments and energetic supplement preparation. A comprehensive evaluation and weekly session options are available. It is a small wellness center that pairs technology-based sessions with movement practices such as Qigong. Rated 5.0 from 4 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Stout Wellness
listings.description: Stout Wellness in Greer offers ZYTO scans and bio sessions, along with an individualized supplement program, wellness counseling, food counseling, sauna time, exercise readiness and wellness seminars. It is open by appointment only, with online booking, and seminars are run for the community. Call to ask which sessions are currently offered. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review, at five stars.

listings.name: Flower of Life Biofeedback
listings.description: Flower of Life Biofeedback is the practice of Melanie A. Crawford, a Certified Holistic Health Counselor (HHC), offering QuEx-ED quantum biofeedback sessions aimed at emotional wellbeing and athletic ability. The practice is at 250 Main Street, Suite 102, Room D, in Montpelier, Vermont, and Barre is the listed city. Parking is wheelchair accessible. The business is categorised as a biofeedback therapist. Rated 5.0 from 1 Google review. Email the practice or call to confirm hours and how to book.

listings.name: Cutting Edge Salon Artistic Styles
listings.description: Cutting Edge Salon at Artistic Styles, 269 North Main in Rutland, Vermont, is run by Michelle, who has more than 32 years of experience in precision haircuts, custom colour, skin care and waxing. Alongside the salon work she offers Reiki sessions and, as a ZYTO specialist, personalised wellness sessions with ZYTO scans aimed at balance and stress. Call 802.236.0669 to book.

listings.name: Judy Breitmeyer--Greater Wellness Consultant
listings.description: Judy Breitmeyer is a wellness coach and Young Living Brand Partner in Greensboro Bend. She uses survey tools, including the ZYTO Scan, which gathers responses from the body to help work out wellness options, so clients can make healthier choices based on how their body responds.

listings.name: E. Dando Holistics
listings.description: E. Dando Holistics is a natural health practice in Newport, South East Wales, run by Emma Dando. Bioresonance sessions can take place face to face at one of several clinic locations across South East Wales, or remotely using a small hair or fingernail sample. Other services include kinesiology, naturopathic nutrition, Reiki, tuning fork sound therapy, acupuncture, Seichem, flower essence therapy, well-being retreats, talks and workshops. Gift vouchers are available and appointments are required. Rated 5.0 from 24 Google reviews, all of them five stars.

listings.name: Newton Hale Centre of Bioresonance (NHC)
listings.description: The Newton Hale Centre of Bioresonance (NHC) is a therapy centre run on the north-west border of England and Wales. Its pages explain the client journey, bioresonance and life coaching through Peace2gether, and a team stays in touch by phone on 01244 911 999. Reviews and news are published, and clients can register online. Rated 5.0 from 10 Google reviews, all of them five stars. The entrance, parking and restroom are wheelchair accessible, and an appointment is recommended. The centre calls itself modern, supportive and quick-developing, with a skilled team whose work is regularly reviewed.

listings.name: Wellness for all
listings.description: Wellness for All in Abergele is a holistic practice that uses dowsing and a bioresonance machine in its sessions. It also runs in-person courses that teach dowsing for personal health and wellness. Call to ask what a first session involves and how to book.
